bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Slip your arms into them, and voila! You’re kept afloat!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Masukkan kedua lenganmu, dan voila! Kamu pun tetap mengapung!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: It's Mabel! She tied a string to herself, binding herself to you. Now she's riding securely in your pack.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Ini Mabel! Dia mengikatkan tali ke tubuhnya agar terikat padamu. Kini dia menumpang dengan aman di dalam tasmu.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: You know what they say. One critter’s lace, is another critter’s bondage rope~!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Kamu tahu kata orang. Tali sepatu seorang penghuni bisa jadi tali pengikat bagi penghuni lain~!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Issue 68. Mint condition! Save for a recent stain… definitely not saliva.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Edisi 68. Kondisinya prima! Kecuali satu noda baru… jelas bukan air liur.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Wear this in icy places, and cold can’t even touch you! Looks super styley too.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Kenakan ini di tempat berlapis es, dan hawa dingin pun tak bisa menyentuhmu! Kelihatannya juga keren sekali.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A box of Finley's stuff he left with his old roommates. Looks like some papers, paintbrushes, and a few bedroom toys.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Sekotak barang milik Finley yang ditinggalkannya di tempat mantan teman serumahnya. Sepertinya berisi kertas, kuas lukis, dan beberapa mainan ranjang.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A sturdy building material, just perfect for reinforcing heavy structures like the town bridge…
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Bahan bangunan yang kokoh, cocok sekali untuk memperkuat bangunan berat seperti jembatan kampung…

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A glass jar containing the "seed of a wolf." A tribe of forest mice asked you to obtain it for a peculiar ceremony...
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Stoples kaca berisi "benih serigala". Suku tikus hutan memintamu mendapatkannya untuk sebuah upacara yang aneh...

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: It’s got all the right curves, and just enough girth to really fill ya up!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Lekukannya pas, dan ketebalannya cukup untuk membuatmu merasa penuh!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A classic, practical tool for excavating and outdoor projects. Surprisingly, shovels are hard to come by in this forest!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Alat klasik yang praktis untuk menggali dan mengerjakan proyek di luar ruangan. Anehnya, sekop sulit didapat di hutan ini!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A jar of frisky fireflies that makes a great lantern. You'd like to watch what's happening in there, but they move around too fast!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Stoples kunang-kunang nakal yang bisa menjadi lentera bagus. Kamu ingin melihat apa yang terjadi di dalamnya, tetapi mereka bergerak terlalu cepat!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A jar of frisky fireflies. You'd like to watch what's happening in there, but they move around too fast!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Stoples kunang-kunang nakal. Kamu ingin melihat apa yang terjadi di dalamnya, tetapi mereka bergerak terlalu cepat!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: This bell will summon Penny to the Central Forest fast travel perch!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Lonceng ini akan memanggil Penny ke tempat hinggap perjalanan cepat Hutan Tengah!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A bottle of ’Sugar’ … an ingredient Scarlett's never been out of her entire life!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Sebotol ’Gula’ … bahan yang seumur hidup tak pernah habis di rumah Scarlett!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Some warm fluffy wool from Finley. Perfect sweater-making material!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Wol hangat dan lembut dari Finley. Bahan yang pas untuk membuat sweter!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A musty piece of wood to the layman. A blank canvas to the artisan.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Bagi orang awam, hanya sepotong kayu apak. Bagi perajin, sebuah kanvas kosong.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A gift from Peter. The wearer might spot "very interesting things…"
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Hadiah dari Peter. Pemakainya mungkin akan melihat "hal-hal yang sangat menarik…"

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A heavy package for Scarlett. Contains two ball gags, one riders crop, two pairs of handcuffs and a full range of anal plugs…
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Paket berat untuk Scarlett. Berisi dua penyumbat mulut berbentuk bola, satu cambuk berkuda, dua pasang borgol, dan satu rangkaian lengkap penyumbat anal…

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Sweet and delicious! You’d snack on these all day if you could!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Manis dan lezat! Kalau bisa, kamu ingin mengemilnya sepanjang hari!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: (Usable) A series of steamy photographs of Melody from a secret modeling session in Maverick's back-room studio.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: (Dapat Digunakan) Serangkaian foto panas Melody dari sesi pemotretan rahasia di studio ruang belakang Maverick.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A jar of frisky fireflies. You'd like to watch what's happening in there, but they move around too fast!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Stoples kunang-kunang nakal. Kamu ingin melihat apa yang terjadi di dalamnya, tetapi mereka bergerak terlalu cepat!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Sharp and shiny, these salutary scissors are suitable for all sorts of shearing shenanigans.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Tajam dan berkilau, gunting berguna ini cocok untuk segala keseruan cukur-mencukur.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A light package for Augustus. Contains an ancient relic of some sort.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Paket ringan untuk Augustus. Berisi sejenis relik kuno.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: To our weary traveler~ Get well soon! We are excited to meet you! The next page is a mess of signatures and paw prints.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Untuk pengelana kami yang kelelahan~ Lekas sembuh! Kami tak sabar ingin bertemu denganmu! Halaman berikutnya penuh tanda tangan dan cap telapak yang bertumpuk-tumpuk.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A gift from Scarlett. This nifty atlas helps travelers navigate the forest! Activate it with [M] or [Select].
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Hadiah dari Scarlett. Atlas praktis ini membantu para pengelana menentukan arah di hutan! Aktifkan dengan [M] atau [Select].

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: This bell will summon Penny to the Lake fast travel perch!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Lonceng ini akan memanggil Penny ke tempat hinggap perjalanan cepat Danau!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A handy notebook that gives you access to the Critter Log, the Quest Log, and Gossiping with Critters!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Buku catatan praktis yang memberimu akses ke Catatan Penghuni, Catatan Misi, dan Obrolan bersama para penghuni!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: An empty glass jar. You could carry all sorts of fun stuff inside!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Stoples kaca kosong. Kamu bisa membawa segala macam barang seru di dalamnya!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: During some Adventures, your other items are stored in the background. You'll see them again when the Adventure is finished!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Selama beberapa Petualangan, barang-barangmu yang lain disimpan sementara. Kamu akan melihatnya lagi setelah Petualangan selesai!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: This bell will summon Penny to the Mountain fast travel perch!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Lonceng ini akan memanggil Penny ke tempat hinggap perjalanan cepat Pegunungan!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A scrumptious red apple from the tree near the northern mountains.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Apel merah yang lezat dari pohon dekat pegunungan di utara.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: This bell will summon Penny to the Plains fast travel perch!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Lonceng ini akan memanggil Penny ke tempat hinggap perjalanan cepat Dataran!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Tournament legal, professional-grade, wood and carbon fiber. A proper endgame-spanker.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Sah untuk turnamen, kelas profesional, terbuat dari kayu dan serat karbon. Pemukul pantat kelas pamungkas sejati.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: An empty glass jar. You could carry all sorts of fun stuff inside!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Stoples kaca kosong. Kamu bisa membawa segala macam barang seru di dalamnya!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Expert Craftsmanship, a touch of Southern Comfort, and a heavy dose of Adult Innovation.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Keterampilan seorang ahli, sedikit Southern Comfort, dan inovasi dewasa yang melimpah.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Part of a cookie Mabel couldn't finish. It's as sweet as the others, but moreso because you got to share it with her.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Bagian kukis yang tak sanggup dihabiskan Mabel. Manisnya sama seperti yang lain, tetapi terasa lebih manis karena kamu bisa berbagi dengannya.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Friendship cookies! Piping fresh and ready to go. These sugary snacks will surely help break the ice!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Kukis persahabatan! Baru matang dan siap dibawa. Camilan manis ini pasti bisa membantu mencairkan suasana!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Fully Adjustable, Customizable. Recommended use with silicone toys only.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Bisa disetel dan disesuaikan sepenuhnya. Disarankan hanya digunakan dengan mainan silikon.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A gift from Augustus. It might help to decipher glyphs around the forest.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Hadiah dari Augustus. Mungkin bisa membantu menguraikan glif di sekitar hutan.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A gift from Maverick. It's definitely broken, but it’s still an amusing conversation piece.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Hadiah dari Maverick. Jelas rusak, tetapi tetap menarik untuk dijadikan bahan obrolan.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A professional camera with a wide angle lens. Essential equipment for any kind of studio photography.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Kamera profesional dengan lensa sudut lebar. Peralatan penting untuk segala jenis fotografi studio.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A special friendship cookie for Finley to help his old roommates make amends. The icing spells out "We're Sorry".
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Kukis persahabatan istimewa untuk Finley, agar mantan teman serumahnya bisa memperbaiki hubungan mereka. Lapisan gulanya bertuliskan "We're Sorry", yang berarti "Kami Minta Maaf".

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: A gift from Ollie. It doesn't seem particularly lucky, but it was still thoughtful of him!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Hadiah dari Ollie. Kelihatannya tidak terlalu membawa keberuntungan, tetapi pemberiannya tetap penuh perhatian!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: Money! Cash! Pesos! Collect enough of these coins and you can buy ALL the nifty goodies at The Musky Mustelid…
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.target: Uang! Duit! Peso! Kumpulkan cukup banyak koin ini dan kamu bisa membeli SEMUA barang keren di Mustelid Muskus…

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/0Bzeuogx.source: (Usable) A very special Season's Greetings card from Melody and Penny, featuring a spicy hot photo from the coldest time of year.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Got some explorin’ to do! Not sure what I want yet -- but I'm sure you can help me find it!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Masih ada yang ingin kucoba! Belum tahu apa yang kuinginkan -- tapi aku yakin kamu bisa membantuku menemukannya!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Gather some critters for sexy shenanigans in the bunnies' downstairs dungeon.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Kumpulkan beberapa penghuni untuk bersenang-senang nakal di ruang bawah tanah pasangan kelinci.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Help Mabel remember what really happened during her last Blessing of the Bells.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Bantu Mabel mengingat apa yang sebenarnya terjadi saat Berkah Lonceng terakhirnya.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Thanks for helping out today, Red. The critters and I really appreciate it!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Terima kasih sudah membantu hari ini, Merah. Aku dan para penghuni sangat menghargainya!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Track down an elusive wolf to collect an important ingredient for the mouse ceremony.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Lacak serigala yang sulit ditemui untuk mengumpulkan bahan penting bagi upacara tikus.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Melody has an idea where you might find an extra greeting card from last year's Blessing. See if you can track it down!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Melody punya gambaran di mana kamu bisa menemukan kartu ucapan tambahan dari Berkah Lonceng tahun lalu. Coba lacak keberadaannya!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Wind from the Big Storm scattered Melody's photoshoot photos around in the forest! Help Maverick find them all.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Angin Badai Besar menyebarkan foto-foto sesi pemotretan Melody ke seluruh hutan! Bantu Maverick menemukannya semua.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: What exactly is the Blessing Of The Bells? See if some of the forest critters can tell you more!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Apa sebenarnya Berkah Lonceng itu? Cari tahu apakah beberapa penghuni hutan bisa menjelaskan lebih lanjut!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Sonny, ya familiar with PlayBear? I’d love to get my paws on a copy!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Nak, kamu tahu PlayBear? Aku ingin sekali punya satu eksemplar!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Join Mabel's tribe in an ancient ceremony to quell the "spirit of the forest."
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Ikuti upacara kuno bersama suku Mabel untuk menenangkan "roh hutan".

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: I need a new toy, but not just ANY toy, it has to NOT look like a toy. Understand?
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Aku butuh mainan baru, tetapi bukan SEMBARANG mainan. Bentuknya harus TIDAK terlihat seperti mainan. Paham?

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Check up on the critters after yesterday's big storm!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Periksa keadaan para penghuni setelah badai besar kemarin!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Search the forest for a light source to visit Mabel's folks.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Carilah sumber cahaya di hutan untuk mengunjungi kaum Mabel.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Maverick's been harvesting Oliver's seed and carrying it away. But why? And why does he need so much?
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Maverick mengumpulkan benih Oliver dan membawanya pergi. Tapi kenapa? Dan kenapa dia membutuhkan begitu banyak?

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Trade Ollie some apples for a ride across the Plains.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Tukarkan apel dengan tumpangan dari Ollie melintasi Dataran.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Find the plant and bring back some special 'seed' for Scarlett.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Temukan tumbuhan itu dan bawakan 'benih' istimewa untuk Scarlett.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Deliver cookies from Charlotte to all the forest critters.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Antarkan kukis dari Charlotte kepada semua penghuni hutan.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Go find a few critters Scarlett wants you to meet.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Pergilah menemui beberapa penghuni yang ingin Scarlett perkenalkan kepadamu.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source:
While you're playing an Adventure, your other quests are stored in the background.

You'll see them again when the Adventure is finished!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target:
Selama kamu menjalani Petualangan, misi-misi lain disimpan sementara.

Kamu akan melihatnya lagi setelah Petualangan selesai!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Help Bucky gather building materials to fix the town bridge.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Bantu Bucky mengumpulkan bahan bangunan untuk memperbaiki jembatan kampung.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: There's a rope-oriented bondage I’d like to try! Can you help me find ropes my size?
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Ada pengikatan dengan tali yang ingin kucoba! Bisa bantu aku mencari tali yang sesuai ukuranku?

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: It's the ladies' turn! Gather a few frisky females for more shenanigans in the bunnies' downstairs dungeon.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Giliran para perempuan! Kumpulkan beberapa perempuan yang sedang bergairah untuk kembali bersenang-senang nakal di ruang bawah tanah pasangan kelinci.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Meet the critters and fetch some sugar for Scarlett.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Berkenalanlah dengan para penghuni dan ambilkan gula untuk Scarlett.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Help the coyotes knit you a cozy warm sweater.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Bantu kedua koyote merajut sweter yang hangat dan nyaman untukmu.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Help Maverick deliver some curious items to the forest critters.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Bantu Maverick mengantar beberapa barang menarik kepada para penghuni hutan.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Help Finley close the loop with his old roommates.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Bantu Finley menyelesaikan masalah dengan mantan teman serumahnya.

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Help the forest critters weather a fierce, wild thunderstorm rolling through the neighborhood!
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Bantu para penghuni hutan menghadapi badai petir dahsyat yang melanda lingkungan mereka!

bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.source: Help Maverick find someone to model in his steamy afterdark photoshoot.
bgdb:resources.assets:320/sheet/t0mvbnMW.target: Bantu Maverick mencari seseorang untuk menjadi model dalam sesi pemotretan malamnya yang panas.

ds:100:100:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]See, honey, I’ve been craving panda… Think you can help?
ds:100:100:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Begini, Sayang, aku sedang mengidamkan panda… Bisa bantu?

ds:100:96:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]What a day! Thanks so much for helping out, sweetie~!
ds:100:96:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hari yang luar biasa! Terima kasih banyak sudah membantu, Sayang~!

ds:100:97:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]… oh me? You didn’t get to help me out? Nonsense! I’m happy seeing my neighbors happy!
ds:100:97:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]… Oh, aku? Kamu belum membantuku? Ah, tidak! Aku senang melihat para tetangga senang!

ds:100:99:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]If you aren’t too tired… There is definitely something you can help me out with…
ds:100:99:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kalau belum terlalu lelah… Ada sesuatu yang pasti bisa kamu bantu…

ds:105:116:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I should visit this area more often. It’s very relaxing and I love the river ambiance!
ds:105:116:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Aku harus lebih sering ke daerah ini. Sangat menenangkan, dan aku suka suasana sungainya!

ds:105:117:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey, I don’t know if you eat fish… but the fish here… don’t like to be eaten… This was news to me.
ds:105:117:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hei, aku tidak tahu apa kamu makan ikan… tapi ikan di sini… tidak suka dimakan… Aku baru tahu.

ds:106:124:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hmm… part of me wants to update my dam into something a bit more presentable…
ds:106:124:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hmm… sebagian diriku ingin membenahi bendunganku jadi lebih enak dilihat…

ds:106:125:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]A lot of the woodwork around town was done by me!
ds:106:125:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Banyak kerajinan kayu di sekitar kota hasil kerjaku!

ds:106:126:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But the other part of me digs the rustic feel!

ds:106:127:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m just happy to see my work appreciated!

ds:106:128:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]These old bones can’t quite keep up these days!
ds:106:128:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tulang-tulang tua ini belakangan sulit mengimbangi kesibukan!

ds:106:129:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]*Yawwwwn* ah… I could go for a nap right about now…
ds:106:129:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]*Menguaaaap* ah… Sekarang aku ingin tidur sebentar…

ds:107:116:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s hard work running a shop, Red! Hard but gratifyin’.
ds:107:116:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mengelola toko itu kerja keras, Merah! Berat tapi memuaskan.

ds:107:117:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]They’d love to fool around with you!

ds:107:118:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]We’re always lookin’ for a good pair of paws to help out though! Keep us in mind!
ds:107:118:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tapi kami selalu mencari sepasang tangan yang andal untuk membantu! Ingat kami, ya!

ds:107:119:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Remind me to introduce you to the gang later!
ds:107:119:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ingatkan aku untuk mengenalkanmu ke geng nanti!

ds:108:116:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Red! You’ve got a cute butt. Just sayin’. The view down here is great.
ds:108:116:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Merah! Pantatmu imut. Cuma bilang. Pemandangannya bagus dari bawah sini.

ds:108:117:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]By the way, if you wanted to try that sounding stuff… I’m your mouse~!
ds:108:117:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Omong-omong, kalau kamu ingin mencoba permainan uretra itu… Akulah tikusmu~!

ds:10:20:Dialogue Text.target: Kamu seharusnya tahu itu tidak baik.

ds:10:22:Dialogue Text.source: Is this the collapse of society and civilization as we know it?
ds:10:22:Dialogue Text.target: Apakah ini runtuhnya masyarakat dan peradaban yang kita kenal?

ds:111:9:Menu Text.source: [pic=3]Hey Red, how can I help you?

ds:112:7:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Hai Nak, apa yang kamu bawa untukku?

ds:115:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m kidding, you know you’re always welcome inside.
ds:115:2:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Aku bercanda, kamu tahu kamu selalu diterima di dalam.

ds:115:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]HOWEVER, I haven’t had a chance to tidy up. So you can’t come in yet.
ds:115:3:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]NAMUN, aku belum sempat merapikan rumah. Jadi kamu belum boleh masuk.

ds:115:4:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Red sweetie, I’m being serious, you can’t go inside.
ds:115:4:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Merah Sayang, aku serius, kamu tidak boleh masuk.

ds:115:6:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I refuse to play your childish games!

ds:115:7:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]… *Her glare pierces your heart and soul*

ds:115:9:Dialogue Text.source: The overwhelming amount of guilt stops you from entering the house.
ds:115:9:Dialogue Text.target: Rasa bersalah yang begitu besar menghentikanmu memasuki rumah.

ds:116:131:Dialogue Text.source: Trespassing? You’re not that kinda panda.
ds:116:131:Dialogue Text.target: Masuk tanpa izin? Kamu bukan panda semacam itu.

ds:117:11:Dialogue Text.source: Wouldn’t wanna be this bridge right now!
ds:117:11:Dialogue Text.target: Tidak mau jadi jembatan ini sekarang!

ds:117:12:Dialogue Text.source: When this bridge grew up, it could be anything.
ds:117:12:Dialogue Text.target: Saat besar nanti, jembatan ini bisa menjadi apa saja.

ds:117:13:Dialogue Text.source: Is it still called a bridge if it doesn’t function as one?
ds:117:13:Dialogue Text.target: Masih bisa disebut jembatan kalau tidak berfungsi sebagai jembatan?

ds:117:4:Dialogue Text.source: It seems there has been an incline in bridge-related violence in these parts.
ds:117:4:Dialogue Text.target: Tampaknya kekerasan terkait jembatan di daerah ini sedang meningkat.

ds:118:133:Dialogue Text.source: FADE TO BLACK, FADE IN TO THE SCENE
ds:118:133:Dialogue Text.target: FADE TO BLACK, FADE IN TO THE SCENE

ds:118:134:Dialogue Text.source: He was definitely my first in terms of big partners!
ds:118:134:Dialogue Text.target: Dia jelas yang pertama bagiku dalam urusan pasangan besar!

ds:118:135:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm that stretched feeling, with his hulking weight over me…
ds:118:135:Dialogue Text.target: Mmm, sensasi teregang itu, dengan bobot tubuhnya yang besar di atasku…

ds:118:136:Dialogue Text.source: It was exhilarating really! And I loved the challenge!
ds:118:136:Dialogue Text.target: Sungguh mendebarkan! Dan aku suka tantangannya!

ds:118:137:Dialogue Text.source: Over time, I was finally able to hilt him. GOSH what a good feeling!
ds:118:137:Dialogue Text.target: Lama-kelamaan, akhirnya aku bisa menampungnya sampai pangkal. ASTAGA, nikmat sekali!

ds:118:138:Dialogue Text.source: PAUSE/SHOW THE IMAGE CLEARLY, WHEN THE PLAYER HITS A BUTTON, FADE TO BLACK AND GO BACK TO THE GAME.
ds:118:138:Dialogue Text.target: PAUSE/SHOW THE IMAGE CLEARLY, WHEN THE PLAYER HITS A BUTTON, FADE TO BLACK AND GO BACK TO THE GAME.

ds:119:138:Dialogue Text.source: Rascal, will ya give us a minute?
ds:119:138:Dialogue Text.target: Rascal, bisa beri kami waktu sebentar?

ds:119:139:Dialogue Text.source: Peter likes his post coitus cuddles!

ds:119:2:Dialogue Text.target: *ngos ngos* Wah, Sayang, kamu luar biasa!

ds:119:321:Dialogue Text.source: Come on in honey. Take a seat on the bed…

ds:119:322:Dialogue Text.source: Ooh, are we doing sex stuff?

ds:119:323:Dialogue Text.source: Haha, yes. How’s that for a proper thank you
ds:119:323:Dialogue Text.target: Haha, iya. Bagaimana kalau ini jadi ucapan terima kasih yang pantas

ds:119:325:Dialogue Text.source: But I’m probably a bit too big for you…
ds:119:325:Dialogue Text.target: Tapi sepertinya barangku agak terlalu besar buatmu…

ds:119:326:Dialogue Text.source: Hah, Rascal… The critters here will surprise you with what they are capable of.
ds:119:326:Dialogue Text.target: Hah, Rascal… Kemampuan para penghuni di sini bakal membuatmu terkejut.

ds:119:327:Dialogue Text.source: That said, I’ll just be doing some mouth stuff.
ds:119:327:Dialogue Text.target: Meski begitu, aku cuma akan bermain dengan mulut.

ds:119:328:Dialogue Text.source: I’ve been wanting to see what ya got going on down there…
ds:119:328:Dialogue Text.target: Aku ingin melihat apa yang kamu punya di bawah sana…

ds:119:329:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh, and look how excited you are already…
ds:119:329:Dialogue Text.target: Oooh, dan lihat, kamu sudah begitu bergairah…

ds:119:330:Dialogue Text.source: Ah hah… I blame the recent plant activities…
ds:119:330:Dialogue Text.target: Ah, hah… Ini gara-gara kegiatan dengan tanaman tadi…

ds:119:331:Dialogue Text.source: Lay back, let me get a taste…

ds:119:332:Dialogue Text.source: Rascal lays back and lets the eager bunny get to work…
ds:119:332:Dialogue Text.target: Rascal berbaring dan membiarkan kelinci yang bersemangat itu mulai bekerja…

ds:11:18:Dialogue Text.source: Whoa! Is there something hidden here??
ds:11:18:Dialogue Text.target: Wah! Ada sesuatu tersembunyi di sini??

ds:120:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ve let all of the critters know you’re awake.
ds:120:156:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sudah kuberi tahu semua penghuni bahwa kamu sudah bangun.

ds:120:157:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Well, almost all of them, but word travels fast here…
ds:120:157:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Yah, hampir semuanya, tapi kabar cepat menyebar di sini…

ds:120:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So tell me. What is it you’re here for?
ds:120:158:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Jadi, ceritakanlah. Untuk apa kamu datang ke sini?

ds:120:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]… Mmmm. I think I know what you’re gettin’ at.

ds:120:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Haha, you’re not the first fella comin’ ‘round here to sleep around!
ds:120:162:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Haha, kamu bukan pria pertama yang datang ke sini untuk tidur dengan banyak pasangan!

ds:120:163:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I can imagine what you may have heard about our little town…
ds:120:163:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Bisa kubayangkan apa yang mungkin kamu dengar tentang kampung kecil kami…

ds:120:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But unfortunately, it doesn’t quite live up to the rumors.
ds:120:164:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tapi sayangnya, kenyataannya tak sepenuhnya seperti kabar yang beredar.

ds:120:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Y’see, we’ve all got things to do and lives to lead.
ds:120:165:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Begini, kami semua punya urusan dan kehidupan masing-masing.

ds:120:166:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Can’t possibly expect us to be bangin’ about all day!
ds:120:166:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Masa kamu berharap kami bercinta sepanjang hari!

ds:120:167:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Who’ll put dinner on the table? Who’ll fetch supplies for the town? Who’ll fix the broken bridge?
ds:120:167:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Siapa yang menyiapkan makan malam? Siapa yang mengambil perbekalan untuk kampung? Siapa yang memperbaiki jembatan rusak?

ds:120:168:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]See, we’re just a town like anywhere else.
ds:120:168:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Jadi, kampung kami sama saja seperti tempat lain.

ds:120:169:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]THOUGH that’s not to say we don’t have our fun!

ds:120:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]In fact! Now that I know that’s what you’re after, I can fill everyone else in…
ds:120:170:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Malah! Sekarang aku tahu itulah yang kamu cari, aku bisa memberi tahu yang lain…

ds:120:172:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Oh, let me fill ya in on how things work around here.
ds:120:172:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Oh, biar kujelaskan cara kerja berbagai hal di sini.

ds:120:173:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]If you see this above a critter’s head, it means they have something important to tell ya!
ds:120:173:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kalau kamu melihat ini di atas kepala penghuni, berarti ada hal penting yang ingin disampaikan padamu!

ds:120:174:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]If you see this, it means they’re waiting on you for something.
ds:120:174:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kalau kamu melihat ini, berarti mereka sedang menunggumu melakukan sesuatu.

ds:120:175:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]If you see this, it means you’ve got something for them!
ds:120:175:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kalau kamu melihat ini, berarti kamu punya sesuatu untuk mereka!

ds:120:176:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Lastly, when you see this, it means a critter has more to say on the topic.
ds:120:176:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Terakhir, kalau kamu melihat ini, berarti penghuni itu masih punya hal lain untuk disampaikan tentang topik tersebut.

ds:120:177:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Sometimes this is where the juicy stuff is!

ds:120:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Why don’t you go around and meet the rest of the folks?
ds:120:179:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Bagaimana kalau kamu berkeliling dan berkenalan dengan penghuni lain?

ds:120:180:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]While you’re out and about, pick me up some sugar from Maverick!
ds:120:180:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sekalian jalan-jalan, ambilkan aku gula dari Maverick, ya!

ds:120:183:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Straight to the point! You’re my kinda panda dear~
ds:120:183:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Terus terang sekali! Panda sepertimu memang seleraku, sayang~

ds:120:184:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]And by the looks of ya down below, you’re just my size too!
ds:120:184:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Dan kalau kulihat bagian bawahmu, ukurannya juga pas denganku!

ds:120:186:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]He’s the otter by the river. You’ll know him when ya see em!
ds:120:186:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Dia berang-berang di tepi sungai. Nanti kamu pasti mengenalinya!

ds:120:194:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Why don’t you go around and meet the rest of the folks?
ds:120:194:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Bagaimana kalau kamu berkeliling dan berkenalan dengan penghuni lain?

ds:121:188:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ohhh, look, I’m not on “good terms” with the fella that lives on that island.
ds:121:188:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ohhh, begini, hubunganku dengan pria yang tinggal di pulau itu tidak “baik-baik saja”.

ds:121:190:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But this is an urgent matter… The town’s needs come first…
ds:121:190:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tapi ini urusan mendesak… Kebutuhan kampung harus diutamakan…

ds:121:191:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nanti hari ini aku akan ke sana…

ds:121:192:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Unless… You learn how to swim by then?
ds:121:192:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kecuali… saat itu kamu sudah belajar berenang?

ds:121:193:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Nooo no. I’ll do it, I’ll do it…
ds:121:193:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tidak, tidak. Biar aku saja, biar aku saja…

ds:121:195:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hehe, it’s a bit old fashioned I suppose…

ds:121:197:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hey there, Rascal – didja’ get the wood I need?
ds:121:197:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Hei, Rascal, sudah dapat kayu yang kuperlukan?

ds:121:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Y’know, I recall there being some on the island in the middle of the lake.
ds:121:199:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Seingatku, ada beberapa di pulau di tengah danau.

ds:121:200:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]That might be enough to get us going here.
ds:121:200:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Mungkin cukup untuk mulai mengerjakan jembatan ini.

ds:121:201:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh but… you can’t swim that huh…
ds:121:201:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oh, tapi… kamu tidak bisa berenang ke sana, ya…

ds:121:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The big ole’ gator and I used to date some time ago.
ds:121:203:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Dulu aku sempat berkencan dengan aligator besar itu.

ds:121:205:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Some things change, while other things don’t…
ds:121:205:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ada hal yang berubah, ada juga yang tidak…

ds:121:206:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve never been one to confront emotional or social problems.
ds:121:206:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Aku tidak pernah pandai menghadapi masalah perasaan atau hubungan sosial.

ds:121:207:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m more of the: “bury things deep down until they disappear forever” kinda guy, y’know?
ds:121:207:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Aku lebih suka cara “pendam dalam-dalam sampai hilang selamanya”, tahu?

ds:122:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Red! What’s shakin’? How can I be of service?
ds:122:153:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Merah! Apa kabar? Ada yang bisa kubantu?

ds:122:154:Dialogue Text.source:
Can you swim across the lake
to the island for me?
ds:122:154:Dialogue Text.target:
Bisa berenang menyeberangi danau
ke pulau itu untukku?

ds:122:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]BUT, why would I swim FOR you? When I can HELP you swim across that lake instead?!
ds:122:156:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]TAPI, kenapa aku harus berenang MENGGANTIKANMU? Kalau aku bisa MEMBANTUMU berenang menyeberangi danau itu?!

ds:122:157:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Well, I won’t technically help you. I’m not gonna teach you or anything.
ds:122:157:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Yah, sebenarnya aku tidak akan membantumu langsung. Tidak mengajarimu atau semacamnya.

ds:122:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]No. Instead. I’ve got a couple of floaties for sale!
ds:122:158:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Bukan. Sebagai gantinya, aku punya sepasang pelampung untuk dijual!

ds:122:159:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]See, you slip your arms into them, and voila! You’re kept afloat!
ds:122:159:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Masukkan kedua lenganmu, dan voila! Kamu pun tetap mengapung!

ds:122:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So long as they don’t… pop… you should be fine…
ds:122:160:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Selama tidak… meletus… mestinya kamu tidak apa-apa…

ds:122:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Ahem, So we got a deal or what?

ds:122:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’ll sell em to ya for 2 coins!

ds:122:167:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Well JUST THIS ONCE, I’ll settle for a trade! Because we’re buds, Red.
ds:122:167:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Yah, KHUSUS KALI INI, barter juga boleh! Karena kita kawan, Merah.

ds:122:168:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]What do you have that might interest me, Red?
ds:122:168:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Apa yang kamu punya yang bisa menarik minatku, Merah?

ds:122:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Red, my guy. I do not do sexual favors as business transactions!
ds:122:170:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Merah, kawanku. Aku tidak menerima layanan seksual sebagai transaksi bisnis!

ds:122:171:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I keep work and pleasure very separate, you understand, my friend.
ds:122:171:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Urusan kerja dan kesenangan sangat kupisahkan, paham, kawan?

ds:122:176:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]HOWEVER, a skilled craftsman can make me something with that!
ds:122:176:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]TAPI, perajin yang terampil bisa membuatkan sesuatu untukku dari itu!

ds:122:177:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Tell ya what Red – Tell Bucky to make me "somethin’ fun" with that.
ds:122:177:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Begini saja, Merah. Minta Bucky membuatkan aku "sesuatu yang seru" dari kayu itu.

ds:122:178:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Once he has, I’ll trade ya for these floaties!

ds:123:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hey there, what can I do for ya?

ds:123:159:Dialogue Text.source: Can you sculpt “something fun” for Maverick?
ds:123:159:Dialogue Text.target: Bisa mengukir “sesuatu yang seru” untuk Maverick?

ds:123:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I know exactly what tickles that critter!
ds:123:162:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Aku tahu persis apa yang bisa menyenangkan penghuni itu!

ds:123:163:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Give me some time, and I’ll whip something out in a jiffy!
ds:123:163:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Beri aku waktu, nanti kubuatkan sesuatu secepat kilat!

ds:123:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Give me some time, and I’ll whip something out in a jiffy!
ds:123:164:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Beri aku waktu, nanti kubuatkan sesuatu secepat kilat!

ds:124:178:Dialogue Text.source: Yes, What do you think of this toy?

ds:124:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh wow. Yes, this is truly the work of a craftsman.
ds:124:179:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oh, wah. Ya, ini benar-benar hasil karya seorang perajin.

ds:124:180:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]*Sniff sniff* Mmm, it’s got that new dildo smell, Red - ya gotta get a whiff!
ds:124:180:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]*endus-endus* Mmm, ada aroma dildo baru, Merah. Coba cium!

ds:124:183:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oh man what a beauty… I can’t wait to put this in places.
ds:124:183:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Wah, indah sekali… Tak sabar ingin memasukkannya ke berbagai tempat.

ds:124:184:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well! A deal is a deal Red, one pair of swimfloaties coming right up!
ds:124:184:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Baiklah! Janji tetap janji, Merah. Sepasang pelampung renang segera datang!

ds:124:187:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Red do you have much experience with toys?

ds:124:189:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]We’re cut from the same cloth my friend, very good very good.
ds:124:189:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Selera kita sama, kawan. Bagus sekali, bagus sekali.

ds:124:190:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Bucky’s The best in the business, I promise!
ds:124:190:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Bucky yang terbaik di bidang ini, aku jamin!

ds:124:191:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’ve never seen such care and creativity in craftsmanship!
ds:124:191:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Belum pernah kulihat kerajinan yang dibuat dengan ketelitian dan kreativitas seperti itu!

ds:124:192:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The old chap’s got that going for sure!
ds:124:192:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Soal itu, pak tua itu memang jagonya!

ds:124:193:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s actually a little difficult to get items from him.

ds:124:195:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh, you gotta give these things a shot, Red! they’ll change your life!
ds:124:195:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oh, kamu harus mencoba mainan-mainan ini, Merah! Hidupmu akan berubah!

ds:124:196:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Giving or receiving, your life, will be changed.
ds:124:196:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Baik memberi maupun menerima, hidupmu akan berubah.

ds:124:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I should introduce you to some of my friends later!
ds:124:199:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Nanti harus kuperkenalkan kamu kepada beberapa temanku!

ds:124:200:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]We get up to all sorts of shenanigans.

ds:124:201:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]He’s the only crafter we got, so he manages all of the town and critter’s needs.
ds:124:201:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Dia satu-satunya perajin kami, jadi dia mengurus semua kebutuhan kampung dan para penghuninya.

ds:124:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]to dinky little trinkets to shove up your butt!
ds:124:203:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]sampai pernak-pernik kecil untuk dijejalkan ke pantatmu!

ds:125:192:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Haha, not yet my friend. We’ll find you something.
ds:125:192:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Haha, belum, kawan. Nanti kita carikan sesuatu untuk Anda.

ds:125:193:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]If you ever want to talk history or culture, I’m happy to assist.
ds:125:193:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kalau ingin berbincang tentang sejarah atau budaya, saya senang membantu.

ds:125:194:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]A majority of the critters here are uh… not so interested in the past.
ds:125:194:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Sebagian besar penghuni di sini, eh… tidak begitu tertarik pada masa lalu.

ds:125:195:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]That’s my main passion, so things have been… a bit lonely…
ds:125:195:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Itulah minat utama saya, jadi rasanya… agak sepi…

ds:125:196:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh. Before I forget, I’ve got a slab of wood here for you.
ds:125:196:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oh, sebelum saya lupa, ada sepotong kayu di sini untuk Anda.

ds:125:197:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And help yourself to the pile over there.
ds:125:197:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Dan silakan ambil dari tumpukan di sana.

ds:125:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Good to see you here, welcome to my little abode!
ds:125:199:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Senang melihat Anda di sini. Selamat datang di kediaman kecil saya!

ds:125:201:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I realized all too late that we didn’t properly introduce ourselves.
ds:125:201:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Saya terlambat sekali menyadari bahwa kita belum berkenalan dengan benar.

ds:125:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]philosopher, scholar, and student to the world and its histories. At your service.
ds:125:203:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]filsuf, cendekiawan, serta pelajar dunia dan sejarahnya. Siap melayani Anda.

ds:125:204:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]And whose rump did I have the pleasure of ferrying?
ds:125:204:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Dan pantat siapa yang tadi dengan senang hati saya antar menyeberang?

ds:125:206:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hei! Lihat siapa yang sekarang punya sirip!

ds:125:207:Dialogue Text.source:
Rascal Redtail, Fluffy, Red… and…
I don’t have any cool titles.
ds:125:207:Dialogue Text.target:
Rascal Redtail, Si Bulu Lembut, Merah… dan…
Aku tidak punya gelar keren.

ds:126:159:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Is that all the wood we need? Sure looks like it!
ds:126:159:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ini semua kayu yang kita perlukan? Kelihatannya begitu!

ds:126:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Just in time too! The blueprint is all finished up.
ds:126:161:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Tepat waktu juga! Rancangannya sudah selesai semua.

ds:126:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Nothing left now but to get to it!

ds:126:163:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Thanks so much for your help Rascal!

ds:127:260:Dialogue Text.source: Camera pans over. Pans back and auto-walk to them. Scarlett:
ds:127:260:Dialogue Text.target: Camera pans over. Pans back and auto-walk to them. Scarlett:

ds:127:263:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Smells like you’ve been fooling around a bit!
ds:127:263:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Dari baumu, sepertinya kamu sudah sedikit bersenang-senang!

ds:127:267:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]We were actually just talking about you and your promiscuity!
ds:127:267:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Sebenarnya kami baru saja membicarakanmu dan kebiasaanmu bergonta-ganti pasangan!

ds:127:268:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I mean, you’ve only been here a short time, and you’ve already been a tremendous help to all the critters around.
ds:127:268:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Maksudku, kamu baru sebentar di sini, tapi sudah sangat membantu semua penghuni sekitar.

ds:127:269:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But honestly, you’ve done a lot more than that.
ds:127:269:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tapi sejujurnya, yang kamu lakukan jauh lebih dari itu.

ds:127:271:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Scarlett and I were talking, and we’ve been more inspired than ever to sleep around again!
ds:127:271:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Scarlett dan aku tadi mengobrol, dan kami jadi lebih bersemangat dari sebelumnya untuk kembali main dengan banyak pasangan!

ds:127:272:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It’s been a hot minute since I’ve fooled around – and seeing you spark a fire in all these folks has me rearing to go!
ds:127:272:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Sudah agak lama aku tidak main-main. Melihatmu mengobarkan gairah mereka semua membuatku ingin segera ikut!

ds:127:274:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Absolutely! I know we’re not alone in the thought either.
ds:127:274:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tentu saja! Aku tahu bukan cuma kami yang berpikir begitu.

ds:127:275:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’ve heard a few critters have already been hooking up!
ds:127:275:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kudengar beberapa penghuni sudah mulai saling bercinta!

ds:127:279:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Actually, Bucky and I were just arranging some plans!
ds:127:279:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Sebenarnya, Bucky dan aku baru saja menyusun rencana!

ds:127:282:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Maverick was looking for you. Be sure to drop by his shop!
ds:127:282:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Maverick mencarimu. Jangan lupa mampir ke tokonya!

ds:127:286:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That’s right! Bucky and I were just arranging some plans!
ds:127:286:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Betul! Bucky dan aku baru saja menyusun rencana!

ds:127:288:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]See Peter’s quite adventurous! He really enjoys getting tied up, and blind folded, right?
ds:127:288:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Begini, Peter suka bereksperimen! Dia senang sekali diikat dan ditutup matanya, kan?

ds:127:289:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Perfect opportunity to do a little switch-a-Roo!

ds:127:291:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I can’t wait! He’s gonna be so surprised once he feels my paws instead of hers!
ds:127:291:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Aku tidak sabar! Dia bakal kaget saat merasakan telapakku, bukan telapak Scarlett!

ds:127:292:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Peter is such a cute submissive critter, I’m excited to get to fool around with him again!
ds:127:292:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Peter itu submisif dan manis sekali. Aku senang bisa bermain dengannya lagi!

ds:127:294:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]You two are super cute together that’s for sure!
ds:127:294:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Yang jelas, kalian berdua manis sekali kalau bersama!

ds:127:295:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Whew~! All this talk Is making me excited! I gotta calm down!
ds:127:295:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Huh~! Obrolan ini membuatku bergairah! Aku harus menenangkan diri!

ds:127:296:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anywho. All of this and so much more is thanks to you Rascal!
ds:127:296:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pokoknya, semua ini dan banyak hal lain terjadi berkat kamu, Rascal!

ds:127:299:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]You’ll probably be seein’ more critters visiting each other too!
ds:127:299:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Mungkin kamu juga akan lebih sering melihat para penghuni saling berkunjung!

ds:128:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ay Red! How can I help ya?

ds:128:167:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Picking up some Sugar? Sure thing, bud!

ds:128:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]OH SCARLETT HUH? Haha! Sure, right. “Sugar.” Yeah I’ll get ya some “Sugar!”
ds:128:170:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]OH, SCARLETT, YA? Haha! Tentu, benar. “Gula.” Iya, kuambilkan “Gula” buatmu!

ds:128:172:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]She didn’t tell ya? Haha, that lady’s never been out of sugar her entire life.
ds:128:172:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Dia tidak memberitahumu? Haha, perempuan itu seumur hidup tak pernah kehabisan gula.

ds:137:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]A quite surprising one, I might add!

ds:137:139:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Heh, Rascal was actually there when Scarlett and I were planning it.
ds:137:139:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Heh, Rascal sebenarnya ada saat Scarlett dan aku merencanakannya.

ds:137:154:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]How many rounds did we go, four?

ds:137:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hah, I just did two. You guys did four…
ds:137:156:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hah, aku cuma dua. Kalian yang empat…

ds:137:159:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]She’s back at the house cleaning up. She let us off the hook to get some beers!
ds:137:159:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Dia di rumah, bersih-bersih. Kami dibolehkan pergi untuk minum bir!

ds:137:162:Dialogue Text.source: I caught the tail end of it.

ds:137:167:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It all started just a bit ago.

ds:137:168:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Scarlett and I were testing out some of the gear you delivered us.
ds:137:168:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Scarlett dan aku sedang mencoba beberapa peralatan yang kamu antar.

ds:137:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]… I don’t think that was quite her words…

ds:137:180:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It sounded more like we were going to PICK UP beers…

ds:137:186:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Oh hello Rascal! Excuse me while I lose my cool on these two boys.
ds:137:186:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Oh, halo, Rascal! Permisi, aku mau meluapkan amarah kepada dua pria ini.

ds:137:187:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]She strapped me to this apparatus, and put blinders on me.
ds:137:187:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Dia mengikatku ke alat ini, lalu memasang penutup mata.

ds:137:188:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]See I like being at my wife’s mercy, so UH, I was already pretty excited.
ds:137:188:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Begini, aku suka menyerahkan diri sepenuhnya kepada istriku, jadi EH, aku sudah cukup bergairah.

ds:137:189:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]She started preppin’ my rear with her tongue, right?
ds:137:189:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Dia mulai menyiapkan pantatku dengan lidah, kan?

ds:137:190:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Slippin’ a few fingers in here ’n there - getting me ready.
ds:137:190:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Menyelipkan beberapa jari ke sana-sini, membuatku siap.

ds:137:191:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So I’m expecting either a toy or somethin, right?
ds:137:191:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Jadi kukira nanti akan ada mainan atau semacamnya, kan?

ds:137:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]What on EARTH ARE YOU DOING lounging about?!

ds:137:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh you thought you’d leave me to clean up that mess?
ds:137:203:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oh, kamu kira aku boleh ditinggal membersihkan kekacauan itu?

ds:137:204:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]There’s cum on the walls Peter, you know what happens if we let that sit.
ds:137:204:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ada peju di dinding, Peter, kamu tahu apa yang terjadi kalau dibiarkan.

ds:137:206:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Y-yes, love. I’ll go help clean it up.

ds:137:210:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh no you don’t. You’re not off the hook either! Half of the mess is all you!
ds:137:210:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oh, jangan harap. Kamu juga belum bebas! Setengah kekacauannya itu ulahmu!

ds:137:212:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ahh… see, I would but… these old bones, y’know? I gotta rest!
ds:137:212:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ahh… begini, aku mau, tapi… tulang-tulang tuaku ini, tahu, kan? Harus istirahat!

ds:137:214:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Nope. You clearly didn’t need a rest plowing my husband.
ds:137:214:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tidak. Jelas kamu tidak butuh istirahat waktu membajak suamiku.

ds:137:216:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Rascal, I hope you have a lovely afternoon. [pic=7]Take care, now!

ds:138:201:Dialogue Text.source: Then all of a sudden, THIS GUY wraps his paws around my entire torso!
ds:138:201:Dialogue Text.target: Lalu tiba-tiba, PRIA INI melingkarkan kedua tangannya mengelilingi seluruh tubuhku!

ds:138:203:Dialogue Text.source: Haha, ok that’s a bit of an exaggeration…

ds:138:205:Dialogue Text.source: He starts hot-doggin’ me, gettin’ me prepped for what’s to come!
ds:138:205:Dialogue Text.target: Dia mulai menggesekkan kontolnya di sela pantatku, menyiapkanku untuk yang akan datang!

ds:138:207:Dialogue Text.source: Naw hah, I was just trying to get it in…
ds:138:207:Dialogue Text.target: Tidak, hah, aku cuma berusaha memasukkannya…

ds:138:209:Dialogue Text.source: He slides in, and BAM! Balls deep. Down to the hilt.
ds:138:209:Dialogue Text.target: Dia masuk, lalu BAM! Sampai mentok. Hingga ke buah zakarnya.

ds:138:213:Dialogue Text.source: And he starts pumpin away! Gawd, am I feelin’ it!
ds:138:213:Dialogue Text.target: Lalu dia mulai mengentak! Astaga, terasa sekali!

ds:138:214:Dialogue Text.source: A good few minutes in, and I’m leakin’ pre-everywhere.
ds:138:214:Dialogue Text.target: Baru beberapa menit, cairan praejakulasiku sudah bocor ke mana-mana.

ds:138:216:Dialogue Text.source: Scarlett starts servicing me from the front!

ds:138:217:Dialogue Text.source: Now I’ve got cuties on either side of me!
ds:138:217:Dialogue Text.target: Sekarang ada dua yang manis di kedua sisiku!

ds:138:221:Dialogue Text.source: Now I won’t deny it, I can’t last very long in the sheets.
ds:138:221:Dialogue Text.target: Tidak akan kusangkal, di ranjang aku memang tidak tahan lama.

ds:138:223:Dialogue Text.source: I don’t think I lasted a minute.

ds:139:133:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hello dear, we were just talking about you!

ds:139:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Of course! We were talking about how things have gotten a whole lot naughtier since you’ve been here.
ds:139:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Tentu! Kami membicarakan bagaimana suasana jadi jauh lebih nakal sejak kamu di sini.

ds:139:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Indeed! Since telling you about my little story, I decided to get some more girl time with Scarlett.
ds:139:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Benar! Setelah menceritakan kisah kecilku padamu, kuputuskan untuk lebih sering berkumpul dengan Scarlett.

ds:139:142:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]All this talk makes me wanna go down on your cute bird rump, right here, right now.
ds:139:142:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Obrolan ini membuatku ingin menjilat pantat burungmu yang manis, di sini, sekarang juga.

ds:139:144:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]Scarlett! Gosh, not in front of Rascal!

ds:139:146:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hah! Let ‘em watch! Better yet, let him join!
ds:139:146:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hah! Biar dia menonton! Lebih bagus lagi kalau ikut!

ds:139:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh! I just thought of a good name for your… “side business.”
ds:139:152:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oh! Aku baru terpikir nama bagus untuk… “usaha sampinganmu.”

ds:139:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Instead of Penny Plume’s Ride and Zoom…

ds:139:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Y’know, we were also talking a bit about some stuff Penny wants to experiment with…
ds:139:165:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Tahu tidak, kami juga membicarakan beberapa hal yang ingin dicoba Penny…

ds:139:169:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Come on darling, you can hide me under those feathers, and I can do my work right here~ No one will suspect a thing!
ds:139:169:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ayolah, Sayang, sembunyikan aku di balik bulumu, nanti bisa kulakukan di sini~ Tidak akan ada yang curiga!

ds:139:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]That is… If you can contain yourself…

ds:139:172:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Scarlett, do I need to drop you in the river AGAIN?
ds:139:172:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Scarlett, apa perlu kujatuhkan kamu ke sungai LAGI?

ds:139:174:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Hah! Tidak, aku tidak apa-apa. Aku akan bersikap baik.

ds:139:175:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But I do hope you can explore that side of you if it’s something you want, though!
ds:139:175:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tapi aku sungguh berharap kamu bisa menjelajahi sisi itu kalau memang kamu mau!

ds:139:177:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]And a complete mockery of my business! How dare you!

ds:139:182:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]Penny Plume’s Ride and Spoon? Penny Plume’s Ride and Poon?
ds:139:182:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=11]Tumpang dan Dekap Sayang Penny Plume? Tumpang dan Memek Goyang Penny Plume?

ds:139:189:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Hehe, so you know how our wonderful Penny here is quite the service girl, right? Married to her work and being so useful…
ds:139:189:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Hehe, jadi kamu tahu Penny kita yang hebat ini suka melayani, kan? Menikah dengan pekerjaannya dan selalu berguna…

ds:139:190:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]She was just telling me how exciting it would be to offer a different service!
ds:139:190:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Dia baru saja bercerita betapa menggairahkannya menawarkan layanan yang berbeda!

ds:139:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Aw, what, should I really not continue?

ds:139:208:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Lagi pula, aku ingin melihatmu salah tingkah…

ds:139:210:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Gosh, you’ll be the death of me, girl.

ds:139:211:Dialogue Text.source:
You don’t have to share
if you don’t want to.
ds:139:211:Dialogue Text.target:
Kamu tidak harus cerita
kalau tidak mau.

ds:139:214:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Well, I had a dream once, and for some reason I can’t get it out of my head…
ds:139:214:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Yah, suatu kali aku bermimpi, dan entah kenapa tidak bisa kulupakan…

ds:139:216:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]I was tied up at my perch… Blind folded… gagged… My rear completely exposed…
ds:139:216:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]Aku diikat di tenggeranku… Mata ditutup… Mulut disumpal… Pantatku terbuka sepenuhnya…

ds:139:217:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]One by one, critters would have a go, leaving me a quivering mess!
ds:139:217:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]Satu demi satu mereka mendapat giliran, membuatku gemetar tidak karuan!

ds:139:220:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Baw I dunno… it probably sounds stupid…

ds:139:224:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Plus, I think it’s super cute since you’re such a service bird already! You truly just want to make your customers happy!
ds:139:224:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Lagi pula, menurutku manis sekali karena kamu memang burung yang suka melayani! Kamu cuma ingin membuat pelangganmu senang!

ds:139:228:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Honey, I’m all for it, I say we make it happen!
ds:139:228:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sayang, aku mendukung sekali. Ayo kita wujudkan!

ds:139:230:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ya ampun, tidak! Mana mungkin aku sanggup!

ds:13:19:Dialogue Text.source: Due to an unknown creature, the path to the north is closed.
ds:13:19:Dialogue Text.target: Karena ada makhluk tak dikenal, jalan ke utara ditutup.

ds:13:21:Dialogue Text.source: You see a sign, but it's too dark to read…
ds:13:21:Dialogue Text.target: Kamu melihat papan, tapi terlalu gelap untuk dibaca…

ds:140:133:Dialogue Text.source: *If the player has done Dustin’s Scene play this first.*
ds:140:133:Dialogue Text.target: *If the player has done Dustin’s Scene play this first.*

ds:140:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Hah! You’re asking that after plowing my rear?

ds:140:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well mate, it might surprise ya, but I usually prefer the ladies, especially romantically.
ds:140:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Yah, Kawan, mungkin mengejutkan, tapi biasanya aku lebih suka perempuan, terutama untuk hubungan romantis.

ds:140:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]That said, I do love messing with my rear, and I certainly won’t pass up a nicely sized critter such as yourself!
ds:140:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Meski begitu, aku suka bermain dengan pantatku, dan jelas tidak akan melewatkan seseorang dengan ukuran mantap sepertimu!

ds:140:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]So do let me know if you’d like to mess around!

ds:141:200:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Good to see ya back on your paws!
ds:141:200:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Senang melihatmu sudah bisa berdiri di atas telapakmu lagi!

ds:141:201:Dialogue Text.source: The beaver lets out a long yawn.
ds:141:201:Dialogue Text.target: Berang-berang pembuat bendungan itu menguap panjang.

ds:141:202:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Sorry - ya caught me in the middle of my afternoon nap!
ds:141:202:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Maaf, kamu datang pas aku sedang tidur siang!

ds:141:204:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But you can just call me Bucky!

ds:141:210:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]If there’s anything ya need during your stay, don’t hesitate to ask!
ds:141:210:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kalau ada yang kamu perlukan selama tinggal di sini, jangan sungkan meminta!

ds:141:211:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Until then… I kinda wanna get back to my nap…
ds:141:211:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sementara itu… rasanya aku ingin melanjutkan tidur siangku…

ds:141:212:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m sure I’ll be seeing ya again very soon!
ds:141:212:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Aku yakin kita akan segera bertemu lagi!

ds:141:215:Dialogue Text.source: He… seems to be quitely snoring… Wake him up?

ds:142:155:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3](Wow… Look at this guy. He’s even cuter when he’s conscious!)
ds:142:155:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3](Wah… lihat dia. Ternyata lebih imut lagi saat sadar!)

ds:142:157:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m Mabel! Your friendly little neighborhood mouse!

ds:142:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s a bit in shambles at the moment, but it’s home!
ds:142:161:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sekarang memang agak berantakan, tapi inilah rumah kami!

ds:142:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I think we’ll get along quite well…

ds:142:225:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Senang sekali kamu sudah bangun dan bisa beraktivitas!

ds:143:166:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]You look more like a Red to me, Mind if I call you Red?
ds:143:166:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Menurutku kamu lebih cocok dipanggil Merah. Boleh kupanggil Merah?

ds:143:169:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Nope! Don’t answer that, it’s already stuck!

ds:143:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I like you Red, I can tell we’re gonna be good buds!
ds:143:170:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Aku suka kamu, Merah. Kita pasti bakal jadi kawan akrab!

ds:143:174:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]By the way, didja’ pick up those treats I left ya?
ds:143:174:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oh, ya, sudah kamu ambil camilan yang kutinggalkan untukmu?

ds:143:175:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The chocolates! Chocolate covered coffee beans to be precise!

ds:143:176:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Aku tidak bisa hidup tanpa biji-biji kecil itu!

ds:143:177:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]They keep me goin’ when I’m slowin’ down, y’know?
ds:143:177:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Bikin aku tetap bertenaga saat mulai lesu, tahu?

ds:143:180:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I left them on the table with all the other food!
ds:143:180:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kutinggalkan di meja bersama semua makanan lainnya!

ds:143:181:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Go back to Scarlett’s House! You won’t regret it.
ds:143:181:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kembalilah ke rumah Scarlett! Kamu tidak akan menyesal.

ds:1443:436:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Maverick filled me in on what he’s been up to…
ds:1443:436:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Maverick sudah menjelaskan apa yang dia lakukan…

ds:1443:438:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Super crazy! I really wanna see it!

ds:1443:439:Dialogue Text.source:
Mabel was saying she’d like to
have you participate sometime.
ds:1443:439:Dialogue Text.target:
Mabel bilang dia ingin
kamu ikut kapan-kapan.

ds:1443:440:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Yeah… Maverick was telling me that too…

ds:1443:442:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Well I’m just a lil nervous… That’s a lot of new critters all at once…
ds:1443:442:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Yah, aku cuma agak gugup… Banyak sekali penghuni baru sekaligus…

ds:1443:443:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah but they’ll be thrilled to see you.
ds:1443:443:Dialogue Text.target: Iya, tapi mereka akan senang sekali bertemu kamu.

ds:1443:445:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Like… What if their little paws aren’t enough for me to get excited?
ds:1443:445:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Misalnya… Bagaimana kalau tangan kecil mereka tidak cukup membuatku bergairah?

ds:1443:446:Dialogue Text.source: Haha, then I can be there to fluff you up!
ds:1443:446:Dialogue Text.target: Haha, kalau begitu aku bisa di sana untuk membangkitkan gairahmu!

ds:1443:448:Dialogue Text.source: Sure! I’d go back in a heartbeat.
ds:1443:448:Dialogue Text.target: Tentu! Aku mau langsung kembali ke sana.

ds:1443:449:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ah, jadi kamu sudah pernah ke sana?

ds:1443:450:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah! I met a bunch of the critters there.
Quite the frisky bunch!
ds:1443:450:Dialogue Text.target:
Iya! Aku bertemu banyak penghuni di sana.
Sekumpulan yang nakal sekali!

ds:1443:452:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Ok, well… I do wanna check it out…

ds:1443:455:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ok, when do you think we should go…

ds:1443:458:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ah! Umm, yeah ok… let’s do it!

ds:1443:461:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Whew… For critters so small, they’ve got some serious stamina!
ds:1443:461:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Wuih… Untuk penghuni sekecil itu, stamina mereka luar biasa!

ds:1443:463:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That was fun though, thanks a lot for coming with me!
ds:1443:463:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tapi tadi seru, terima kasih banyak sudah ikut denganku!

ds:1443:465:Dialogue Text.source: Definitely! Just, uh, let me recover a bit.
ds:1443:465:Dialogue Text.target: Pasti! Cuma, eh, biarkan aku pulih dulu.

ds:1443:466:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Haha, yeah of course. I’m absolutely spent.
ds:1443:466:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Haha, ya tentu. Aku benar-benar kehabisan tenaga.

ds:1444:1000:Dialogue Text.source: I think we’re gonna have a lot of fun with this guy!
ds:1444:1000:Dialogue Text.target: Kurasa kita akan bersenang-senang sekali dengan pria ini!

ds:1444:1002:Dialogue Text.source: Alright everyone, let’s try something new…
ds:1444:1002:Dialogue Text.target: Baiklah semuanya, ayo coba sesuatu yang baru…

ds:1444:1003:Dialogue Text.source: *The night carries on as the critters experiment with Oliver…*
ds:1444:1003:Dialogue Text.target: *Malam berlanjut saat para penghuni bereksperimen dengan Oliver…*

ds:1444:1005:Dialogue Text.source: Alright, that’s gotta be his last load, let’s call it a night everyone.
ds:1444:1005:Dialogue Text.target: Baiklah, pasti itu semburan terakhirnya, cukup sampai di sini malam ini, semuanya.

ds:1444:1006:Dialogue Text.source: Whew, yeah sorry… I’m getting pretty exhausted…
ds:1444:1006:Dialogue Text.target: Wuih, ya maaf… Aku mulai cukup kelelahan…

ds:1444:1007:Dialogue Text.source: Ok ok… once Sable gets their tongue out of my ass… O-ooh~!
ds:1444:1007:Dialogue Text.target: Oke oke… setelah Sable mengeluarkan lidahnya dari pantatku… O-ooh~!

ds:1444:1009:Dialogue Text.source: H-hold on… Let me finish… Almost there~

ds:1444:1010:Dialogue Text.source: Dude you’ve cum like, 5 times already. Let’s go!
ds:1444:1010:Dialogue Text.target: Kawan, kamu sudah keluar kira-kira 5 kali. Ayo!

ds:1444:1012:Dialogue Text.source: I just really wanna see him blow again!
ds:1444:1012:Dialogue Text.target: Aku cuma ingin sekali melihatnya menyembur lagi!

ds:1444:1013:Dialogue Text.source: Are you sure we can’t go one more time?
ds:1444:1013:Dialogue Text.target: Yakin kita tidak boleh sekali lagi?

ds:1444:1015:Dialogue Text.source: I-it’s ok! I can probably go one more time…
ds:1444:1015:Dialogue Text.target: T-tidak apa-apa! Mungkin aku bisa sekali lagi…

ds:1444:919:Dialogue Text.source: I’m so glad you’re wanting to do this, Oliver!
ds:1444:919:Dialogue Text.target: Aku senang sekali kamu mau melakukannya, Oliver!

ds:1444:920:Dialogue Text.source: We’ve got a bunch of critters that are super excited to meet you!
ds:1444:920:Dialogue Text.target: Banyak penghuni yang sangat bersemangat ingin bertemu kamu!

ds:1444:921:Dialogue Text.source: Oh! I hope I don’t disappoint them…
ds:1444:921:Dialogue Text.target: Oh! Semoga aku tidak mengecewakan mereka…

ds:1444:923:Dialogue Text.source: The spa will get you in the mood, there’s just a vibe that’s hard to resist!
ds:1444:923:Dialogue Text.target: Spa ini akan membuatmu bergairah, suasananya sulit ditolak!

ds:1444:926:Dialogue Text.source: And stay here, I’ll get the critters ready.
ds:1444:926:Dialogue Text.target: Dan tunggu di sini, akan kusiapkan para penghuni.

ds:1444:929:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah, I’m just like… in my head…
ds:1444:929:Dialogue Text.target: Iya, aku cuma… terlalu banyak pikiran…

ds:1444:937:Dialogue Text.source: Oh, swirl your tongue like that again… Oooh~!

ds:1444:939:Dialogue Text.target: Heh, oke, sekarang mulai terasa… Kamu boleh mengeluarkannya dari mulutmu.

ds:1444:943:Dialogue Text.source: Oh!! Uh! Rascal’s helping me uh… get in the mood…
ds:1444:943:Dialogue Text.target: Oh!! Eh! Rascal membantuku, eh… membangkitkan gairah…

ds:1444:944:Dialogue Text.source: Hah! Well don’t blow your load before the show!

ds:1444:947:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah, I think he’s trying to see how much he can fit… This usually doesn’t work too well…
ds:1444:947:Dialogue Text.target: Iya, kurasa dia ingin tahu seberapa banyak yang bisa masuk… Biasanya ini tidak terlalu berhasil…

ds:1444:949:Dialogue Text.source: Gah! Hah… Damn, you’re still not fully hard!
ds:1444:949:Dialogue Text.target: Gah! Hah… Sial, kamu bahkan belum keras sepenuhnya!

ds:1444:951:Dialogue Text.source: Should I keep tugging on ya?

ds:1444:952:Dialogue Text.source: No no, I think we’re ready to go.
ds:1444:952:Dialogue Text.target: Tidak tidak, kurasa kita sudah siap.

ds:1444:953:Dialogue Text.source: Good, because as much as I don’t want this to stop, the other critters are waiting!
ds:1444:953:Dialogue Text.target: Bagus, karena meski aku tidak ingin ini berhenti, para penghuni lain menunggu!

ds:1444:954:Dialogue Text.source: Ok, let’s get this show on the road then!
ds:1444:954:Dialogue Text.target: Oke, kalau begitu ayo mulai pertunjukannya!

ds:1444:957:Dialogue Text.source: *The bushes part and the woodland critters gasp in awe.*

ds:1444:958:Dialogue Text.source: *Oliver stands there awkwardly waiting for someone to break the silence.*

ds:1444:962:Dialogue Text.source: *The chorus of oohs and aahs turn into cheers of excitement!*

ds:1444:963:Dialogue Text.source: *The critters take turns climbing and sniffing about. A few critters hop on his head.*

ds:1444:965:Dialogue Text.source: *The chatter of hundreds of little curious critters echo through the forest.*

ds:1444:966:Dialogue Text.source: *Oliver turns slightly pink from the attention, but he seems to enjoy it judging by his erection.*

ds:1444:967:Dialogue Text.source: Ok ok, give the guy some space!

ds:1444:968:Dialogue Text.source: Let’s get the volunteers up here, and the rest of you can watch!
ds:1444:968:Dialogue Text.target: Para sukarelawan kemari, yang lain boleh menonton!

ds:1444:972:Dialogue Text.source: I was thinking we could get some of these critters a front row view to Oliver’s junk!
ds:1444:972:Dialogue Text.target: Kupikir kita bisa memberi beberapa penghuni ini kesempatan melihat bagian intim Oliver dari barisan terdepan!

ds:1444:974:Dialogue Text.source: Great! Yeah grab it, and aim it toward these guys.
ds:1444:974:Dialogue Text.target: Bagus! Ya, pegang, lalu arahkan ke mereka ini.

ds:1444:975:Dialogue Text.source: You doin’ ok up there big guy?
ds:1444:975:Dialogue Text.target: Kamu baik-baik saja di atas sana, pria besar?

ds:1444:976:Dialogue Text.source: Y-yeah… There’s some ladies flashing me over there…
ds:1444:976:Dialogue Text.target: I-iya… Ada beberapa wanita di sana yang memamerkan tubuh kepadaku…

ds:1444:981:Dialogue Text.source: The head is as big as I am! And you’re saying it flares up?
ds:1444:981:Dialogue Text.target: Kepalanya sebesar tubuhku! Dan katamu ini bisa melebar?

ds:1444:982:Dialogue Text.source: Take in that smell! It’s intoxicating!

ds:1444:990:Dialogue Text.target: Panasnya terasa memancar dari benda ini!

ds:1444:994:Dialogue Text.source: N-no… Equines have a lot of pre…
ds:1444:994:Dialogue Text.target: B-belum… Keluarga kuda punya banyak cairan praejakulasi…

ds:1444:995:Dialogue Text.source: Makes sense, gotta lube this thing up!
ds:1444:995:Dialogue Text.target: Masuk akal, benda ini perlu dilumasi!

ds:1444:996:Dialogue Text.source: Sorry folks, I’ll watch where I’m aiming this thing…
ds:1444:996:Dialogue Text.target: Maaf, teman-teman, akan kuperhatikan arah bidikannya…

ds:1444:997:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah get it in her mouth next time!
ds:1444:997:Dialogue Text.target: Iya, lain kali arahkan ke mulutnya!

ds:144:162:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Haha, masuk akal, kawan kecil. Masuk akal.

ds:144:163:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Today marks my 5th year of changing my life.
ds:144:163:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hari ini genap tahun ke-5 sejak aku mulai mengubah hidupku.

ds:144:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So this is a commemorative piece! Ya feel me?

ds:144:166:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Haha, that’s half the beauty of it, bud!

ds:144:167:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kadang memang TIDAK ADA yang perlu dipahami!

ds:144:168:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m always painting something, so be sure to stop by soon!
ds:144:168:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Aku selalu melukis sesuatu, jadi mampir lagi sebentar lagi, ya!

ds:144:169:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I can show you more of my work!

ds:144:172:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]You’re just in time to see my newest piece!
ds:144:172:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kamu datang tepat waktu untuk melihat karya terbaruku!

ds:144:174:Dialogue Text.source: *Camera moves over to the art piece for a few seconds, then returns to the two talking*
ds:144:174:Dialogue Text.target: *Camera moves over to the art piece for a few seconds, then returns to the two talking*

ds:144:175:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Mmmhm. She’s a beaut. This one’s called, Epiphany.
ds:144:175:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mmmhm. Indah, ya. Yang ini berjudul Pencerahan.

ds:144:177:Dialogue Text.source: Ram - Finley Clovenhoof Clefthoof (Finley the Fluffy? Self proclaimed chill name?)
ds:144:177:Dialogue Text.target: Ram - Finley Clovenhoof Clefthoof (Finley the Fluffy? Self proclaimed chill name?)

ds:144:178:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ay! Lil’ guy! Welcome to my little slice of paradise~!
ds:144:178:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hei! Kawan kecil! Selamat datang di surga kecilku~!

ds:144:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The name is Finley, and whom do I have the pleasure of speaking to?
ds:144:179:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Namaku Finley. Dengan siapa aku mendapat kehormatan berbicara?

ds:145:196:Dialogue Text.source: *Maybe you can hear the bunny coming in, or something. A window opening*
ds:145:196:Dialogue Text.target: *Maybe you can hear the bunny coming in, or something. A window opening*

ds:145:198:Dialogue Text.source: She comes closer to the bed as Red stirs.
ds:145:198:Dialogue Text.target: She comes closer to the bed as Red stirs.

ds:145:201:Dialogue Text.source: Red begins to wake, he sits up on the bed.
ds:145:201:Dialogue Text.target: Red begins to wake, he sits up on the bed.

ds:145:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]You’ve been out for quite a while, dear.
ds:145:203:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Kamu sudah cukup lama tidak sadarkan diri, sayang.

ds:145:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Please take it easy and relax all you need.

ds:145:213:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Why, you’ve found yourself in our quaint little town.
ds:145:213:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Nah, kamu sudah sampai di kampung kecil kami yang nyaman.

ds:145:214:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The parts here are called The Forest of Love.

ds:145:215:Dialogue Text.source: Oh perfect! Exactly where I want to be!
ds:145:215:Dialogue Text.target: Oh, pas sekali! Tepat di tempat yang ingin kutuju!

ds:145:216:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh? You were searching for this place?

ds:145:218:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We’re a bit off the beaten path, but you’re here now!
ds:145:218:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tempat kami agak terpencil, tapi sekarang kamu sudah di sini!
