ds:280:200:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I can’t remember for the life of me!

ds:280:201:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It’s a real mess Red, not a good look at all. No sir.
ds:280:201:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kacau sekali, Merah, citraku jadi jelek. Benar-benar.

ds:280:202:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]To help me save a bit of face… Can you find out who it’s for?
ds:280:202:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Untuk sedikit menjaga nama baikku… Bisa cari tahu ini untuk siapa?

ds:280:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ask around, I’m sure someone will be able to help!
ds:280:203:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Coba tanya-tanya, pasti ada yang bisa membantu!

ds:280:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Excellent! You’re really saving my butt here, man.

ds:280:209:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So there’s one last package that needs to be delivered…
ds:280:209:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Jadi masih ada satu paket terakhir yang harus diantar…

ds:280:284:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Get goin’ Red! Don’t make the customer wait!
ds:280:284:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ayo berangkat, Merah! Jangan buat pelanggan menunggu!

ds:281:224:Dialogue Text.source: Know anyone looking for a shovel?

ds:281:226:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But where did she run off to…

ds:282:133:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I know we haven’t known each other for too long…
ds:282:133:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Aku tahu kita belum lama saling kenal…

ds:282:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But you’ve been very nice to me, and helped set some things in motion.
ds:282:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tapi kamu sangat baik kepadaku, dan membantu memulai beberapa hal.

ds:282:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And uh… well… I appreciate it a lot. Thank you!
ds:282:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Dan, eh… yah… Aku sangat menghargainya. Terima kasih!

ds:282:139:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh and, it hasn’t been worn or anything!
ds:282:139:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oh, dan ini belum pernah dipakai atau apa!

ds:282:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I just kept it around as a good luck charm… Not that… it was particularly lucky or anything…
ds:282:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Cuma kusimpan sebagai jimat keberuntungan… Bukan berarti… ini benar-benar membawa keberuntungan atau apa…

ds:282:141:Dialogue Text.target: Terima kasih Oliver, akan kujaga baik-baik!

ds:283:228:Dialogue Text.source: Know anyone looking for a shovel?

ds:283:229:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hm! Yeah, actually, I think Scarlett was looking for one.
ds:283:229:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hm! Iya, sebenarnya, sepertinya Scarlett mencari sekop.

ds:284:232:Dialogue Text.source: Know anyone looking for a shovel?

ds:284:233:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Bawha! You betcha! It was Dustin for sure!

ds:284:234:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I was just giving him a ride a second ago! He’s at the lake.
ds:284:234:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Baru saja kuantar dia! Dia ada di danau.

ds:284:239:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Okay! Dustin should be around here somewhere. Maybe check on the south shore!
ds:284:239:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Oke! Dustin pasti di sekitar sini. Coba periksa tepi selatan!

ds:285:198:Dialogue Text.source: Know anyone looking for a shovel?

ds:285:200:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I don’t really know folks too much yet, so I’m probably not the one to ask…
ds:285:200:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Aku belum begitu mengenal yang lain, jadi mungkin bukan aku orang yang tepat untuk ditanya…

ds:286:202:Dialogue Text.source: Know anyone looking for a shovel?

ds:286:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh sure! Bucky has been looking for one for a while now.
ds:286:203:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oh, tentu! Bucky sudah cukup lama mencarinya.

ds:286:204:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]He’s just South of here. We just finished a cup of tea together.
ds:286:204:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Dia di sebelah selatan sini. Kami baru saja selesai minum teh bersama.

ds:287:206:Dialogue Text.source: Know anyone looking for a shovel?

ds:287:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]However, I could use a haircut… heh.

ds:288:211:Dialogue Text.source: Know anyone looking for a shovel?

ds:288:214:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oooooh yeah! That’s us! We need a shovel!
ds:288:214:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oooooh, iya! Kami orangnya! Kami butuh sekop!

ds:288:220:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Nope. Sorry Rascal, we can’t help you.
ds:288:220:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Tidak. Maaf, Rascal, kami tidak bisa membantu.

ds:289:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Wow! This sounds like a ton of work! Let me know if I can help!
ds:289:199:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Wah! Sepertinya banyak sekali pekerjaannya! Bilang kalau aku bisa membantu!

ds:289:201:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Quite ambitious! I’d be happy to lend a paw too!

ds:289:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Thanks mates! But putting it together is part of the training!
ds:289:203:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Terima kasih, Kawan-kawan! Tapi membangunnya juga bagian dari latihan!

ds:289:204:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Though perhaps havin’ ya clear out some trees wouldn’t be a bad idea…
ds:289:204:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Meski mungkin boleh juga kalau kalian bantu menyingkirkan beberapa pohon…

ds:289:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s curious we haven’t found more shovels…
ds:289:208:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Aneh juga kita belum menemukan lebih banyak sekop…

ds:289:211:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]I’ll let Peter know to keep an eye out next time he’s out.
ds:289:211:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Akan kubilang pada Peter untuk mencarinya saat dia pergi lagi.

ds:289:213:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]If I’m out training, I’ll be sure to keep an eye out too!
ds:289:213:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Kalau sedang berlatih di luar, aku juga pasti akan mencarinya!

ds:289:218:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I got the OK a bit ago from Scarlett here, but just got crackin’ on it.
ds:289:218:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Scarlett sudah mengizinkannya beberapa waktu lalu, tapi aku baru mulai mengerjakannya.

ds:289:222:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]And sorry if we put you on the spot!

ds:289:223:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ll be able to do extensive workout routines! With proper flat ground and no potential hazards to worry about!
ds:289:223:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Aku bisa menjalani latihan fisik yang lengkap! Dengan tanah yang benar-benar rata dan tanpa perlu mengkhawatirkan bahaya apa pun!

ds:289:224:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Could even run a course for ya guys, if ya’d like!
ds:289:224:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Bahkan bisa kubuatkan sesi latihan untuk kalian kalau mau!

ds:289:225:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Whattya say? Wanna sweat and lose some pounds?
ds:289:225:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Bagaimana? Mau berkeringat dan menurunkan berat badan?

ds:289:227:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I’ll be honest dear, I don’t think I could keep up!
ds:289:227:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Jujur saja, Sayang, rasanya aku tidak akan sanggup mengimbangi!

ds:289:230:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yeah, sorry sonny! I’m a bit past my prime for that sorta thing!
ds:289:230:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ya, maaf, Nak! Masa jayaku untuk hal semacam itu sudah agak lewat!

ds:289:235:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I should be able to make a few courses of varying intensities, so everyone can have a go!
ds:289:235:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Aku pasti bisa membuat beberapa latihan dengan tingkat intensitas berbeda, supaya semua bisa mencoba!

ds:289:236:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But that’s a bit away… First thing’s first! Gotta make it!
ds:289:236:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tapi itu masih nanti… Yang pertama dulu! Tempatnya harus dibangun!

ds:289:238:Dialogue Text.source: Oh right! I’ve got a Shovel!

ds:289:240:Dialogue Text.source: Yeaaah, I’m not sure if that’s my thing…
ds:289:240:Dialogue Text.target: Iyaaa, aku kurang yakin itu cocok buatku…

ds:289:241:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oy come on now, I bet ya’ve been rollin’ about all day, huh?
ds:289:241:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oi, ayolah, pasti seharian kamu berguling ke sana kemari, kan?

ds:289:242:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I can teach ya some more secrets if ya come train!
ds:289:242:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Bisa kuajari lebih banyak rahasia kalau kamu ikut latihan!

ds:289:244:Dialogue Text.source: Errr, but it’s a shop order. From Maverick.
ds:289:244:Dialogue Text.target: Errr, tapi ini pesanan dari toko. Dari Maverick.

ds:289:246:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Great! I ordered one a bit ago!

ds:289:255:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I needed one to tend to the garden. I was out here grabbing some herbs I’d like to grow at home.
ds:289:255:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Aku butuh untuk merawat kebun. Tadi aku ke sini mengambil beberapa herba yang ingin kutanam di rumah.

ds:289:256:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Lots of general spices that’s handy for all of the critters…
ds:289:256:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Berbagai bumbu umum yang berguna bagi semua penghuni…

ds:289:258:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]And I’ve got a new project underway…

ds:289:259:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I need to dig up a bunch of clay, and I’m basically stuck until I get a shovel…
ds:289:259:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Aku perlu menggali banyak tanah liat, dan praktis tidak bisa melanjutkan sebelum dapat sekop…

ds:289:261:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And I need it for the training grounds…

ds:289:265:Dialogue Text.source: I think Scarlett should have it.

ds:289:268:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I’ll be as quick as I can! Then I can pass it along!
ds:289:268:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Akan kupakai secepat mungkin! Lalu bisa kuserahkan ke yang lain!

ds:289:270:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Sounds good, I can help with the garden if ya’d like!
ds:289:270:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Boleh juga, kalau mau aku bisa bantu mengurus kebun!

ds:289:271:Dialogue Text.source: I think Bucky should have it.

ds:289:273:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ya sure? I don’t mean to step on any toes…

ds:289:275:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Nonsense! Where would be without your help!
ds:289:275:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ah, jangan begitu! Apa jadinya kami tanpa bantuanmu!

ds:289:276:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]You can do what you need to, then pass it along.
ds:289:276:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Kerjakan dulu keperluanmu, lalu serahkan ke yang lain.

ds:289:277:Dialogue Text.source: I think Dustin should have it.

ds:289:279:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Yeah? I’ll be quick with it! Then I can pass it along!
ds:289:279:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ya? Akan kupakai sebentar saja! Lalu bisa kuserahkan ke yang lain!

ds:289:282:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m quite excited to see your project come along.

ds:289:285:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Hmmm, well, there’s not too much of a rush on my end.

ds:289:286:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The season just started after all, plenty of time for things to grow!
ds:289:286:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Lagi pula musimnya baru mulai, masih banyak waktu untuk tumbuh!

ds:289:288:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And, I wouldn’t mind a good excuse to take a break!
ds:289:288:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Dan aku tidak keberatan punya alasan bagus untuk beristirahat!

ds:289:290:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Works for me! I could use a breather after hulling all this junk!
ds:289:290:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Aku setuju! Aku butuh istirahat setelah mengangkut semua barang ini!

ds:289:292:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Works for me! I could use a breather after hauling all this junk!
ds:289:292:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Aku setuju! Aku butuh istirahat setelah mengangkut semua barang ini!

ds:289:294:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m excited to see it too! Always happy to see more craftsman critters!
ds:289:294:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Aku juga tidak sabar melihatnya! Selalu senang melihat lebih banyak perajin di sini!

ds:289:295:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Let me know if you need any help!

ds:289:296:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]My back is a bit sore after fixing up that bridge…
ds:289:296:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Punggungku agak pegal setelah memperbaiki jembatan itu…

ds:289:301:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Appreciate it mates! There’s heaps to do, so this’ll will help a lot!
ds:289:301:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Terima kasih, Kawan-kawan! Banyak yang harus dikerjakan, jadi ini sangat membantu!

ds:289:302:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]After I’m done, I’ll pass it along!
ds:289:302:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Setelah selesai, akan kuserahkan ke yang lain!

ds:28:20:Dialogue Text.source: But at least it’s a nice day.

ds:290:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Did you figure out who the shovel was for?

ds:290:200:Dialogue Text.source: Sort of… a few critters needed it…
ds:290:200:Dialogue Text.target: Kurang lebih… ada beberapa yang membutuhkannya…

ds:290:201:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh no. I messed that up big time.

ds:290:202:Dialogue Text.source: But it’s ok! We figured it out.
ds:290:202:Dialogue Text.target: Tapi tidak apa-apa! Sudah kami atasi.

ds:290:206:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Damn, you really saved my rump this time!
ds:290:206:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Sial, kali ini kamu benar-benar menyelamatkan pantatku!

ds:290:207:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]If the customer is happy, I’m happy!

ds:290:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And it’s all thanks to you, Red!

ds:290:209:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Now it’s time to show my thanks!

ds:290:210:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I’m a business man through and through, so your time will be compensated, absolutely.
ds:290:210:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Aku ini pebisnis sejati, jadi waktumu pasti akan kubayar, tentu saja.

ds:290:211:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Given how long this took you, how many tasks you completed, your expertise in the field…
ds:290:211:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mengingat waktu yang kamu habiskan, banyaknya tugas yang kamu selesaikan, keahlianmu di lapangan…

ds:290:214:Dialogue Text.source: Sounds a little low there, bud…

ds:290:216:Dialogue Text.source: RECEIVE 7 or 10 COINS (this doesn’t really matter)
ds:290:216:Dialogue Text.target: RECEIVE 7 or 10 COINS (this doesn’t really matter)

ds:290:217:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Now that that’s all taken care of, welcome to my shop!
ds:290:217:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Nah, setelah semuanya beres, selamat datang di tokoku!

ds:290:218:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Thanks to you, I’ve had the time to reorganize and set this baby up!
ds:290:218:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Berkat kamu, aku punya waktu untuk menata ulang dan menyiapkan tempat ini!

ds:290:219:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]And now that you have some cash, we can talk business!
ds:290:219:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Dan sekarang kamu punya uang, kita bisa berbisnis!

ds:290:220:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Let me know if anything catches your interest!

ds:290:221:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oh and, if you just want to hang out, I’ll be here!
ds:290:221:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Oh, kalau cuma mau nongkrong, aku ada di sini!

ds:290:222:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I may be running a business, but we’re still buds, Red!
ds:290:222:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Walau aku berbisnis, kita tetap berteman, Merah!

ds:290:224:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]What! Are you honestly hard balling me here, Red?

ds:290:225:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Well I suppose you did save my butt.

ds:291:197:Dialogue Text.source: WHEN PLAYER STARTS TO WALK AWAY, THE RAM WILL CALL OUT.
ds:291:197:Dialogue Text.target: WHEN PLAYER STARTS TO WALK AWAY, THE RAM WILL CALL OUT.

ds:291:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Gah, I can’t handle this. Just go for it.
ds:291:199:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Gah, aku tidak tahan lagi. Lakukan saja.

ds:291:200:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Try to stick with the top layers!

ds:292:274:Dialogue Text.source: Oh, this is quite a comfy ride!

ds:292:275:Dialogue Text.source: Hmm, are you sure I trimmed enough here?
ds:292:275:Dialogue Text.target: Hmm, yakin di sini sudah cukup kupangkas?

ds:292:278:Dialogue Text.source: More importantly, squeeze that bad boy in there.
ds:292:278:Dialogue Text.target: Yang lebih penting, desakkan barangmu itu ke dalam.

ds:292:283:Dialogue Text.source: Whew! I needed that, thanks lil buddy.
ds:292:283:Dialogue Text.target: Huh! Aku butuh itu. Terima kasih, Kawan Kecil.

ds:292:286:Dialogue Text.source: … Say, you sure I cut enough off?
ds:292:286:Dialogue Text.target: … Ngomong-ngomong, yakin sudah cukup yang kupotong?

ds:292:288:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah man, to be honest I don’t want you cutting much closer.
ds:292:288:Dialogue Text.target: Iya, Kawan, jujur saja aku tidak mau kamu memotong lebih dekat lagi.

ds:293:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]A lil, welcome gift and personal favorite of mine!
ds:293:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hadiah kecil sebagai ucapan selamat datang, dan salah satu benda favoritku!

ds:293:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]This lil’ baby has helped me get an eye for spotting out various interesting things!
ds:293:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Benda kecil ini membantuku jeli menemukan berbagai hal menarik!

ds:293:138:Dialogue Text.source: Wait, do you need this to see?
ds:293:138:Dialogue Text.target: Tunggu, kamu butuh ini untuk melihat?

ds:293:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]See I’ve got a fancy pair of specs now. I haven’t used that lil guy in years.
ds:293:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Sekarang aku punya kacamata bagus. Benda kecil itu sudah bertahun-tahun tidak kupakai.

ds:293:141:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But it served me well, so take care of it!
ds:293:141:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tapi dulu berguna sekali, jadi rawat baik-baik!

ds:294:157:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Ah, you’d like to hear more about Lanora, eh?
ds:294:157:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Ah, Anda ingin mendengar lebih banyak tentang Lanora, ya?

ds:294:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Fortunately, I do have another passage I can share!
ds:294:158:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Untungnya, ada satu bagian lagi yang bisa saya ceritakan!

ds:294:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]As previously discussed, there were many group-oriented events, involving critters of all shapes and sizes.
ds:294:160:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Seperti yang sudah dibahas, banyak acara berkelompok yang melibatkan makhluk dari segala bentuk dan ukuran.

ds:294:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]This passage reveals that there were also smaller, private events. Likely for the most devout? A right of passage, perhaps?
ds:294:161:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Bagian ini mengungkap bahwa ada juga acara kecil yang pribadi. Mungkin untuk yang paling taat? Barangkali suatu upacara peralihan?

ds:294:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anyways, from what I gather, Lanora would occasionally choose two disciples, often male.
ds:294:162:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pokoknya, dari yang saya pahami, sesekali Lanora memilih dua pengikut, biasanya laki-laki.

ds:294:163:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]They’d escort her across the forest, through the darkest of woods, all the way to the top of a mountain. There they would find a hidden cave.
ds:294:163:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mereka mengawalnya melintasi hutan, menembus bagian yang paling gelap, sampai ke puncak gunung. Di sana mereka menemukan gua tersembunyi.

ds:294:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Once in the cave, the disciples and Lanora would engage in a union of the body.
ds:294:164:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Di dalam gua, para pengikut itu dan Lanora menyatukan tubuh mereka.

ds:294:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]That is to say, they got… uh… Down and dirty…

ds:294:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]This particular scripture goes on and on.
ds:294:170:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Tulisan suci yang satu ini panjang sekali.

ds:294:171:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Like half of the glyphs are about how they switch sides, fill her holes, bathe her in their… *ahem* well, you know…
ds:294:171:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Hampir separuh glifnya membahas bagaimana mereka bertukar sisi, mengisi lubang-lubangnya, memandikannya dengan… *ehem* yah, Anda tahu…

ds:294:173:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Honestly, I can’t imagine what sort of worship this was…
ds:294:173:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Jujur, saya tidak bisa membayangkan pemujaan macam apa ini…

ds:294:174:Dialogue Text.source: Are you sure this was a form of worship?

ds:294:175:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well certainly! These inscriptions are rare, you see. Especially for their time.
ds:294:175:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tentu saja! Prasasti seperti ini langka, tahu. Apalagi pada masa itu.

ds:294:176:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Writing and record-keeping was a niche task. Only certain learned critters were scribes. So typically, only important events were written down.
ds:294:176:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Menulis dan mencatat itu pekerjaan khusus. Hanya makhluk terpelajar tertentu yang menjadi juru tulis. Jadi biasanya hanya peristiwa penting yang dicatat.

ds:294:178:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Still, quite a saucy ritual… I can’t quite connect the dots…
ds:294:178:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Meski begitu, ritual yang cukup panas… Saya belum bisa menghubungkan semuanya…

ds:294:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]… But this Forest was indeed full of “love” before.
ds:294:179:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]… Tapi dahulu hutan ini memang penuh “cinta”.

ds:294:180:Dialogue Text.source: What else do you know about the “Shrine Maiden”?
ds:294:180:Dialogue Text.target: Apa lagi yang kamu ketahui tentang “Gadis Kuil” itu?

ds:295:170:Dialogue Text.source: They shared Lanora, body and soul.
ds:295:170:Dialogue Text.target: Mereka berbagi Lanora, jiwa dan raga.

ds:295:171:Dialogue Text.source: One would take her from the front, and the other would take her from the back.
ds:295:171:Dialogue Text.target: Yang satu menggaulinya dari depan, dan yang lain dari belakang.

ds:295:172:Dialogue Text.source: Long into the night, the disciples would spend hours trying to sate Lanora.
ds:295:172:Dialogue Text.target: Hingga larut malam, para pengikut menghabiskan waktu berjam-jam berusaha memuaskan Lanora.

ds:295:173:Dialogue Text.source: It’s said her lust and scent invigorated the males. Tapping into their primal natures…
ds:295:173:Dialogue Text.target: Konon, nafsu dan aromanya membangkitkan gairah para pria. Menggugah naluri purba mereka…

ds:296:142:Dialogue Text.source: I just finished fooling around with some friends, right?
ds:296:142:Dialogue Text.target: Aku baru saja selesai main dengan beberapa teman, kan?

ds:296:143:Dialogue Text.source: We were cuddling together, catching our breath and enjoying the shade, y’know?
ds:296:143:Dialogue Text.target: Kami berpelukan, mengatur napas dan menikmati keteduhan, tahu?

ds:296:144:Dialogue Text.source: Well across from me, I spot her…

ds:296:145:Dialogue Text.source: She’s a bit shorter than you, super cute hat, rockin’ bod…
ds:296:145:Dialogue Text.target: Dia sedikit lebih pendek darimu, topinya manis sekali, tubuhnya aduhai…

ds:296:146:Dialogue Text.source: She was ridin’ this guy, giving me quite the show!
ds:296:146:Dialogue Text.target: Dia menunggangi seorang pria, memberi tontonan yang hebat!

ds:296:147:Dialogue Text.source: I thought it was just a coincidence, and then we locked eyes.
ds:296:147:Dialogue Text.target: Kukira cuma kebetulan, lalu mata kami bertemu.

ds:296:148:Dialogue Text.source: She lifted her tail to give me the full show! I was hard again in seconds!
ds:296:148:Dialogue Text.target: Dia mengangkat ekornya supaya aku bisa melihat semuanya! Dalam hitungan detik aku keras lagi!

ds:297:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]A partner? Naw, this is a pretty solo venture.

ds:297:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Why do you ask Red, you want in as a business partner?
ds:297:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Kenapa tanya, Merah, mau jadi mitra bisnis?

ds:297:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I might be able to cut you in… but we wouldn’t be look at anything more than 7 percent…
ds:297:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mungkin bisa kuberi bagian… tapi tidak lebih dari 7 persen…

ds:297:139:Dialogue Text.source:
No, I meant a
relationship partner.

ds:297:142:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Naw, I don’t really have time for that sorta thing…
ds:297:142:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Tidak, aku tidak begitu punya waktu untuk urusan itu…

ds:297:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]She was absolutely inviting me to join… but uh…

ds:297:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]For some reason… I couldn’t accept it…

ds:297:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I dunno Red… There was something different about her…
ds:297:156:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Entahlah, Merah… Ada yang berbeda pada dirinya…

ds:297:157:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I just got kinda scared that… maybe that was a path I wasn’t ready for…
ds:297:157:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Aku agak takut kalau… mungkin itu jalan yang belum siap kutempuh…

ds:297:159:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Well I just don’t have time for something serious, y’know?
ds:297:159:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Yah, aku tidak punya waktu untuk hubungan serius, tahu?

ds:297:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s a lot of work running a business.

ds:297:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]So it’s hard to imagine squeezing in a relationship…
ds:297:161:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Jadi sulit membayangkan masih sempat menjalin hubungan…

ds:297:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But, that’s not to say I don’t sleep around!
ds:297:162:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Tapi bukan berarti aku tidak berganti-ganti pasangan!

ds:297:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Heh, there’s a nice lil lagoon down the river.
ds:297:164:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Heh, ada laguna kecil yang bagus di hilir sungai.

ds:297:165:Dialogue Text.source:
Well maybe she didn’t want
anything serious.
ds:297:165:Dialogue Text.target:
Mungkin dia juga tidak ingin
hubungan serius.

ds:297:169:Dialogue Text.source:
You should!
She seems interested, and
it might be a fun opportunity.
ds:297:169:Dialogue Text.target:
Sebaiknya coba!
Sepertinya dia tertarik, dan
mungkin ini kesempatan yang seru.

ds:297:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It’s a common place to go for a quick hook up!
ds:297:170:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Tempat yang biasa didatangi untuk bercinta sebentar!

ds:297:171:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Red, I ain’t gonna sugar coat it, it’s basically a non-stop orgy.
ds:297:171:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Merah, terus terang saja, pada dasarnya itu pesta seks tanpa henti.

ds:297:173:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Yep! I used to spend a lot of time there! Buncha party animals!
ds:297:173:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Yap! Dulu aku sering sekali di sana! Isinya para penggila pesta!

ds:297:174:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Not quite my speed these days… but I meet up with some old friends and fool around here ’n there.
ds:297:174:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Sekarang kurang cocok dengan gayaku… tapi sesekali aku bertemu teman lama dan main di sana-sini.

ds:297:175:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I should really take ya down there sometime!

ds:297:177:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Y’know… There is this one girl at the lagoon…
ds:297:177:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Tahu tidak… Ada seorang perempuan di laguna itu…

ds:297:178:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hmm! Y’know after hearing it aloud, it seems so obvious.
ds:297:178:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hmm! Setelah mendengarnya diucapkan, rasanya jelas sekali.

ds:297:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I could always let her know what I’m looking for, I’m sure she’d understand!
ds:297:179:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Aku bisa bilang apa yang kuinginkan, pasti dia mengerti!

ds:297:182:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Part of me thinks I actually WANT to be serious with her…

ds:297:184:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m serious Red! This is kinda why I was avoiding it… I don’t wanna mess it up…
ds:297:184:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Aku serius, Merah! Itulah sebabnya agak kuhindari… Aku tidak mau mengacaukannya…

ds:297:185:Dialogue Text.source:
Mmm, I think you should talk to her.
You wouldn’t want to miss
this experience entirely, right?
ds:297:185:Dialogue Text.target:
Mmm, menurutku kamu harus bicara dengannya.
Kamu tidak ingin melewatkan
pengalaman ini sama sekali, kan?

ds:297:188:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Some flirty smiles and gestures here ’n there, but the last time I saw her…
ds:297:188:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sedikit senyum dan gerak-gerik menggoda, tapi terakhir kali kulihat dia…

ds:297:190:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m usually pretty surface level when fooling with the critters there.
ds:297:190:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Biasanya hubunganku dengan orang di sana tidak mendalam.

ds:297:195:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I think you’re right, Red! I’ll talk to her!
ds:297:195:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Kurasa kamu benar, Merah! Aku akan bicara dengannya!

ds:297:197:Dialogue Text.source:
And thank you
for the saucy story!
ds:297:197:Dialogue Text.target:
Dan terima kasih
atas cerita panasnya!

ds:297:198:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It’s a lil’ spicy though, so be prepared!

ds:298:288:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah I’ll say! Ya practically jumped on me!
ds:298:288:Dialogue Text.target: Iya, jelas sekali! Kamu hampir melompat menerkamku!

ds:298:289:Dialogue Text.source: Gus’ might be a gentle giant, but ohgosh, when all that weight is on top of you…
ds:298:289:Dialogue Text.target: Gus memang raksasa yang lembut, tapi astaga, saat seluruh berat tubuhnya menindihmu…

ds:298:291:Dialogue Text.source: H-hey… I know I’ve put on a few pounds…
ds:298:291:Dialogue Text.target: H-hei… Saya tahu berat saya naik sedikit…

ds:298:293:Dialogue Text.source: No no, I didn’t mean it that way!

ds:298:294:Dialogue Text.source: You’re just a lot bigger than me, and uh, heh… It’s super hot.
ds:298:294:Dialogue Text.target: Tubuhmu memang jauh lebih besar dariku, dan eh, heh… Itu menggairahkan sekali.

ds:298:317:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh I see. Well, I’m glad you enjoyed it!
ds:298:317:Dialogue Text.target: Oooh, begitu. Yah, saya senang Anda menikmatinya!

ds:298:318:Dialogue Text.source: I uh… really enjoyed it too…

ds:298:320:Dialogue Text.source: I’d say! I’ve never seen you cum so much…
ds:298:320:Dialogue Text.target: Jelas! Belum pernah kulihat kamu mengeluarkan peju sebanyak itu…

ds:298:333:Dialogue Text.source: Heh, well you see, I too prepped for our meet…
ds:298:333:Dialogue Text.target: Heh, begini, saya juga bersiap untuk pertemuan kita…

ds:298:334:Dialogue Text.target: Seharian saya merangsang diri sampai hampir orgasme, lalu menahannya!

ds:298:337:Dialogue Text.source: You’re getting better at that, aren’t you?

ds:298:351:Dialogue Text.source: All the better for what happened next…
ds:298:351:Dialogue Text.target: Makin bagus untuk yang terjadi berikutnya…

ds:298:355:Dialogue Text.source: See Rascal, once Gus has his fun, he insists on cleaning his own mess!
ds:298:355:Dialogue Text.target: Begini, Rascal, setelah Gus puas, dia bersikeras membersihkan kekacauannya sendiri!

ds:298:372:Dialogue Text.source: Heh, I mean… I couldn’t leave you like that…
ds:298:372:Dialogue Text.target: Heh, maksud saya… Tidak mungkin saya meninggalkan Anda begitu…

ds:298:375:Dialogue Text.source: Gosh, and that tongue gets EVERYWHERE!
ds:298:375:Dialogue Text.target: Astaga, lidah itu menjangkau SEMUA BAGIAN!

ds:298:390:Dialogue Text.source: And uh… I swear you were suckin’ on my paws a bit…
ds:298:390:Dialogue Text.target: Dan eh… Aku yakin tadi kamu mengisap telapakku sebentar…

ds:298:391:Dialogue Text.source: Is that a new thing for you?

ds:298:393:Dialogue Text.source: What can I say? I missed those lil’ beans…
ds:298:393:Dialogue Text.target: Mau bilang apa? Saya rindu bantalan kecil itu…

ds:299:377:Dialogue Text.source:
Evening gentlemen!
Out for another round?
ds:299:377:Dialogue Text.target:
Selamat malam, Tuan-tuan!
Keluar untuk minum lagi?

ds:299:381:Dialogue Text.source: Post Coital drinking? Is that a thing?
ds:299:381:Dialogue Text.target: Minum sesudah bercinta? Memang ada kebiasaan begitu?

ds:299:394:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ahh, I had a really good time!

ds:299:398:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I feel like we should be thanking you Rascal…
ds:299:398:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Rasanya kami perlu berterima kasih kepada Anda, Rascal…

ds:299:402:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Imagine just pickin’ up and moving… I don’t think I could do it!
ds:299:402:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Bayangkan, langsung berkemas dan pindah… Rasanya aku tidak sanggup!

ds:299:404:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]My path was pretty similar… Though I was fueled by the research first and foremost.
ds:299:404:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Jalan saya cukup mirip… Meski pendorong utama saya adalah penelitian.

ds:299:405:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I also intended on returning to my home at somepoint…
ds:299:405:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Saya juga berniat pulang ke tempat asal suatu saat nanti…

ds:299:406:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]But the company won me over, heh!
ds:299:406:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Tapi teman-teman di sini meluluhkan hati saya, heh!

ds:299:408:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]It’s a past time for us, that’s for sure!

ds:299:409:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Though I didn’t have anything at my place…
ds:299:409:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Tapi di rumah saya sedang tidak ada minuman…

ds:299:418:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I’m sure Bucky and I would’ve come together at some point again…
ds:299:418:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Saya yakin suatu saat Bucky dan saya pasti akan akur lagi…

ds:299:419:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But we feel like you really helped push things along…

ds:299:421:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yeah! Your involvement kinda… I dunno. It’s helped us smooth things over a lot.
ds:299:421:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Iya! Keterlibatanmu itu… entahlah. Banyak membantu kami membereskan masalah.

ds:299:422:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]And we were lucky enough to catch you again!

ds:299:424:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Do you wanna hear about the naughty stuff we were just up to?
ds:299:424:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mau dengar hal-hal nakal yang baru saja kami lakukan?

ds:299:437:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And do know we hope you’ll consider this place home one day. If you don’t already…
ds:299:437:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Dan ketahuilah, kami berharap suatu hari Anda menganggap tempat ini rumah. Kalau belum…

ds:299:441:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Rascal, have you ever seen alligator bits?

ds:299:444:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]They are quite unique! Really thick at the tip! So you gotta be ready for it.
ds:299:444:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Unik sekali! Ujungnya tebal sekali! Jadi kamu harus siap.

ds:299:445:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Remember Gus? You used to have to warm me up for hours before it’d pop in!
ds:299:445:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ingat, Gus? Dulu kamu harus menyiapkan tubuhku berjam-jam sebelum bisa masuk!

ds:299:453:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I mean, no one really knows how long you were planning on sticking around…
ds:299:453:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Maksudku, tidak ada yang benar-benar tahu kamu berencana tinggal berapa lama…

ds:299:454:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But if it’s up to us, we’d say forever!

ds:299:458:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m honestly still surprised you can take it at all! You’re quite the impressive lil’ guy…
ds:299:458:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sejujurnya saya masih heran Anda sanggup menerimanya! Kecil-kecil, Anda luar biasa…

ds:299:463:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]We didn’t have to warm ya up too much this time…
ds:299:463:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kali ini kita tidak perlu terlalu lama melakukan pemanasan…

ds:299:465:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]That’s because I prepped ahead of time!

ds:299:476:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Wha? You uprooted, traveled abroad, with no plan?
ds:299:476:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Apa? Kamu meninggalkan tempat asal, pergi ke negeri lain, tanpa rencana?

ds:299:484:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Once I saw you were ready, I really couldn’t help myself…
ds:299:484:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Begitu melihat Anda siap, saya benar-benar tidak bisa menahan diri…

ds:29:21:Dialogue Text.source: Wow, you really walked out here…
ds:29:21:Dialogue Text.target: Wah, kamu benar-benar berjalan sampai sini…

ds:29:23:Dialogue Text.source: Maybe a nice relaxing spot to rub one out?
ds:29:23:Dialogue Text.target: Mungkin tempat santai yang bagus untuk mengocok?

ds:2:131:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Red! I’m blocking this area for a reason!
ds:2:131:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Merah! Aku menghalangi area ini karena ada alasannya!

ds:2:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Seriously, for your own safety, you can’t go that way.
ds:2:132:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Serius, demi keselamatanmu sendiri, kamu tidak boleh lewat sana.

ds:300:481:Dialogue Text.source: I couldn’t hold that thing in for long.
ds:300:481:Dialogue Text.target: Tidak sanggup aku menahan barang itu lama-lama di dalam.

ds:301:324:Dialogue Text.source: Sure! What are you three up to?

ds:301:334:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Next time we’ll be doing some Haiku.

ds:301:338:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]One that lets us tune into our surroundings, and be present in the moment.
ds:301:338:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Yang membuat kita selaras dengan sekitar dan hadir pada saat ini.

ds:301:351:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Nah man, it’s a nice change of pace.

ds:301:356:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I get the feeling you’re not used to chilling…

ds:301:360:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Chill with us again next time we’re here!
ds:301:360:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Santai lagi bersama kami kalau nanti kami di sini!

ds:302:498:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Nah, ini dia! Sang penyair yang sedang naik daun!

ds:302:499:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Give us a verse! Drop some lines!

ds:302:501:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Hehe, yeah, I’m pretty curious to hear what you came up with!
ds:302:501:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hehe, iya, aku penasaran sekali ingin mendengar hasil karyamu!

ds:302:508:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]PFFT! Wow ok! I had a feeling it would be something like that!
ds:302:508:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]PFFT! Wah, oke! Sudah kuduga bakal seperti itu!

ds:302:510:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yet it works pretty well! Certainly invokes some vivid imagery!
ds:302:510:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tapi hasilnya cukup bagus! Gambaran yang muncul jelas sekali!

ds:302:512:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Heh, it actually reminds me of a poem I wrote… It has similar themes…
ds:302:512:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Heh, itu malah mengingatkanku pada puisi yang kutulis… Temanya mirip…

ds:302:516:Dialogue Text.source:
[pic=4]Gushing from your rear
Fluids running down your legs
Watering the Earth
ds:302:516:Dialogue Text.target:
[pic=4]Pantatmu muncrat
Lelehan di kakimu
Menyiram bumi

ds:302:521:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ok, something tells me I know exactly what inspired this one!
ds:302:521:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oke, rasanya aku tahu persis apa yang mengilhaminya!

ds:302:523:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Heh… we should probably fill you in Rascal.
ds:302:523:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Heh… Rascal, sepertinya kami perlu menceritakan latarnya padamu.

ds:302:527:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well it was one of our earlier interactions together.
ds:302:527:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Jadi, ini terjadi saat kami baru beberapa kali bersama.

ds:302:528:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]By this time, we were already pretty friendly, and fooling around here and there.
ds:302:528:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Saat itu kami sudah cukup akrab, dan sesekali main-main mesra.

ds:302:529:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Claire reaaallly wanted to try to get my tip in…

ds:302:532:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I was wiggling around in all kinds of positions. Violet was coaxing and massaging me the whole time!
ds:302:532:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Aku meliuk-liuk mencoba segala macam posisi. Violet terus membujuk dan memijatku!

ds:302:534:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But she got it in! It was quite impressive, really.
ds:302:534:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tapi akhirnya dia berhasil memasukkannya! Cukup mengesankan, sungguh.

ds:302:536:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Heh, after all that teasing… I was really on edge!
ds:302:536:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Heh, setelah digoda selama itu… aku sudah di ambang keluar!

ds:302:542:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Right? We got a real silver tongue here.
ds:302:542:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Iya, kan? Ada yang benar-benar berlidah manis di sini.

ds:302:544:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Oh, I’m sure you’re really thinking about his tongue right now!
ds:302:544:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Oh, pasti sekarang kamu benar-benar memikirkan lidahnya!

ds:302:546:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Heh… Seems that tongue can do many great things…
ds:302:546:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Heh… Rupanya lidah itu bisa melakukan banyak hal hebat…

ds:302:548:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Anyways, that was a good poem Oliver.

ds:302:549:Dialogue Text.source: Who knew Haiku could be sexy!

ds:302:551:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yeah I think we need to focus on more sexy haiku.
ds:302:551:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Iya, kurasa kita harus lebih fokus pada haiku seksi.

ds:302:554:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah, since the first one was more about Claire, I wanted one for Violet too..
ds:302:554:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Iya, karena yang pertama lebih tentang Claire, aku juga ingin membuat satu untuk Violet..

ds:302:559:Dialogue Text.source:
[pic=4]Her tender lapping
Cleaning up the mess I made
I’m hard once again

ds:302:562:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Of course, I can just about hilt Olly these days!
ds:302:562:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tentu saja, sekarang aku hampir bisa memasukkan Olly sampai pangkalnya!

ds:302:569:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Um heh… I actually had a sequel to that last haiku…
ds:302:569:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Em, heh… Sebenarnya aku punya lanjutan haiku tadi…

ds:303:322:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]OK Rascal, you’re up! What do you got for us?
ds:303:322:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oke, Rascal, giliranmu! Apa yang kamu siapkan untuk kami?

ds:303:330:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I would change it to. "How lucky are we"

ds:303:334:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s very good Oliver, the feeling is quite mutual!
ds:303:334:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Bagus sekali, Oliver. Kami juga merasakan hal yang sama!

On a lazy afternoon
How lucky am I
ds:303:343:Dialogue Text.target:
[pic=4]Minum dan kawan

Mujurnya aku

ds:303:346:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oliver, would you like to go next? I can tell you came up with something.
ds:303:346:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oliver, mau giliran berikutnya? Aku tahu kamu sudah punya sesuatu.

ds:303:355:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I’m not gonna lie - that haiku was a lot lamer until you explained it.
ds:303:355:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Jujur, haikunya jauh lebih garing sebelum kamu jelaskan.

ds:303:357:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yeah, it may be a bit of a stretch, but that’s what I was thinking when writing.
ds:303:357:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Iya, mungkin agak mengada-ada, tapi itulah yang kupikirkan saat menulisnya.

ds:303:360:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]We’re learning from the best after all!

ds:303:362:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Right? This idea really echos with the idea of time as a whole.
ds:303:362:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Iya, kan? Gagasan ini benar-benar bergema dalam konsep waktu secara keseluruhan.

ds:303:363:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Though we see time as a day to day thing, thousands of years ago, or thousands of years from now - so many things change, yet so much remains the same.
ds:303:363:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Meski kita memandang waktu dari hari ke hari, ribuan tahun lalu, ataupun ribuan tahun mendatang—begitu banyak yang berubah, tetapi begitu banyak pula yang tetap sama.

ds:303:364:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]A journey without an end - yet time marches on, and flows like a river.
ds:303:364:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Perjalanan tanpa akhir—namun waktu terus berjalan, mengalir seperti sungai.

ds:303:365:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It’s interesting to consider though, if "time" is the "river," then we are the "water."
ds:303:365:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Tapi menarik juga untuk direnungkan: kalau "waktu" itu "sungai", maka kitalah "airnya".

ds:303:366:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And does the "water" come back in the form of "rain" and "snow"?
ds:303:366:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Lalu apakah "air" itu kembali dalam wujud "hujan" dan "salju"?

ds:303:369:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It’s not my greatest one. But I’ve captured a few concepts in this.
ds:303:369:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ini bukan karyaku yang terbaik. Tapi ada beberapa konsep yang kutangkap di dalamnya.

ds:303:370:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]See Rascal, a difficult part of traditional haiku is the split of two ideas.
ds:303:370:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Begini, Rascal, salah satu kesulitan haiku tradisional adalah pemisahan dua gagasan.

ds:303:371:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Two ideas that contrast each other, they vibrate against each other and change the context of each other.
ds:303:371:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Dua gagasan yang saling berlawanan, saling bergetar dan mengubah konteks satu sama lain.

ds:303:372:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The poem is meant to capture both, the phenomena of an instant of observing water, yet the realization that every droplet of water is new.
ds:303:372:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Puisi itu ingin menangkap keduanya: pengalaman sesaat mengamati air, sekaligus kesadaran bahwa setiap tetes airnya baru.

ds:303:373:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Each droplet that passes this place came from a glacier up above, and who knows, maybe it has made its way back here before.
ds:303:373:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Setiap tetes yang melewati tempat ini berasal dari gletser di atas sana, dan siapa tahu, mungkin pernah kembali ke sini sebelumnya.

ds:303:375:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh damn, that’s crazy. I’ve never considered the water flowing down this river is unique…
ds:303:375:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Wah, anjir, luar biasa. Tak pernah kupikirkan bahwa air yang mengalir di sungai ini selalu berbeda…

ds:303:376:Dialogue Text.source:
[pic=4]Marching Forever
A journey without an end
The flowing River
ds:303:376:Dialogue Text.target:
[pic=4]Terus melangkah
Perjalanan tak usai
Sungai mengalir

ds:303:383:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Most haiku reflect nature, a season, and one of the senses.
ds:303:383:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kebanyakan haiku mencerminkan alam, suatu musim, dan salah satu pancaindra.

ds:303:386:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But before I start. Rascal, do you remember last time when we were chilling?
ds:303:386:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Tapi sebelum mulai, Rascal, kamu ingat waktu kita bersantai bersama dulu?

ds:303:389:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]This was composed during that chill session. You’ll see what I mean.
ds:303:389:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ini kususun saat kita bersantai waktu itu. Nanti kamu paham maksudku.

ds:303:392:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]They’re most recognized by their 5-7-5 syllable structure.
ds:303:392:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ciri yang paling dikenal adalah pola suku katanya yang 5-7-5.

ds:303:393:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But structure is only one piece of the puzzle.
ds:303:393:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Tapi pola hanyalah satu bagian dari teka-tekinya.

ds:303:394:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]A Haiku is a moment, an experience, if you will.
ds:303:394:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Haiku itu sebuah momen, sebuah pengalaman, begitulah.

ds:303:396:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Today’s chill will also involve some creativity.
ds:303:396:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Acara santai hari ini juga akan melibatkan kreativitas.

ds:303:398:Dialogue Text.source: Remind me what that is, exactly?

ds:303:401:Dialogue Text.source: That’s right! I’m here to chill.

ds:303:402:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hey! Looks like you’ve made it to another chill session!
ds:303:402:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Hei! Rupanya kamu datang lagi untuk bersantai bersama!

ds:303:407:Dialogue Text.source: Take me high above the clouds

ds:303:430:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That was… actually pretty good. I’m impressed!
ds:303:430:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tadi itu… cukup bagus, sungguh. Aku terkesan!

ds:303:431:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I see you were inspired by Penny, she’d be happy to hear this!
ds:303:431:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Rupanya Penny yang mengilhamimu. Dia pasti senang mendengarnya!

ds:303:433:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Absolutely, she’s a sap for this poetry stuff!
ds:303:433:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Betul sekali, dia mudah tersentuh oleh puisi seperti ini!

ds:303:438:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That was… actually pretty good. I’m impressed!
ds:303:438:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tadi itu… cukup bagus, sungguh. Aku terkesan!

ds:303:439:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I dig the commentary! And good to see you’re an advocate of the chill life!
ds:303:439:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Aku suka komentarmu! Senang juga melihatmu mendukung hidup santai!

ds:303:441:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yo, wait, are WE the bugs?? Damn.

ds:303:449:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Heh, that’s what she says to most of mine…
ds:303:449:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Heh, itu yang dia katakan untuk sebagian besar puisiku…

ds:303:454:Dialogue Text.source: *This dialogue plays at the end of each ending.*
ds:303:454:Dialogue Text.target: *This dialogue plays at the end of each ending.*

ds:303:455:Dialogue Text.source:
Thanks guys!
Next chill session, I’ll have something better!
ds:303:455:Dialogue Text.target:
Terima kasih, semuanya!
Lain kali kita bersantai bersama, aku akan membawa yang lebih bagus!

ds:303:460:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That was… actually pretty good. I’m impressed!
ds:303:460:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tadi itu… cukup bagus, sungguh. Aku terkesan!

ds:303:461:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I see you were inspired by the bridge and your experiences in the forest. Very nice!
ds:303:461:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Rupanya jembatan dan pengalamanmu di hutan yang mengilhamimu. Bagus sekali!

ds:304:698:Dialogue Text.source: Mabel must have really been giving it to him.

ds:304:699:Dialogue Text.source: She can be quite resourceful with her body, y’know!
ds:304:699:Dialogue Text.target: Dia cukup pandai memanfaatkan tubuhnya, tahu!

ds:304:701:Dialogue Text.source: And golly, what a mess! Bucky was stunned there, just gushing load after load on her face.
ds:304:701:Dialogue Text.target: Dan astaga, berantakan sekali! Bucky tertegun di sana, terus menyemburkan peju ke wajahnya berkali-kali.

ds:305:268:Dialogue Text.source: You two look like you know how to party!
ds:305:268:Dialogue Text.target: Kalian berdua sepertinya tahu cara berpesta!

ds:305:272:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Clearly Rascal can tell a couple of party animals when he sees em!
ds:305:272:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Jelas Rascal bisa mengenali para penggila pesta sekali lihat!

ds:305:273:Dialogue Text.source: Actually no, I was just trying to be cool.
ds:305:273:Dialogue Text.target: Sebenarnya tidak, aku cuma mencoba terlihat keren.

ds:305:278:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah I’m not really one to party much.
ds:305:278:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Iya, sebenarnya aku tidak terlalu sering berpesta.

ds:305:280:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m good with critters, but the party crowd isn’t quite my thing.
ds:305:280:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Aku bisa bergaul, tapi keramaian pesta kurang cocok buatku.

ds:305:291:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]God, I had to wash our clothes like, five times to get all that out!
ds:305:291:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Astaga, aku harus mencuci pakaian kita sekitar lima kali sampai semuanya hilang!

ds:305:293:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Yeah next bukkake, remind me to remove my clothes.
ds:305:293:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Iya, bukkake berikutnya, ingatkan aku melepas pakaian.

ds:305:294:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey Rascal, you ever partaken in one of those?
ds:305:294:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hei, Rascal, pernah ikut yang seperti itu?

ds:305:297:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Heh, next time we’re in one we’ll be sure to call ya.
ds:305:297:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Heh, lain kali kami ikut, pasti kamu kami panggil.

ds:305:298:Dialogue Text.source:
Actually, I wouldn’t mind
being in the middle of one!
ds:305:298:Dialogue Text.target:
Sebenarnya aku tidak keberatan
berada di tengah-tengahnya!

ds:305:300:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh yeah? Ya wanna be covered by a buncha guys spunk?
ds:305:300:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oh, ya? Mau dilumuri peju banyak pria?

ds:305:301:Dialogue Text.target: Heh, apa pun akan kucoba sekali…

ds:305:304:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The view from below is great, lemme tell ya~!
ds:305:304:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pemandangan dari bawah bagus sekali, percaya deh~!

ds:305:306:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We could even clean you off afterward…

ds:305:309:Dialogue Text.source:
Actually, I was thinking
we could round up some ladies…
ds:305:309:Dialogue Text.target:
Sebenarnya kupikir
kita bisa mengumpulkan beberapa perempuan…

ds:305:312:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]A buncha ladies going to town on themselves with a dude in the middle?
ds:305:312:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Banyak perempuan memuaskan diri habis-habisan, dengan pria di tengah?

ds:305:315:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We’ll need to find a buncha squirters though…
ds:305:315:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tapi kita harus mencari banyak yang bisa muncrat…

ds:305:323:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But sex parties? That’s a different story.

ds:305:326:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]There’s some pretty active critters about a day’s hike from here.
ds:305:326:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ada sejumlah makhluk yang cukup aktif, sekitar sehari perjalanan kaki dari sini.

ds:305:327:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The parties always delve into some sorta sex thing.

ds:305:328:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]They’ve been known to be pretty crazy!

ds:305:329:Dialogue Text.source:
Oh? What’s the craziest thing
you two have done?
ds:305:329:Dialogue Text.target:
Oh? Apa hal tergila
yang pernah kalian lakukan?

ds:305:331:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hmm, well there was that oooooone tiiiiiiiime.

ds:305:334:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]This is her favorite story, and I swear it didn’t even happen!
ds:305:334:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ini cerita favoritnya, dan aku yakin itu bahkan tidak pernah terjadi!

ds:305:336:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah, that’s because you were WAAAAY too drunk!
ds:305:336:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Iya, karena kamu waktu itu TERLALUUU mabuk!

ds:305:341:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So as you know, Claire can be quite competitive…
ds:305:341:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Jadi, seperti yang kamu tahu, Claire cukup suka bersaing…

ds:305:342:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Buuut let it be known, that Claire is a bit of a light weight when it comes to alcohol.
ds:305:342:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Taaapi perlu diketahui, Claire itu agak lemah terhadap alkohol.

ds:305:347:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Anyways, one thing led to another. And, go figure, Claire gets reaaaaaally horny when she’s drunk!
ds:305:347:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pokoknya, satu hal membawa ke hal lain. Dan, coba tebak, Claire jadi bergairaaah sekali kalau mabuk!

ds:305:349:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ok that’s not true! I am the same amount of horny, regardless of alcohol.
ds:305:349:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oke, itu tidak benar! Gairahku sama saja, ada alkohol atau tidak.

ds:305:353:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ok, so one thing lead to another - and I kiiiinda egged on a competition of who could get the most guys off.
ds:305:353:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oke, jadi satu hal membawa ke hal lain, dan aku agak memancing lomba siapa yang bisa membuat paling banyak pria keluar.

ds:305:354:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]The night started off with us finding guys seperately, but I guess word got around…
ds:305:354:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Awal malam kami mencari pria sendiri-sendiri, tapi sepertinya kabarnya menyebar…

ds:306:291:Dialogue Text.source: Soon enough we found ourselves in the middle of a bukkake!
ds:306:291:Dialogue Text.target: Tidak lama kemudian kami sudah berada di tengah bukkake!

ds:306:292:Dialogue Text.source: Been a while since we’ve gotten into that position.
ds:306:292:Dialogue Text.target: Sudah lama kami tidak berada dalam posisi itu.

ds:306:293:Dialogue Text.source: Claire, you shoulda saw the look on your face. You were in heaven.
ds:306:293:Dialogue Text.target: Claire, andai kamu melihat ekspresimu sendiri. Kamu seperti di surga.

ds:307:497:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey. man! Good to see you here!

ds:307:499:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey! If it isn’t our stand-in barber!
ds:307:499:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hei! Ini dia tukang cukur pengganti kita!

ds:307:501:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We heard you treated Finley quite well.
ds:307:501:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kami dengar kamu menangani Finley dengan baik.

ds:307:502:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]We might have you as an apprentice!
ds:307:502:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mungkin kamu bisa jadi murid magang kami!

ds:307:505:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Y’know, Rascal also gave me a special treatment afterward…
ds:307:505:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tahu tidak, sesudahnya Rascal juga memberiku perawatan khusus…

ds:307:511:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yeah, apparently Rascal here appreciated my assets, and wanted to have a go back there.
ds:307:511:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Iya, rupanya Rascal menyukai asetku dan ingin mencoba dari belakang.

ds:307:516:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Haha ok ok, my ego can only get so inflated!
ds:307:516:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Haha, oke, oke, nanti egoku terlalu menggelembung!

ds:307:517:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Anywho, he hopped on back and showed me what Red Pandas can do!
ds:307:517:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pokoknya, dia naik ke belakang dan menunjukkan kemampuan panda merah!

ds:307:518:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I had no idea they had knots!
ds:307:518:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Aku tidak tahu mereka punya simpul genital!

ds:307:520:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Yeah… I’m not sure that they do…
ds:307:520:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Iya… Aku juga tidak yakin mereka punya…

ds:307:525:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]He’s kinda big for his size huh? Don’t suppose it caused ya too much trouble though Finley?
ds:307:525:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Barangnya agak besar untuk tubuh sekecil itu, ya? Tapi tidak terlalu menyusahkanmu, kan, Finley?

ds:307:527:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well I haven’t been practicing much these days - and there was no time for warming up.
ds:307:527:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Yah, belakangan ini aku jarang berlatih, dan tidak sempat pemanasan.

ds:307:530:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I see! Sounds like we gotta toy around with you more often then.
ds:307:530:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Begitu! Berarti kami harus lebih sering bermain-main denganmu dan mainan kami.

ds:307:535:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yeah, occasionally Finley’ll let us pin him down and stuff some toys up there!
ds:307:535:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Iya, sesekali Finley mengizinkan kami menahannya dan memasukkan mainan ke sana!

ds:307:538:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yeah, when was the last time we even fooled around?

ds:307:540:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Mmm. It was when we were gonna paint together.

ds:307:541:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I had to run an errand so I was a bit late.
ds:307:541:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Aku harus mengurus sesuatu, jadi agak terlambat.

ds:307:542:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]When I got there, I saw Claire’s got her muzzle more than half way down your shaft.
ds:307:542:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Saat sampai, kulihat moncong Claire sudah menelan lebih dari separuh batangmu.

ds:307:544:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]OOOH right! Dang, that was some time ago!
ds:307:544:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]OOOH, benar! Astaga, itu sudah cukup lama!

ds:307:545:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I keep telling Finley, I’m gonna deep throat him one day.
ds:307:545:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Aku selalu bilang pada Finley, suatu hari barangnya akan kutelan sampai tenggorokan.

ds:307:546:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So I’ll give it a shot every so often. He’s a good sport for being so willing.
ds:307:546:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Jadi sesekali kucoba. Baik sekali dia mau terus meladeninya.

ds:307:548:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Who am I, to shatter the dreams of an ambitious lady.
ds:307:548:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Siapalah aku sampai mau menghancurkan impian perempuan ambisius.

ds:307:550:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Gosh, I still remember that pull out. That was QUITE the load Finley.
ds:307:550:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Astaga, aku masih ingat saat dicabut. BANYAK SEKALI yang keluar, Finley.

ds:307:552:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yeah that was my fault. We were at it for a WHILE and I didn’t want him getting soft on me.
ds:307:552:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Iya, itu salahku. Kami melakukannya LAMA SEKALI dan aku tidak mau barangnya melembek.

ds:307:553:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Honestly props to him for lasting so long.
ds:307:553:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Jujur, salut dia bisa bertahan selama itu.

ds:307:557:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Y’know the rest of that night was pretty hot too…
ds:307:557:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tahu tidak, sisa malam itu juga cukup panas…

ds:307:568:Dialogue Text.source: Wait, but I didn’t hear anything about toys.
ds:307:568:Dialogue Text.target: Tunggu, tapi aku tidak dengar apa-apa soal mainan.

ds:307:571:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Like I said, we’re overdue for a session!

ds:307:572:Dialogue Text.source: Hit me up when that happens!

ds:308:566:Dialogue Text.source: Gotta say, there’s nothin’ quite like making out with Claire after she’s got a fresh load!
ds:308:566:Dialogue Text.target: Harus kuakui, tidak ada yang seenak berciuman mesra dengan Claire setelah dia baru menerima peju!

ds:308:570:Dialogue Text.source: I had it pretty good too. Dinner and a show!
ds:308:570:Dialogue Text.target: Aku juga menikmati keuntungannya. Santapan sekaligus tontonan!

ds:309:20:Dialogue Text.source: Whoa that’s a ton of dirt!

ds:309:22:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I think Bucky said he could put this to use. That’ll be good.
ds:309:22:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Seingatku Bucky bilang tanah ini bisa dipakainya. Baguslah.

ds:309:23:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Grounds almost all prepped! Then I can lay the foundation!
ds:309:23:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Lahannya hampir siap semua! Setelah itu aku bisa pasang fondasinya!

ds:309:26:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Just gotta catch my breath, and I’ll be back at it!
ds:309:26:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Tinggal mengatur napas sebentar, lalu lanjut lagi!

ds:311:508:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well, I heard you’re… um… into bigger guys?
ds:311:508:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Yah, kudengar kamu… emm… suka pria besar?

ds:311:512:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Well uh… I don’t know if you wanna try… may-
ds:311:512:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Yah, eh… Tidak tahu apa kamu mau mencoba… mung-

ds:311:514:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Haha yes, please. Whatever you wanna do, yes please!
ds:311:514:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Haha, iya, silakan. Apa pun yang mau kamu lakukan, iya, silakan!

ds:311:516:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Water is whatever, you guys had to REBUILD it!
ds:311:516:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Air tidak masalah, kalian sampai harus MEMBANGUNNYA LAGI!

ds:311:518:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]If the forest is going to keep growing, we’ll be needing to rebuild all sorts of stuff.
ds:311:518:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kalau hutan ini terus berkembang, kami perlu membangun ulang segala macam hal.

ds:311:519:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Really, it’s not a problem, and it was a matter of time anyways.
ds:311:519:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sungguh, tidak masalah, lagi pula tinggal menunggu waktu.

ds:311:521:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Well… I’d still like to make it up to you somehow…
ds:311:521:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Yah… Aku tetap ingin menebusnya entah bagaimana…

ds:311:525:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Actually, I had something else in mind…

ds:311:529:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But I bet thats a sight to behold from you!
ds:311:529:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tapi kalau kamu yang melakukannya, pasti pemandangannya luar biasa!

ds:311:530:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah, I’d pay to see that!
ds:311:530:Dialogue Text.target: Iya, aku rela membayar untuk melihatnya!

ds:311:532:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh please, hah! It would be on the house, of course!

ds:311:537:Dialogue Text.source:
Hey! Good to see you’re
talking over things.
ds:311:537:Dialogue Text.target:
Hei! Senang melihat kalian
sedang membicarakan masalahnya.

ds:311:539:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah, thanks for the push! It’s always hard for me to make the first step…
ds:311:539:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Iya, terima kasih atas dorongannya! Selalu sulit bagiku mengambil langkah pertama…

ds:311:541:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Don’t worry, I know exactly how you feel, especially with you being pretty new ’n all!
ds:311:541:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tenang, aku tahu persis perasaanmu, apalagi kamu masih cukup baru dan sebagainya!

ds:311:542:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I shoulda reached out, again, I’m sorry about that!
ds:311:542:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Seharusnya aku yang menghubungimu. Sekali lagi, maaf soal itu!

ds:311:544:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh not at all, I still feel absolutely awful about the bridge!
ds:311:544:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oh, tidak, aku masih merasa bersalah sekali soal jembatan!

ds:311:545:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Is there any way I can make it up to you?

ds:311:547:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hah, as I’ve said, you’ve got nothing to feel bad about!
ds:311:547:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hah, seperti kataku, kamu tidak perlu merasa bersalah!

ds:311:548:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s my shoddy craftsmanship that got you all wet in the first place.
ds:311:548:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hasil pertukanganku yang payah itulah yang membuatmu basah kuyup.

ds:311:550:Dialogue Text.source:
Speaking of which! That was
an impressive paw-free orgasm!
ds:311:550:Dialogue Text.target:
Oh, bicara soal itu! Orgasme tanpa
bantuan tangan tadi mengagumkan!

ds:311:554:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s hard for me to climax without some sorta stimulation…
ds:311:554:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sulit bagiku mencapai klimaks tanpa semacam rangsangan…

ds:311:556:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh heh! Yeah, see, I don’t have any paws to help out, so I kinda had to figure out other ways of pleasing myself…
ds:311:556:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oh, heh! Iya, begini, aku tidak punya tangan untuk membantu, jadi harus mencari cara lain memuaskan diri…

ds:311:557:Dialogue Text.source: Is that a normal thing for you?

ds:311:560:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Normally I use… ermm… well… my own mouth…
ds:311:560:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Biasanya aku pakai… ermm… yah… mulutku sendiri…

ds:311:562:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Hey Rascal! It’s good to see you

ds:311:566:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Gosh! You’re a wizard with that tongue! Those lips too!

ds:311:568:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Heh, thanks… They’re my main tool for pleasing critters…
ds:311:568:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Heh, terima kasih… Itulah alat utamaku untuk memuaskan pasangan…

ds:312:18:Dialogue Text.source: There's a bunch of glyphs carved here... No idea what it says.
ds:312:18:Dialogue Text.target: Banyak aksara diukir di sini... Tidak tahu apa tulisannya.

ds:313:130:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hey Rascal! Ya ready to get some work done?

ds:314:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hah! Not much I can do with these wings.
ds:314:132:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hah! Tidak banyak yang bisa kulakukan dengan sayap ini.

ds:314:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Memantau kemajuan, mengurus komunikasi, DAN menyediakan makanan serta minuman ringan!

ds:315:130:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Rascal? Are you helping us here too?
ds:315:130:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Rascal? Kamu juga ikut membantu di sini?

ds:315:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Gosh! You’ve already helped so much! I feel like we’re taking advantage of you!
ds:315:132:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Astaga! Kamu sudah banyak sekali membantu! Rasanya kami memanfaatkanmu!

ds:315:133:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]You don’t have to if you don’t want to. This is our mess to fix!
ds:315:133:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Kalau tidak mau, kamu tidak harus ikut. Ini masalah kami yang harus kami bereskan!

ds:316:131:Dialogue Text.target: Oh! Aku kaget kamu ada di sini!

ds:316:133:Dialogue Text.source: I thought you and Bucky were on bad terms?
ds:316:133:Dialogue Text.target: Kukira hubunganmu dengan Bucky sedang buruk?

ds:316:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Sorry you had to see any of that, it’s quite unbecoming for critters our age to act like that.
ds:316:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Maaf Anda harus melihat kejadian itu. Tidak pantas kami yang sudah seumur ini bersikap begitu.

ds:316:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The fact is, our conflicts should be second to our town and the well being of our neighbors!
ds:316:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Yang jelas, perselisihan kami harus dikesampingkan demi kota dan kesejahteraan para tetangga!

ds:316:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Simply put, this is too important for me to NOT help!
ds:316:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Singkatnya, ini terlalu penting untuk TIDAK saya bantu!

ds:316:139:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]This has given us time to be adults again and start figuring stuff out.
ds:316:139:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ini memberi kami waktu untuk kembali bersikap dewasa dan mulai menyelesaikan masalah.

ds:316:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Er… not to bog you down with drama or details.
ds:316:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Er… saya tidak bermaksud membebani Anda dengan drama atau detailnya.

ds:316:141:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But don’t worry about us, I think we’ll be ok!
ds:316:141:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tapi jangan khawatirkan kami, rasanya kami akan baik-baik saja!

ds:316:142:Dialogue Text.source: Ok. Well I’m glad you’ll be joining us!
ds:316:142:Dialogue Text.target: Oke. Yah, aku senang kamu ikut bergabung!

ds:317:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Dustin and I will be supervising Bucky’s plans!
ds:317:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Dustin dan aku akan mengawasi pelaksanaan rencana Bucky!

ds:317:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]We’ll be makin’ sure y’all ain’t slackin’!

ds:318:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Great! Look alive out there! We’ll be counting on ya!

ds:318:209:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Look alive out there! We’ll be counting on ya!

ds:31:21:Dialogue Text.source: They look tasty… too high up to reach though…
ds:31:21:Dialogue Text.target: Kelihatannya enak… tapi terlalu tinggi untuk diraih…

ds:31:22:Dialogue Text.source: Hmm… Do apples grow this high up in elevation?
ds:31:22:Dialogue Text.target: Hmm… Apa apel tumbuh di ketinggian begini?

ds:320:131:Dialogue Text.source: Thanks, and right back at ya!

ds:321:130:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Nice work Rascal! Thanks for all your help!
ds:321:130:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kerja bagus, Rascal! Terima kasih atas semua bantuanmu!

ds:321:131:Dialogue Text.source: Thank you for the wonderful refreshments!
ds:321:131:Dialogue Text.target: Terima kasih atas makanan dan minumannya yang nikmat!

ds:321:133:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh hey, I’ve got a bell for you!

ds:321:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]This one’s for the perch across the river!
ds:321:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Yang ini untuk tenggeran di seberang sungai!

ds:321:210:Dialogue Text.source: Thank you for the wonderful refreshments!
ds:321:210:Dialogue Text.target: Terima kasih atas makanan dan minumannya yang nikmat!

ds:321:211:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Nice work Rascal! Thanks for all your help!
ds:321:211:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kerja bagus, Rascal! Terima kasih atas semua bantuanmu!

ds:322:130:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Thanks again for helping out Rascal, we really appreciate it!
ds:322:130:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sekali lagi, terima kasih sudah membantu, Rascal. Kami sangat menghargainya!

ds:322:131:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Oooh, this’ll actually be a great opportunity for you!

ds:322:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]There’s so many other critters to meet, so be sure to head down there tomorrow!
ds:322:132:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Masih banyak penghuni lain yang bisa kamu temui, jadi besok sempatkan ke sana!

ds:322:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh, Penny said she has something for ya!
ds:322:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Oh, Penny bilang dia punya sesuatu untukmu!

ds:322:209:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Thanks again for helping out Rascal, we really appreciate it!
ds:322:209:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sekali lagi, terima kasih sudah membantu, Rascal. Kami sangat menghargainya!

ds:322:210:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Don’t forget, Penny said she has something for ya!
ds:322:210:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Jangan lupa, Penny bilang dia punya sesuatu untukmu!

ds:323:130:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Terima kasih atas kerja keras Anda, Rascal!

ds:325:131:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Now I can show you my shop! I’ll give you the tour tomorrow!
ds:325:131:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sekarang aku bisa menunjukkan tokoku! Besok kuajak kamu berkeliling!

ds:326:130:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Sekali lagi, terima kasih atas bantuanmu, Rascal!

ds:326:131:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Also - be sure to stay off the bridge for now!
ds:326:131:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oh ya, jangan naik ke jembatan dulu!

ds:326:211:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ok everyone! I think that about does it!

ds:326:219:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ah, it’s nice to see a days hardwork pay off!
ds:326:219:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ah, senang melihat kerja keras seharian membuahkan hasil!

ds:326:225:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I wanna thank everyone for their help!
ds:326:225:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Aku ingin berterima kasih kepada semuanya atas bantuan kalian!

ds:326:226:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]And a special thanks to our guest, Rascal!
ds:326:226:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Dan terima kasih khusus untuk tamu kita, Rascal!

ds:326:229:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Aye! Remind me to get you a drink at my shop later!
ds:326:229:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Hei! Ingatkan aku untuk mentraktirmu minum di tokoku nanti!

ds:326:239:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Ah, alright. First rounds on the house!

ds:326:243:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ok everyone, let’s all get a good nights rest!
ds:326:243:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oke, semuanya, mari istirahat yang nyenyak malam ini!

ds:326:244:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh! And don’t use the bridge just yet! We need to let it sit while the compounds dry.
ds:326:244:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oh! Jembatannya jangan dipakai dulu! Harus didiamkan sampai bahan campurannya kering.

ds:327:131:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I let ya sleep in, but the day’s well on its way!
ds:327:131:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kubiarin kamu tidur lebih lama, tapi sekarang sudah lumayan siang!

ds:327:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Go check out the rest of the forest to the South!

ds:328:18:Dialogue Text.source: I don't think this is the way to go right now…
ds:328:18:Dialogue Text.target: Rasanya sekarang bukan waktunya lewat sini…

ds:329:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3] Let me know if you're tired, you can stay the night!
ds:329:132:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3] Bilang kalau sudah lelah, kamu bisa menginap!

ds:32:23:Dialogue Text.source: No Penny to be seen though.

ds:330:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Rascal! Please stay off the bridge for now!

ds:331:573:Dialogue Text.source: Evening ladies! What are you two up to?
ds:331:573:Dialogue Text.target: Selamat malam, Nona-nona! Kalian sedang apa?

ds:331:575:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Penny and I were just talking about setting up a date with the plant-
ds:331:575:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Penny dan aku baru saja membicarakan rencana kencan dengan tanaman itu-

ds:331:576:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]OH MY GOSH, I JUST REMEMBERED! Rascal recently had his own experience with the plant!
ds:331:576:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]YA AMPUN, AKU BARU INGAT! Rascal baru saja punya pengalaman sendiri dengan tanamannya!

ds:331:578:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh? You’ve met our little friend in the woods?
ds:331:578:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Oh? Kamu sudah bertemu teman kecil kami di hutan?

ds:331:579:Dialogue Text.source: I did! It got well acquainted with my rear…
ds:331:579:Dialogue Text.target: Sudah! Dia jadi akrab sekali dengan pantatku…

ds:331:583:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Tell me, are you comfortable being on the receiving end?
ds:331:583:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Katakan, kamu nyaman jadi pihak yang menerima?

ds:331:584:Dialogue Text.source: I am! I quite enjoy it!

ds:331:586:Dialogue Text.source: I’m not a big fan, but I’m flexible.
ds:331:586:Dialogue Text.target: Aku tidak terlalu suka, tapi bisa menyesuaikan.

ds:331:588:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’ll be sure to keep that in mind!

ds:331:592:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So, I actually ran into Rascal JUST AFTER it all went down.
ds:331:592:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Jadi, sebenarnya aku bertemu Rascal TEPAT SETELAH semuanya selesai.

ds:331:593:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I was gathering up my nerve to ask him out on a date - I didn’t even realize what he was up to.
ds:331:593:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Aku sedang mengumpulkan keberanian untuk mengajaknya kencan. Bahkan tidak sadar dia sedang apa.

ds:331:596:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Turns out he was running an errand for Scarlett. Gathering some "fresh fertilizer," stored in Scarlett’s favorite way.
ds:331:596:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ternyata dia sedang menjalankan tugas Scarlett. Mengumpulkan “pupuk segar”, disimpan dengan cara kesukaan Scarlett.

ds:331:599:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Baw, I see. But still, experiencing it at all is something to respect!
ds:331:599:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Baw, begitu. Tapi tetap saja, berani mencobanya itu patut dihargai!

ds:331:601:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So he’s over there, clenching his butt cheeks, red in the face, cum oozing down his legs - I’m over there like ’Hey uhhh wanna get a drink maybe?’
ds:331:601:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Jadi dia merapatkan pantat, wajah merah, peju meleleh di kakinya, sementara aku malah bilang, ‘Hei, ehhh, mau minum mungkin?’

ds:331:605:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Rascal’s so humble, he didn’t cut me off, or interrupt me. Just kindly held it in, squirming.
ds:331:605:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Rascal rendah hati sekali, tidak memotong atau menyelaku. Cuma dengan baik hati menahannya di dalam sambil menggeliat.
