ds:388:159:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]No no. There’s a cave at the top of the path here.
ds:388:159:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Bukan, bukan. Ada gua di ujung atas jalan ini.

ds:388:161:Dialogue Text.source: Oh okay, why don’t you come with?

ds:388:163:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Hmm, honestly, it’s a petty reason, and I probably shouldn’t hassle you with it.
ds:388:163:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hmm, jujur, alasannya sepele, mungkin sebaiknya tidak merepotkanmu.

ds:388:167:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Maybe I don’t need that stuff… It’s probably still dirty honestly…
ds:388:167:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mungkin barang-barang itu tidak kubutuhkan… Jujur, mungkin masih kotor…

ds:388:168:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oh, Rascal! Didn’t see you were still here.
ds:388:168:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Oh, Rascal! Tidak lihat kamu masih di sini.

ds:388:171:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve got some belongings up the mountain. Do you think you could grab them?
ds:388:171:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ada beberapa barangku di atas gunung. Bisa tolong ambilkan?

ds:389:374:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey Rascal! Didja figure it all out? Did I get up to some crazy shenanigans?
ds:389:374:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Hai Rascal! Sudah tahu semuanya? Apa aku melakukan kenakalan yang gila?

ds:389:376:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Baiklah! Aku siap mendengarkan, apa yang terjadi?

ds:389:378:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Wow… Y’know, that explains why I was so dang sore the next day…
ds:389:378:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Wah… Itu menjelaskan kenapa keesokan harinya tubuhku sakit sekali…

ds:389:380:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So then that’s it? We all fell asleep?

ds:389:383:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah, apparently Augustus and Penny
had some fun themselves.
ds:389:383:Dialogue Text.target:
Iya, ternyata Augustus dan Penny
juga bersenang-senang.

ds:389:385:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah, he called her "Felicity"
while they were going at it.
ds:389:385:Dialogue Text.target:
Iya, dia memanggilnya “Felicity”
saat mereka melakukannya.

ds:389:386:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Whaaaat Hah! Ok ok, I actually know what’s going on there.
ds:389:386:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Apaaa Hah! Oke oke, aku sebenarnya tahu yang terjadi.

ds:389:388:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I don’t, but I bet that was a critter that was important to the event The Blessing was created from.
ds:389:388:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Tidak, tapi kurasa dia sosok penting dalam peristiwa yang menjadi asal-usul Berkah.

ds:389:389:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]In fact, I wouldn’t be surprised if that was the original bird who flew the Bell!
ds:389:389:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Bahkan, aku tidak akan heran kalau dialah burung pertama yang menerbangkan Lonceng!

ds:389:391:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Well Augustus is a huge history buff, right?

ds:389:392:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Him and I talk all the time about different cultures, and all sorts of stories from the past.
ds:389:392:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Dia dan aku sering sekali membicarakan budaya yang berbeda, dan segala macam kisah masa lalu.

ds:389:393:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]He’s mentioned a few times that he’s really fascinated by some of these important figures.
ds:389:393:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Dia beberapa kali bilang sangat terpesona pada beberapa tokoh penting ini.

ds:389:394:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I bet he’s got an idol kink!
ds:389:394:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kurasa dia punya kink terhadap tokoh idola!

ds:389:396:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Iya! Maksudnya, tertarik pada penghuni yang berprestasi.

ds:389:399:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I’ve had this hunch for a while. But what’s interesting is Penny’s side there…
ds:389:399:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Aku sudah cukup lama menduganya. Tapi yang menarik adalah sisi Penny…

ds:389:400:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Obviously adorning the role is super customary for the holiday. But is she that into the role play of it?
ds:389:400:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Jelas menjalankan peran itu memang adat hari raya tersebut. Tapi apa dia begitu menyukai permainan peran itu?

ds:389:402:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I know she’s a bit less up front than the rest of us, I wonder if this is one of her hidden kinks?
ds:389:402:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Aku tahu dia agak kurang terbuka daripada kami, apa ini salah satu kink tersembunyinya?

ds:389:406:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Great! Yeah, I’ve heard many retellings of this night, but the critters always start talking over each other and disagreeing on the timing of certain things.
ds:389:406:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Bagus! Ya, aku sudah sering mendengar kisah malam itu, tapi mereka selalu saling menyela dan tidak sepakat soal urutan waktunya.

ds:389:407:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It’s nice to set things straight finally!

ds:389:408:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Hm… I Wonder if I’ll try a kissing booth again next year…
ds:389:408:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Hm… Apa aku akan mencoba stan ciuman lagi tahun depan…

ds:389:409:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Anyways, thank you for finding all that out for me Rascal!
ds:389:409:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pokoknya, terima kasih sudah mencari tahu semuanya untukku, Rascal!

ds:389:410:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Anything I can do to repay you?

ds:389:412:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Hah! Ok, you got it, hot stuff!

ds:38:132:Dialogue Text.source: A set of gardening tools. They’ve gotten a ton of use.
ds:38:132:Dialogue Text.target: Seperangkat alat berkebun. Sudah sering sekali dipakai.

ds:390:260:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]As you can guess, I take on the roll of the Bell Bearer.
ds:390:260:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Seperti yang bisa kamu tebak, aku berperan sebagai Pembawa Lonceng.

ds:390:261:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Partly to play out the role, but also…

ds:390:262:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I do go on look out for any critters that might be struggling in the cold.
ds:390:262:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Aku sungguh berpatroli mencari penghuni yang mungkin kesulitan menghadapi dingin.

ds:390:263:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]There has been a few occasions where I have found critters in need of help. Much like how I found you!
ds:390:263:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Beberapa kali aku menemukan penghuni yang butuh bantuan. Sama seperti saat menemukanmu!

ds:390:264:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But mainly I just go around visiting other areas. It’s always nice seeing other critters ringing out their bells to me in celebration too!
ds:390:264:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tapi kebanyakan aku berkeliling mengunjungi daerah lain. Selalu menyenangkan melihat penghuni lain membunyikan lonceng untukku dalam perayaan juga!

ds:390:267:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But my experience of the celebration is a bit different than the other critters here…
ds:390:267:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tapi pengalamanku merayakannya agak berbeda dari penghuni lain di sini…

ds:390:269:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]He insists that there is this "Saint" character that played a role during the Blessing.
ds:390:269:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=11]Dia bersikeras ada tokoh “Sang Suci” yang berperan saat Berkah.

ds:390:270:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]But that’s not how I’ve heard it.

ds:390:271:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]In any case, there’s a whole other part of the festivities that I don’t partake in because I’m prepping for the actual Blessing.
ds:390:271:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pokoknya, ada bagian lain dari perayaan itu yang tidak kuikuti karena aku menyiapkan Pemberkatan yang sesungguhnya.

ds:390:272:Dialogue Text.source: I see! Ok, I will talk to him.
ds:390:272:Dialogue Text.target: Begitu! Oke, aku akan bicara dengannya.

ds:390:273:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Thanks for asking about this though! I’m happy to teach folks about this since it’s a time that’s very close to my heart!
ds:390:273:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tapi terima kasih sudah bertanya! Aku senang menceritakannya karena masa itu begitu dekat di hatiku!

ds:390:276:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Critters had no choice but to band together. They would exchange and share provisions, huddle for warmth, and share in eachother’s company.
ds:390:276:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Para penghuni tidak punya pilihan selain bersatu. Mereka bertukar dan berbagi perbekalan, berhimpitan menghangatkan diri, dan saling menemani.

ds:390:277:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]But they knew it wouldn’t last, they knew they needed help.
ds:390:277:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Tapi mereka tahu itu tidak akan bertahan, mereka tahu butuh bantuan.

ds:390:278:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]So each night, when the weather was the most still, the critters would ring their bells for hope that anyone would hear it.
ds:390:278:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Jadi setiap malam, saat cuaca paling tenang, para penghuni membunyikan lonceng dengan harapan ada yang mendengar.

ds:390:279:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Day after day, new critters would show up, share in the warmth and comfort others could provide, and night after night, they would ring their bells.
ds:390:279:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Hari demi hari, penghuni baru berdatangan, berbagi kehangatan dan kenyamanan yang bisa diberikan yang lain, dan malam demi malam, mereka membunyikan lonceng.

ds:390:280:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Weeks went by. Until finally, on the 18th night, a heavy sound rung out from the skies.
ds:390:280:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Minggu demi minggu berlalu. Hingga akhirnya, pada malam ke-18, bunyi berat bergema dari langit.

ds:390:281:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The familiar sound of a bell, but this one was much larger… It grew louder and louder. It was coming closer!
ds:390:281:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Bunyi lonceng yang mereka kenal, tapi yang ini jauh lebih besar… Bunyinya makin keras. Makin dekat!

ds:390:282:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]On the 19th night, a great falcon was spotted in the distance.
ds:390:282:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=10]Pada malam ke-19, seekor falkon besar terlihat di kejauhan.

ds:390:283:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]The bird carried a tremendous bell, ringing out far into the night.
ds:390:283:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=10]Burung itu membawa lonceng raksasa, bunyinya menggema jauh menembus malam.

ds:390:284:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]The critters calls were heard, they were answered!

ds:390:285:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]The Falcon circled overhead, ringing out their giant bell. And the critters joined in with their own chorus of bells!
ds:390:285:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Falkon itu berputar di atas, membunyikan lonceng raksasanya. Dan para penghuni ikut serta dengan paduan bunyi lonceng mereka!

ds:390:286:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Within hours, a rescue team came barreling after the falcon, providing food and water to all.
ds:390:286:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Dalam beberapa jam, tim penyelamat menyusul falkon itu dengan cepat, menyediakan makanan dan air bagi semua.

ds:390:287:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Thus, The Blessing of the Bells became a widespread story. A necessity for winter survival back in the day.
ds:390:287:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Begitulah Berkah Lonceng menjadi kisah yang tersebar luas. Dulu itu kebutuhan untuk bertahan hidup di musim dingin.

ds:390:289:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I go flying around with a BIG OLE BELL ringing across the lands!
ds:390:289:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Aku terbang berkeliling membawa LONCENG BESAR, membunyikannya ke seluruh penjuru!

ds:390:290:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Critters down below will join me ringing out their own bells as I pass by. It’s a wonderful time!
ds:390:290:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Penghuni di bawah ikut membunyikan lonceng mereka saat aku lewat. Saat yang indah!

ds:390:292:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It really is! It’s a magical time, and I’m super grateful I can be a part of it!
ds:390:292:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Memang! Saat yang ajaib, dan aku bersyukur sekali bisa menjadi bagiannya!

ds:390:294:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Did Scarlett tell you why this is a holiday at all? Where it all started?
ds:390:294:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Scarlett sudah cerita kenapa ini menjadi hari raya? Dari mana asalnya?

ds:390:295:Dialogue Text.source: She said I should hear it from you.

ds:390:297:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Well The Blessing of the Bells has become much more superficial these days.
ds:390:297:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Yah, belakangan Berkah Lonceng lebih berfokus pada hal-hal luarnya.

ds:390:298:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Gift giving, partying, decorations, friends and family, y’know how it goes…
ds:390:298:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Memberi hadiah, berpesta, dekorasi, teman dan keluarga, kamu tahu sendiri…

ds:390:299:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]But it actually started in much darker times…
ds:390:299:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Tapi sebenarnya bermula di masa yang jauh lebih kelam…

ds:390:300:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Long ago, the Winters were very harsh, and times were much tougher. Provisions were harder to come by, and larger communities like ours were quite scarce.
ds:390:300:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Dahulu kala, Musim Dingin sangat keras, dan kehidupan jauh lebih sulit. Perbekalan lebih susah didapat, dan komunitas besar seperti kita cukup langka.

ds:390:301:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Snowy seasons were quite dangerous. If a family didn’t prepare, there were dire consequences…
ds:390:301:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Musim bersalju cukup berbahaya. Kalau sebuah keluarga tidak bersiap, akibatnya sangat buruk…

ds:390:302:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]One terrible Winter, the winds blew harder than ever, the snow was relentless, the temperatures were unbearable.
ds:390:302:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Pada suatu Musim Dingin yang mengerikan, angin bertiup lebih kencang dari sebelumnya, salju tak kunjung berhenti, suhunya tak tertahankan.

ds:390:306:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh it’s a wonderful time! Lots of the critters here get into the spirit of things.
ds:390:306:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Oh, itu saat yang indah! Banyak penghuni di sini ikut bersemangat.

ds:390:307:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I hope you’ll join us for the next one!

ds:390:308:Dialogue Text.source:
I’d like to!
Can you tell me more about it?
ds:390:308:Dialogue Text.target:
Aku mau!
Bisa ceritakan lebih banyak?

ds:390:310:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s a month long celebration, where critters bundle up, decorate their surroundings, share gifts and meals!
ds:390:310:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Perayaannya sebulan penuh, para penghuni mengenakan pakaian hangat, menghias sekitar, berbagi hadiah dan makanan!

ds:390:311:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]We close out each night of celebration with a ringing of a bell!
ds:390:311:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Kami menutup setiap malam perayaan dengan bunyi lonceng!

ds:390:312:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Then do the whole thing over the next day!

ds:390:314:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It is! And that’s not even the best part!
ds:390:314:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Memang! Dan itu bahkan belum bagian terbaiknya!

ds:390:315:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]The very last day, yours truly finishes the entire celebration with "The Blessing!"
ds:390:315:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Pada hari terakhir, aku sendiri menutup seluruh perayaan dengan “Pemberkatan!”

ds:390:318:Dialogue Text.source:
I’ve heard you know a thing or two
about The Blessing of the Bells?
ds:390:318:Dialogue Text.target:
Kudengar kamu tahu satu dua hal
tentang Berkah Lonceng?

ds:391:260:Dialogue Text.source:
I was wondering if you could
tell me about The Blessing of the Bells
ds:391:260:Dialogue Text.target:
Aku ingin tahu apa kamu bisa
bercerita tentang Berkah Lonceng

ds:391:261:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oh? Isn’t it a little early to be thinking of that?
ds:391:261:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Oh? Bukankah agak terlalu awal untuk memikirkannya?

ds:391:262:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s the middle of Summer after all…

ds:391:263:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Er wait, have you celebrated The Blessing before?
ds:391:263:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Eh, tunggu, Anda pernah merayakan Berkah sebelumnya?

ds:391:264:Dialogue Text.source:
I’ve just learned about it.
Penny said you could tell me more.
ds:391:264:Dialogue Text.target:
Aku baru mendengarnya.
Kata Penny kamu bisa cerita lebih banyak.

ds:391:265:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ah yes, you’ve come to the right gator!
ds:391:265:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ah ya, Anda menemui aligator yang tepat!

ds:391:266:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Knowing Penny, she’s likely told you the cultural and historical significance already?
ds:391:266:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mengenal Penny, kemungkinan dia sudah menceritakan makna budaya dan sejarahnya?

ds:391:269:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m assuming she told you to come to me to hear about The Saint?
ds:391:269:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Saya berasumsi dia menyuruh Anda menemui saya untuk mendengar tentang Sang Suci?

ds:391:271:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Haha, I bet she wasn’t too keen on telling you that part…
ds:391:271:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Haha, pasti dia tidak terlalu ingin menceritakan bagian itu…

ds:391:273:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Indeed… See cultural holidays will vastly change over generations.
ds:391:273:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Memang… Begini, hari raya budaya berubah drastis dari generasi ke generasi.

ds:391:274:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It can be hard to tell what stemmed from legitimacy, and what was added for fun.
ds:391:274:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Kadang sulit membedakan mana yang berasal dari kenyataan, dan mana yang ditambahkan untuk bersenang-senang.

ds:391:275:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]To Penny’s credit, I can’t say I’ve seen records of "The Saint" being involved with The Blessing…
ds:391:275:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Harus saya akui Penny ada benarnya, saya belum pernah melihat catatan bahwa “Sang Suci” terlibat dalam Berkah…

ds:391:276:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But as a child, this aspect was a favorite of mine for the festivities. I’m definitely guilty of perpetuating this nonsense, but it’s so fun!
ds:391:276:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tetapi sewaktu kecil, bagian ini favorit saya dalam perayaan. Saya memang ikut melestarikan omong kosong ini, tetapi seru sekali!

ds:391:278:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Right - so, you’re generally familiar with the origins of The Blessing of the Bells?
ds:391:278:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Baiklah, jadi Anda sudah cukup tahu asal-usul Berkah Lonceng?

ds:391:280:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well it’s been said that there was a mysterious critter going around providing small boons and gifts to the young.
ds:391:280:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Konon ada sosok misterius yang berkeliling memberi bantuan kecil dan hadiah kepada yang muda.

ds:391:281:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Likely to keep their mind off of such perilous times.
ds:391:281:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Mungkin untuk mengalihkan pikiran mereka dari masa yang begitu berbahaya.

ds:391:282:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Again, no official records of that happening - But the myth became tradition!
ds:391:282:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sekali lagi, tidak ada catatan resmi tentang itu, tetapi mitosnya menjadi tradisi!

ds:391:283:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s customary to give each other gifts during this holiday, but it’s also customary to give some gifts in total anonymity, thus continuing on the spirit of "The Saint".
ds:391:283:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sudah menjadi kebiasaan saling memberi hadiah saat hari raya ini, tetapi juga memberi sebagian hadiah tanpa mengungkap identitas sama sekali, sehingga semangat “Sang Suci” terus hidup.

ds:391:286:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And there’s no secret that I try to play that role during our celebrations…
ds:391:286:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Dan bukan rahasia bahwa saya mencoba memainkan peran itu saat perayaan kami…

ds:391:287:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Believe me, it’s QUITE TRICKY for a fella like me to provide gifts without being noticed…
ds:391:287:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Percayalah, CUKUP SULIT bagi sosok seperti saya untuk memberi hadiah tanpa ketahuan…

ds:391:290:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Even I receive some of these anonymous gifts… Like truly anonymous.
ds:391:290:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Bahkan saya pun menerima sebagian hadiah anonim ini… Benar-benar anonim.

ds:391:291:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]See, it’s always easy to tell when a critter here is "trying" to be secretive.
ds:391:291:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Begini, selalu mudah tahu saat penghuni di sini “mencoba” berahasia.

ds:391:292:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But I’ll occasionally get a truly mysterious gift, and try as I might, no one seems to know where it comes from.
ds:391:292:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Tetapi sesekali saya mendapat hadiah yang benar-benar misterius, dan sekeras apa pun saya mencoba, sepertinya tidak ada yang tahu asalnya.

ds:391:293:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]All the critters know I’m supposed to be "The Saint" - so they often think I’m messing with them.
ds:391:293:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Semua penghuni tahu seharusnya sayalah “Sang Suci”, jadi mereka sering mengira saya sedang mengerjai mereka.

ds:391:294:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But I swear to you, I’ve no idea who keeps gifting me things during the festivities.
ds:391:294:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Tetapi saya bersumpah kepada Anda, saya tidak tahu siapa yang terus memberi saya hadiah selama perayaan.

ds:391:295:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Obviously it’s gotta be a critter here, and really I’m just happy to see the spirit of The Saint living on.
ds:391:295:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Jelas pasti penghuni di sini, dan sebenarnya saya senang melihat semangat Sang Suci tetap hidup.

ds:391:297:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Anyways, will you be joining us for this year’s Blessing?
ds:391:297:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pokoknya, Anda akan ikut Berkah tahun ini?

ds:391:298:Dialogue Text.source: I hope so! It sounds amazing!

ds:391:299:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It really is a special time here for us.
ds:391:299:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ini sungguh masa yang istimewa bagi kami di sini.

ds:391:300:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I know I don’t speak for myself when I say we’d love to have you!
ds:391:300:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Saya tahu bukan hanya saya yang merasa kami akan senang sekali menyambut Anda!

ds:391:301:Dialogue Text.source: Thanks for telling me about all of this!
ds:391:301:Dialogue Text.target: Terima kasih sudah menceritakan semua ini!

ds:392:260:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh not much. Just doing some shopping…

ds:392:261:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I was gonna pick up some veggies for a stew…

ds:392:264:Dialogue Text.source: I only ever see like, 3 things for sale.
ds:392:264:Dialogue Text.target: Aku cuma pernah melihat, paling, 3 barang dijual.

ds:392:265:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah he’s got stuff in the back. No idea why there’s only ever 3 things on display here…
ds:392:265:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ya, barangnya ada di belakang. Entah kenapa yang dipajang di sini selalu cuma 3…

ds:393:375:Dialogue Text.source:
Do you remember Scarlett’s party
during the last Blessing of the Bells?
ds:393:375:Dialogue Text.target:
Kamu ingat pesta Scarlett
saat Berkah Lonceng terakhir?

ds:393:376:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hmmm, you’ll have to be a bit more specific than that!

ds:393:377:Dialogue Text.source:
Claire and Violet said you guys
all got up to some naughty stuff.
ds:393:377:Dialogue Text.target:
Kata Claire dan Violet kalian semua
melakukan hal-hal nakal.

ds:393:379:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]C’mon mate, you remember stuffin’ my rear, don’t ya?
ds:393:379:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Ayolah, Kawan, kamu ingat mengisi pantatku, kan?

ds:393:382:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Ah but yes, now it’s coming back to me.
ds:393:382:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Ah, tapi iya, sekarang aku mulai ingat.

ds:393:384:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh that’s right, Claire and Violet were wearing their festive colors eh?
ds:393:384:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oh betul, Claire dan Violet memakai warna-warna perayaan, ya?

ds:393:389:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yep! The those coyotes might be evil, but they keep their word!
ds:393:389:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Yap! Para koyote itu mungkin jahat, tapi mereka menepati janji!

ds:393:390:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]… That was a good time, we should do that again…
ds:393:390:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]… Menyenangkan sekali, kita harus melakukannya lagi…

ds:393:398:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Y’know, I wouldn’t mind being on the tongue-bath side of you going at Dustin.
ds:393:398:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tahu tidak, aku tidak keberatan dapat bagian dimandikan lidah saat kamu menggenjot Dustin.

ds:393:400:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oy! Why am I always on bottom?

ds:393:403:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]What? A lil guy like you being a top? You crazy?
ds:393:403:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Apa? Pria kecil sepertimu jadi top? Kamu gila?

ds:393:408:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But Red, those girls are evil, you know that right?
ds:393:408:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Tapi Merah, para wanita itu jahat, kamu tahu kan?

ds:393:413:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Back me up Dustin, we were watching those two lick on Mabel, right?
ds:393:413:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Benar kan, Dustin, kita sedang menonton mereka berdua menjilati Mabel?

ds:393:418:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]And Red, those tongues? WOW. They get everywhere. It’s great.
ds:393:418:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Dan Merah, lidah-lidah itu? WAH. Bisa menjangkau mana saja. Mantap.

ds:393:420:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]So there Dustin and I were, watching this show. And y’know, we’re gettin’ pretty excited.
ds:393:420:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Jadi Dustin dan aku menonton pertunjukan itu. Dan kami mulai cukup bergairah.

ds:393:421:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I nudge him and say somethin’ like: Let’s see if we can get those gals to lick us like that.
ds:393:421:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Kusenggol dia dan kubilang kira-kira: Coba kita buat para wanita itu menjilati kita begitu.

ds:393:426:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]And sure enough, after they finished off with Mabel, they noticed us two handsome fellas.
ds:393:426:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Dan benar saja, setelah selesai dengan Mabel, mereka melihat kami, dua pria tampan ini.

ds:393:427:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]They got in close Red, reaaaaal close.

ds:393:429:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yeah mate, that big ole snout was all up in my business!
ds:393:429:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Iya, Kawan, moncong besar itu langsung mendekati punyaku!

ds:393:431:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We thought it was our turn for a coyote tongue bath… But…
ds:393:431:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kami kira sekarang giliran kami dimandikan lidah koyote… Tapi…

ds:393:432:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Turns out they had something else in mind.

ds:393:438:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]We were not of sound mind, y’know? We were taken advantage of!
ds:393:438:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Pikiran kami tidak jernih, tahu? Kami dimanfaatkan!

ds:393:440:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ok, I wouldn’t go that far, mate.
ds:393:440:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oke, aku tidak akan bilang sejauh itu, Kawan.

ds:393:442:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yeah I know, I’m just being dramatic.

ds:393:443:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Long story short, we’d get our tongue baths. But only if Dustin could fit my dong!
ds:393:443:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Singkatnya, kami bakal dimandikan lidah. Tapi hanya kalau milikku bisa masuk ke Dustin!

ds:393:445:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Yeah see, turns out the coyotes knew Mabel was giving me some stretching lessons.
ds:393:445:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ya, ternyata para koyote tahu Mabel memberiku pelajaran peregangan.

ds:393:446:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]And they just saw how stretchy she could be, soooo. I was up to bat…
ds:393:446:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Dan mereka baru melihat seberapa melarnya dia, jadiii. Sekarang giliranku…

ds:394:711:Dialogue Text.source: I had to focus on not blowing my load so soon. This guy’s lil rear is incredible.
ds:394:711:Dialogue Text.target: Aku harus fokus supaya tidak terlalu cepat keluar. Pantat kecil pria ini luar biasa.

ds:394:714:Dialogue Text.source: At this point I was much more relaxed. I could take like, half of him pretty comfortably.
ds:394:714:Dialogue Text.target: Saat itu aku jauh lebih rileks. Kira-kira separuh miliknya bisa kutampung dengan cukup nyaman.

ds:394:715:Dialogue Text.source: But that was about the end of it. There’s only so much room y’know?
ds:394:715:Dialogue Text.target: Tapi cuma sampai situ. Ruangnya terbatas, tahu?

ds:394:716:Dialogue Text.source: And GOSH, mate, the feeling of being so filled out like that. Gah!
ds:394:716:Dialogue Text.target: Dan ASTAGA, Kawan, rasanya terisi sepenuh itu. Gah!

ds:394:719:Dialogue Text.source: When you were just like, sittin’ on it, rockin’ back and forth. WHEW.
ds:394:719:Dialogue Text.target: Saat kamu cuma duduk di atasnya, bergoyang maju mundur. WUIH.

ds:394:723:Dialogue Text.source: I especially lost it when Violet started licking me.
ds:394:723:Dialogue Text.target: Apalagi saat Violet mulai menjilatiku, aku langsung kehilangan kendali.

ds:394:724:Dialogue Text.source: Her tongue would cover my entire lower region, it was nuts, mate!
ds:394:724:Dialogue Text.target: Lidahnya menutupi seluruh bagian bawah tubuhku, gila sekali, Kawan!

ds:394:727:Dialogue Text.source: Now, mate, these gals were being very critical!
ds:394:727:Dialogue Text.target: Nah, Kawan, para wanita ini teliti sekali!

ds:394:728:Dialogue Text.source: They wanted to see from all angles to make sure Maverick was gettin’ IN there.
ds:394:728:Dialogue Text.target: Mereka ingin melihat dari semua sudut untuk memastikan milik Maverick benar-benar MASUK.

ds:394:729:Dialogue Text.source: So I got to work! Sliding that tip in and bouncing on it a lil further every time.
ds:394:729:Dialogue Text.target: Jadi aku mulai beraksi! Memasukkan ujungnya lalu mengentak turun sedikit lebih jauh setiap kali.

ds:394:731:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah, I remember that! Y’know those two were watching you like a hawk.
ds:394:731:Dialogue Text.target: Ya, aku ingat! Mereka berdua mengawasimu dengan sangat saksama.

ds:395:136:Dialogue Text.source:
Perhaps someone important
to The Blessing of the Bells?
ds:395:136:Dialogue Text.target:
Mungkin seseorang yang penting
dalam Berkah Lonceng?

ds:396:134:Dialogue Text.source: Hey, why do you only sell 3 things?
ds:396:134:Dialogue Text.target: Hei, kenapa kamu cuma menjual 3 barang?

ds:396:136:Dialogue Text.source: There’s only like, 3 things you’re selling.
ds:396:136:Dialogue Text.target: Cuma ada sekitar 3 barang yang kamu jual.

ds:396:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh naw, that’s just what’s on display, Red.
ds:396:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Oh, bukan, itu cuma yang dipajang, Merah.

ds:396:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ya think I don’t keep my shop stocked?
ds:396:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kamu kira aku tidak menjaga persediaan toko?

ds:396:139:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ya think I’m some kinda hack, Red?!

ds:396:140:Dialogue Text.source: No no, I just want to know what else you sell.
ds:396:140:Dialogue Text.target: Tidak, tidak, aku cuma ingin tahu apa lagi yang kamu jual.

ds:396:142:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Y’know… I’ve been a lil back logged on stocking so…
ds:396:142:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Tahu tidak… Aku agak terlambat mengisi stok, jadi…

ds:397:133:Dialogue Text.source: How do you like The Blessing of the Bells?
ds:397:133:Dialogue Text.target: Seberapa besar kamu menyukai Berkah Lonceng?

ds:397:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Whattya think love, how do we like The Blessing?
ds:397:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Bagaimana menurutmu, Sayang, seberapa besar kita menyukai Berkah?

ds:397:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]This is a Blessing house hold. If ya don’t love The Blessing, we gotta kick you out.
ds:397:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Rumah ini menjunjung Berkah. Kalau tidak cinta Berkah, kami harus mengusirmu.

ds:397:144:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Haha, yes of course, we love The Blessing! We go pretty all out with decorations too.
ds:397:144:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Haha, ya tentu, kami cinta Berkah! Kami juga habis-habisan memasang dekorasi.

ds:397:146:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Absolutely, just wait till you see it this year!
ds:397:146:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tentu, tunggu sampai kamu lihat tahun ini!

ds:398:134:Dialogue Text.source: How do you like The Blessing of the Bells?
ds:398:134:Dialogue Text.target: Seberapa besar kamu menyukai Berkah Lonceng?

ds:398:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Bundling up in warm cloooothes, hanging with your paaals!
ds:398:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Membungkus diri dengan pakaian hangaaat, berkumpul dengan kawaaaan!

ds:398:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Have a few drinks and we’re singing songs together, it’s such a good time!
ds:398:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Minum sedikit lalu kita bernyanyi bersama, menyenangkan sekali!

ds:399:136:Dialogue Text.source: How do you like The Blessing of the Bells?

ds:399:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Personally, I really dig Winter. And the holidays were pretty big for me as a kid.
ds:399:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Aku pribadi sangat suka musim dingin. Dan perayaannya sangat berarti bagiku sewaktu kecil.

ds:399:139:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Plus it’s always good to have an excuse to hang and drink with friends!
ds:399:139:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Lagi pula, selalu menyenangkan punya alasan berkumpul dan minum bersama teman!

ds:39:288:Dialogue Text.source: Player moves around to the next target. Player interacts- Snipping sounds.
ds:39:288:Dialogue Text.target: Player moves around to the next target. Player interacts- Snipping sounds.

ds:39:290:Dialogue Text.source: Player moves to the next target. Player interacts- Snipping sounds
ds:39:290:Dialogue Text.target: Player moves to the next target. Player interacts- Snipping sounds

ds:39:292:Dialogue Text.source: Player moves to the next target and snips. Now the rear is left. Target moves to the rear. Player moves to the rear.
ds:39:292:Dialogue Text.target: Player moves to the next target and snips. Now the rear is left. Target moves to the rear. Player moves to the rear.

ds:39:293:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Hey Rascal, careful with the bits back there!
ds:39:293:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Hei, Rascal, hati-hati dengan bagian sensitif di belakang sana!

ds:39:294:Dialogue Text.source: These are some very nice bits…

ds:39:296:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]You uh… Wanna mess around when you’re done?

ds:39:301:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Whew! Ok, that feels SO much better.

ds:39:302:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]You’re actually pretty good with those things. Sorry I doubted you!
ds:39:302:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ternyata kamu cukup mahir memakai alat itu. Maaf sudah meragukanmu!

ds:39:304:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Often times the coyote gals’ will let me have a go at them. Both if I can handle it!
ds:39:304:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Biasanya para koyote itu membiarkanku bermain dengan mereka. Dua-duanya kalau aku sanggup!

ds:39:305:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]… But it’s been a while since I’ve had a male partner. Want to have a go back there?
ds:39:305:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]… Tapi sudah lama aku tidak punya pasangan laki-laki. Mau mencoba dari belakang?

ds:39:306:Dialogue Text.source:
You bet!
Let me get a rock or something….
ds:39:306:Dialogue Text.target:
Tentu!
Biar kucari batu atau apa dulu….

ds:39:310:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Man, you’re pretty big for such a little guy!
ds:39:310:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Wah, barangmu lumayan besar untuk tubuh sekecil itu!

ds:39:311:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Heh, I really needed that… let’s do it again sometime!
ds:39:311:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Heh, aku benar-benar butuh itu… kapan-kapan kita ulangi lagi!

ds:39:313:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh, while you were back there, I noticed some of the wool got carried by the wind.
ds:39:313:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oh, saat kamu di belakang tadi, kulihat sebagian wolnya terbawa angin.

ds:39:314:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Make sure you snatch it up! I’m sure the coyotes could use the surplus.
ds:39:314:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Jangan lupa memungutnya! Para koyote pasti bisa memanfaatkan sisanya.

ds:39:315:Dialogue Text.source: Player can return to the coyotes.
ds:39:315:Dialogue Text.target: Player can return to the coyotes.

ds:3:131:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh Sorry Red, shop’s closed today. I’d have closed the door if I had one!
ds:3:131:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Oh, maaf Merah, hari ini toko tutup. Pasti sudah kututup pintunya kalau aku punya!

ds:3:133:Dialogue Text.source: You decide to spare the beaver your shenanigans.
ds:3:133:Dialogue Text.target: Kamu memutuskan tidak merepotkan si berang-berang pembuat bendungan dengan kenakalanmu.

ds:400:134:Dialogue Text.source: How do you like The Blessing of the Bells?
ds:400:134:Dialogue Text.target: Seberapa besar kamu menyukai Berkah Lonceng?

ds:400:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Critters are in here every day, buyin’ gifts.
ds:400:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Penghuni datang ke sini setiap hari, membeli hadiah.

ds:400:139:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh, and uh, spending time with everyone is great.
ds:400:139:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Oh, dan, eh, menghabiskan waktu bersama semua orang juga menyenangkan.

ds:401:134:Dialogue Text.source: How do you like The Blessing of the Bells?
ds:401:134:Dialogue Text.target: Seberapa besar kamu menyukai Berkah Lonceng?

ds:401:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh it’s a blast! Especially with the critters here!
ds:401:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Oh, seru sekali! Apalagi bersama para penghuni di sini!

ds:401:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But what I really love about the holidays is the decoration!
ds:401:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Tapi yang benar-benar kusuka dari hari raya adalah dekorasinya!

ds:401:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Something about seeing this place blanketed in snow, and lit with lights and decorations.
ds:401:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ada sesuatu saat melihat tempat ini berselimut salju, diterangi lampu dan dekorasi.

ds:401:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]This place is straight gorgeous in the Winter.
ds:401:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tempat ini sungguh indah di Musim Dingin.

ds:402:133:Dialogue Text.source: How do you like The Blessing of the Bells?
ds:402:133:Dialogue Text.target: Seberapa besar kamu menyukai Berkah Lonceng?

ds:402:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Heh, well. It’s no secret that I absolutely love The Blessing!
ds:402:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Heh, yah. Bukan rahasia lagi bahwa saya sangat mencintai Berkah!

ds:402:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]You should absolutely join us for our next one, we’d love to have ya!
ds:402:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Anda harus ikut yang berikutnya, kami akan senang menyambut Anda!

ds:403:133:Dialogue Text.source: How do you like The Blessing of the Bells?
ds:403:133:Dialogue Text.target: Seberapa besar kamu menyukai Berkah Lonceng?

ds:403:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Aside from the weeks of celebration and fun times, it means a lot to me too.
ds:403:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Selain berminggu-minggu perayaan dan kesenangan, maknanya juga besar bagiku.

ds:403:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I hope you can be around for the next one! It’s a really special time!
ds:403:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Semoga kamu ada di sini saat yang berikutnya! Saat yang benar-benar istimewa!

ds:404:133:Dialogue Text.source: How do you like The Blessing of the Bells?
ds:404:133:Dialogue Text.target: Seberapa besar kamu menyukai Berkah Lonceng?

ds:404:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Um! Well, I’ve always loved it as a kid…
ds:404:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Em! Yah, sejak kecil aku selalu menyukainya…

ds:404:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But the older I get, holidays kinda… just feel a bit different…
ds:404:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Tapi makin dewasa, hari raya agak… terasa sedikit berbeda…

ds:404:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]BUT! I’ve never had a Blessing here…
ds:404:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]TAPI! Aku belum pernah merayakan Berkah di sini…

ds:404:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]So who knows! I’m looking forward to the next one!
ds:404:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Jadi siapa tahu! Aku menantikan yang berikutnya!

ds:405:268:Dialogue Text.source: How do you like The Blessing of the Bells?
ds:405:268:Dialogue Text.target: Bagaimana pendapat kalian tentang Berkah Lonceng?

ds:405:271:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Not to be too one-note or anything, but Violet and I get to parade our festive get ups!
ds:405:271:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Bukan bermaksud membahas hal yang itu-itu saja, tapi Violet dan aku bisa memamerkan pakaian perayaan kami!

ds:405:273:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We do be pulling off those reds.
ds:405:273:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kami memang cocok pakai warna merah itu.

ds:405:277:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Soal penampilan, hampir apa saja bisa kami tangani.

ds:405:279:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Sometime’s we are pulling ON some dongs!

ds:405:283:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Nah but seriously, the holidays are great.

ds:405:284:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Scarlett and Peter always host a pretty crazy party.
ds:405:284:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Scarlett dan Peter selalu mengadakan pesta yang cukup gila.

ds:406:133:Dialogue Text.source: How do you like The Blessing of the Bells?
ds:406:133:Dialogue Text.target: Seberapa besar kamu menyukai Berkah Lonceng?

ds:406:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Gosh I think it’s gotta be my favorite holiday…
ds:406:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Astaga, kurasa itu pasti hari raya favoritku…

ds:406:135:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I mean, it’s hard to beat a holiday that lasts all month, hah!
ds:406:135:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Maksudku, sulit menandingi hari raya yang berlangsung sebulan penuh, hah!

ds:406:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It’s a lot of fun and we all spend a lot of time together.
ds:406:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Seru sekali dan kami semua banyak menghabiskan waktu bersama.

ds:406:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It’s a really nice and cozy time!

ds:407:132:Dialogue Text.source: How is Penny able to carry critters all day?
ds:407:132:Dialogue Text.target: Bagaimana Penny bisa membawa penumpang seharian?

ds:407:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Well ya gotta be if you’re flyin’ around with a big ol’ bell every year!
ds:407:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Memang harus kuat kalau terbang membawa lonceng besar setiap tahun!

ds:407:149:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh shoot! That’s right, I keep forgetting!

ds:407:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]The Blessing is a big ole celebration we have during the Winter!
ds:407:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Berkah Lonceng itu perayaan besar kami saat musim dingin!

ds:407:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]For a few weeks, we decorate, give gifts, and share meals!
ds:407:151:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Selama beberapa minggu kami menghias, memberi hadiah, dan makan bersama!

ds:408:10:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But for now, let me tell you about this one!

ds:408:119:Dialogue Text.source: The dragon glanced up to see the wolf in bliss. Her back was arched, her tongue was flopping out.

ds:408:11:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Have you heard of a book called Lyllith the Dragonslayer?

ds:408:125:Dialogue Text.target: Sudah lama sang serigala tidak bersama pasangan yang benar-benar memuaskannya.

ds:408:13:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s a spinoff from a larger series called Scales And Tails. It’s a bunch of books in a low fantasy world.
ds:408:13:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Itu cerita cabang dari seri yang lebih besar, berjudul Sisik dan Ekor. Sekumpulan buku berlatar dunia fantasi dengan unsur magis yang terbatas.

ds:408:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I thought y’all were forming an angry mob to finally throw me out!
ds:408:140:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kukira kalian membentuk massa marah untuk akhirnya mengusirku!

ds:408:141:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Instead I got to hear about this hot story!
ds:408:141:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ternyata aku malah mendengar cerita panas ini!

ds:408:143:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Right? I gotta get my paws on these books!
ds:408:143:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Iya kan? Aku harus mendapatkan buku-buku ini!

ds:408:144:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh sure! Whenever Claire finishes, you can borrow that copy!
ds:408:144:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oh, tentu! Setelah Claire selesai, kamu boleh meminjam salinannya!

ds:408:146:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Thank you for sharing that with us!

ds:408:148:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Would you guys…<pause> Be interested in another story some time?
ds:408:148:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Apa kalian…<pause> Berminat mendengar cerita lain kapan-kapan?

ds:408:14:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]All the books intertwine and tell a huge epic story filled with adventure, mystery, love, and death! It’s amazing!
ds:408:14:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Semua bukunya saling terjalin dan mengisahkan cerita epik besar, penuh petualangan, misteri, cinta, dan kematian! Luar biasa!

ds:408:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Great! I’ll be sure to find something fun!

ds:408:19:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]See the title is also a play-on-words! Lyllith the Dragon SLAYER? or Lyllith the Dragon’s <bounce>LAYER!</bounce>
ds:408:19:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Judulnya juga permainan kata! Lyllith si PEMBANTAI Naga? Atau Lyllith si <bounce>PEMBELAI Naga!</bounce>

ds:408:21:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Buuuut, she’s only been with one dragon so far… <pause>There’s a slew of other creatures for sure, so…
ds:408:21:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Tapiii, sejauh ini dia baru bersama satu naga… <pause>Dengan makhluk-makhluk lain memang banyak, jadi…

ds:408:22:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Maybe that’s just hinting at what’s to come.
ds:408:22:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Mungkin itu bocoran tentang apa yang bakal keluar nanti.

ds:408:25:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So as you can guess, Lyllith is the main character…
ds:408:25:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Jadi seperti yang bisa kamu tebak, Lyllith tokoh utamanya…

ds:408:28:Dialogue Text.source: Lyllith’s a wolf! She’s badass, justice-driven, and full of mom-energy!
ds:408:28:Dialogue Text.target: Lyllith itu serigala! Dia tangguh, menjunjung keadilan, dan sangat keibuan!

ds:408:30:Dialogue Text.source: She’s a sellsword and usually frequents taverns until she finds a job.
ds:408:30:Dialogue Text.target: Dia pendekar bayaran dan biasanya mengunjungi kedai-kedai sampai mendapat pekerjaan.

ds:408:31:Dialogue Text.source: A Job… Or a partner for the night.
ds:408:31:Dialogue Text.target: Pekerjaan… Atau pasangan untuk malam itu.

ds:408:32:Dialogue Text.source: One particular night, she learns about a dragon that’s terrorizing a nearby town…
ds:408:32:Dialogue Text.target: Suatu malam, dia mendengar tentang naga yang meneror kota di dekat situ…

ds:408:34:Dialogue Text.source: Now Lyllith has taken on dragons before. They can be a bit spicy, but nothing she can’t handle.
ds:408:34:Dialogue Text.target: Nah, Lyllith pernah menghadapi naga sebelumnya. Mereka bisa agak galak, tapi tidak ada yang tak sanggup dia tangani.

ds:408:36:Dialogue Text.source: But no amount of gear could’ve prepared her for this dragon…
ds:408:36:Dialogue Text.target: Tapi perlengkapan sebanyak apa pun tidak mungkin menyiapkannya untuk naga yang satu ini…

ds:408:42:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We were just passing by and got caught up in your story!

ds:408:44:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]No no, it’s a book series I really like. I was just telling Rascal about it.
ds:408:44:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Bukan, bukan, itu seri buku yang sangat kusuka. Aku cuma menceritakannya kepada Rascal.

ds:408:45:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh that’s great! Again, don’t mind us, we’re just here to listen.
ds:408:45:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oh, bagus sekali! Sekali lagi, jangan hiraukan kami, kami cuma mau mendengarkan.

ds:408:48:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Do go on! I love hearing about how couples meet!
ds:408:48:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Lanjutkan! Aku suka mendengar bagaimana pasangan berkenalan!

ds:408:49:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ooooh! Yeah these two actually had some pretty rough beginnings!
ds:408:49:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ooooh! Ya, awal hubungan mereka berdua memang cukup sulit!

ds:408:4:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Are you ready for our book club?

ds:408:53:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well…<pause> Rivals turned co-workers…<pause> Turned co-workers with benefits?

ds:408:73:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Aw! It’s the little genuine connections that do it!

ds:409:733:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey Rascal… I know we just met, but could I ask a favor?

Jujur, aku heran kamu belum pernah mendengar tentangku.
Kukira gosip cepat menyebar di hutan…

ds:409:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ah, we’re kinda secluded up here… And I tend to keep to myself most of the times…
ds:409:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ah, di atas sini kami agak terpencil… Dan biasanya aku lebih suka menyendiri…

ds:409:751:Dialogue Text.source: Um, I can leave if you want.
ds:409:751:Dialogue Text.target: Emm, aku bisa pergi kalau kamu mau.

ds:409:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oh, no that’s ok. You just really caught me off guard.
ds:409:752:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Oh, tidak, tidak apa-apa. Aku cuma kaget sekali.

ds:409:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Nice to meet you. I see you aren’t from around here.
ds:409:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Senang berkenalan. Rupanya kamu bukan dari sekitar sini.

ds:409:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Red Panda, right? The first time I’ve seen one!

That’s right! I’ve come to experience
