ds:409:757:Dialogue Text.target:
Betul! Aku datang untuk merasakan
“cinta!” di hutan ini!

ds:409:758:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]O-Oh! Heh… Well that’s much more Melody’s department…
ds:409:758:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]O-Oh! Heh… Yah, itu lebih ke urusan Melody…

ds:409:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And you can take all the time you need until you’re ready, darling.
ds:409:765:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Dan kamu boleh mengambil waktu selama yang kamu butuhkan sampai siap, Sayang.

ds:409:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But really though, any day now would be great…
ds:409:766:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tapi sungguh, kalau bisa sesegera mungkin, itu bagus sekali…

ds:409:771:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I see you’ve met a new friend?

ds:409:776:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I had to make sure you weren’t trying to hurt my poor little Charlotte.
ds:409:776:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Harus kupastikan kamu tidak mencoba menyakiti Charlotte kecilku yang malang.

ds:409:780:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]As I’m sure you guessed, I’m Melody!
ds:409:780:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Seperti yang pasti sudah kamu tebak, aku Melody!

ds:409:781:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]We weren’t expecting guests, or I would have had tea prepared…
ds:409:781:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Kami tidak menyangka akan ada tamu, kalau tahu sudah kusiapkan teh…

ds:409:782:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Now, what can we do for you?

ds:409:783:Dialogue Text.source: Do you happen to have Finley’s Stuff?
ds:409:783:Dialogue Text.target: Apa barang-barang Finley ada di sini?

ds:409:785:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oh yes, we put his stuff in a box.
ds:409:785:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Oh, iya, barangnya kami taruh dalam kotak.

ds:409:786:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]We thought he’d come by to pick it up but…
ds:409:786:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Kami kira dia akan mampir mengambilnya, tapi…

ds:409:787:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I guess we pushed him too far…

ds:409:789:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yeaaaah we definitely took him for granted.
ds:409:789:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Iyaaa, kami memang menganggap kebaikannya sudah sewajarnya.

ds:409:790:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]See Rascal, we were a bit of a handful as roommates…
ds:409:790:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Begini, Rascal, kami agak merepotkan sebagai teman serumah…

ds:409:794:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]But we definitely could’ve tried a little harder…
ds:409:794:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Tapi yang jelas kami bisa berusaha sedikit lebih keras…

ds:409:796:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]… You know, that gives me an idea!
ds:409:796:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]… Tahu tidak, aku jadi punya ide!

ds:40:253:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hey there, Rascal! I was just out wandering!

ds:410:204:Dialogue Text.source: Oh? Looks like some adult titles?

ds:410:205:Dialogue Text.source: Ok this whole bottom section is erotic novels…
ds:410:205:Dialogue Text.target: Oke, seluruh bagian bawah ini novel erotis…

ds:410:207:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]Oh uh! Melody is pretty picky about critters going into her room.
ds:410:207:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=9]Oh, eh! Melody cukup pilih-pilih soal siapa yang boleh masuk kamarnya.

ds:410:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]She doesn’t even let me in there that often…
ds:410:208:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=10]Bahkan aku juga tidak sering diizinkan masuk…

ds:411:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Can’t wait to cook with you sometime!

ds:411:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Always happy to see you around here!

ds:412:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Rascal, darling. I haven’t seen Charlotte this excited in a while.
ds:412:747:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Rascal, Sayang. Sudah lama aku tidak melihat Charlotte sebersemangat ini.

ds:412:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Would you mind doing whatever she asks for a bit?

ds:412:749:Dialogue Text.source: I was planning on it anyways!

ds:412:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Wonderful! I’ll make it up to you somehow!

ds:412:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I can’t wait to see you go next!

ds:413:130:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Alright Rascal… I’ve got a plan, but I’ll need your help.
ds:413:130:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Baiklah, Rascal… Aku punya rencana, tapi perlu bantuanmu.

ds:413:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So, I’ve been meaning to meet the critters of the forest, right?
ds:413:132:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Jadi, aku sudah lama ingin berkenalan dengan penghuni hutan, kan?

ds:413:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And we also need to patch up our relationship with Finley, right?
ds:413:134:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Dan kami juga perlu memperbaiki hubungan dengan Finley, kan?

ds:413:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I think I have a way to do both!
ds:413:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Rasanya aku punya cara untuk melakukan keduanya!

ds:413:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But I need you to help break the ice, what do you say?
ds:413:137:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tapi aku perlu kamu membantu memecah kebekuan, bagaimana?

ds:413:141:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]No Rascal, I’m asking for your help. Please be serious!
ds:413:141:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Bukan, Rascal, aku minta bantuanmu. Tolong serius!

ds:413:144:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]See, I like to bake, and I’m pretty good if I do say so myself.
ds:413:144:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Begini, aku suka memanggang kue, dan boleh dibilang cukup mahir.

ds:413:145:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But I’m not good at meeting new folks…
ds:413:145:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tapi aku tidak pandai berkenalan dengan orang baru…

ds:413:146:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And the last time I tried, I scared them off by accident…
ds:413:146:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Dan terakhir kali mencoba, tanpa sengaja aku malah membuat mereka takut…

ds:413:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m willing and really wanting to put in the work, but if you could help me out, I’d be very grateful!
ds:413:147:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Aku mau dan sungguh ingin berusaha, tapi kalau kamu bisa membantu, aku akan sangat berterima kasih!

ds:413:148:Dialogue Text.source: Why not have Melody do it?

ds:413:149:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]She’s out going and great with people for sure… But we’re both basically strangers to the rest of the critters…
ds:413:149:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Dia memang supel dan pandai bergaul… Tapi pada dasarnya kami berdua orang asing bagi penghuni lain…

ds:413:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]This would just make things smoother, if you don’t mind!
ds:413:150:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ini akan membuat semuanya lebih lancar, kalau kamu tidak keberatan!

ds:413:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Great! Well first I need to get baking.

ds:413:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Once they are done, I’ll let you know!

ds:413:154:Dialogue Text.source:
Of course I’ll help out!
Though I might charge a cookie tax…
ds:413:154:Dialogue Text.target:
Tentu aku mau membantu!
Tapi mungkin ada pajak kukis…

ds:413:717:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Once they are done, I’ll let you know!

ds:413:718:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So why not break the ice with some extra special "friendship cookies"!
ds:413:718:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Jadi kenapa tidak memecah kebekuan dengan “kukis persahabatan” yang istimewa!

ds:414:715:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]These cookies are piping fresh and ready to go!
ds:414:715:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kukis ini baru matang, masih hangat, dan siap diantar!

ds:414:717:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh, and here’s that special one for Finley… Make sure he knows it’s from us!
ds:414:717:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oh, ini yang istimewa untuk Finley… Pastikan dia tahu ini dari kami!

ds:414:739:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Rascal, the cookies are piping fresh and ready to go!
ds:414:739:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Rascal, kukisnya baru matang, masih hangat, dan siap diantar!

ds:414:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Give that special one to Finley… Make sure he knows it’s from us!
ds:414:740:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Berikan yang istimewa itu kepada Finley… Pastikan dia tahu ini dari kami!

ds:414:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Rascal, the cookies are piping fresh and ready to go!
ds:414:754:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Rascal, kukisnya baru matang, masih hangat, dan siap diantar!

ds:414:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Be sure to give some to all the critters!

ds:415:717:Dialogue Text.source: This one’s from a new friend!

ds:415:719:Dialogue Text.source: Nope! Have ya met Charlotte and Melody?
ds:415:719:Dialogue Text.target: Bukan! Sudah bertemu Charlotte dan Melody?

ds:415:720:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ah! Yes the bear and fox up in the caves, right?
ds:415:720:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ah! Iya, beruang dan rubah di gua-gua itu, kan?

ds:415:721:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I’ve seen them here and there, but very seldomely.
ds:415:721:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Sesekali saya melihat mereka, tapi jarang sekali.

ds:415:722:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Sebenarnya saya pikir mungkin mereka sudah pindah…

ds:415:726:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Umm… Can I take a few more?

ds:416:737:Dialogue Text.source: Actually, I have something for ya!

ds:416:740:Dialogue Text.source: It is! I hope you like cookies!

ds:416:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Thanks Rascal! This is very nice of you!

ds:416:743:Dialogue Text.source:
Actually they’re from Charlotte and Melody!
I’m just the delivery boy.
ds:416:743:Dialogue Text.target:
Sebenarnya dari Charlotte dan Melody!
Aku cuma pengantar.

ds:416:744:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Oh, bagus sekali! Charlotte pandai sekali memanggang kue!

ds:416:745:Dialogue Text.source:
They wanna be more active
with the critters down here.
ds:416:745:Dialogue Text.target:
Mereka ingin lebih aktif
bergaul dengan penghuni di bawah sini.

ds:416:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m a bit familiar with them, but obviously they’re a little large to use my services.
ds:416:747:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Aku sedikit mengenal mereka, tapi jelas tubuh mereka agak terlalu besar untuk memakai jasaku.

ds:416:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And frankly, no one really goes up there - but there is a perch! That’s a part of my route!
ds:416:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Dan sejujurnya, jarang ada yang naik ke sana, tapi ada tenggeran! Itu bagian ruteku!

ds:416:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]Hmm, I don’t think I have a spare bell though… I really have to make more…
ds:416:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=11]Hmm, rasanya aku tidak punya lonceng cadangan… Harus kubuat lebih banyak…

ds:416:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]They might have a spare one up there…

ds:416:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I mean, it’s not like they use the one I gave them!
ds:416:752:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Maksudku, yang kuberikan kepada mereka juga tidak dipakai!

ds:417:737:Dialogue Text.source: Have you met Melody and Charlotte?

ds:417:738:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The polar bear and the fox gal, right?
ds:417:738:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Si beruang kutub dan perempuan rubah itu, kan?

ds:417:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But I have wanted to meet em!

ds:417:744:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I’ve got a thing for big ladies, mate!

ds:417:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]See lil’ guys like myself can uh… get in pretty deep if ya know what I’m sayin.
ds:417:745:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Begini, pria kecil sepertiku bisa eh… masuk cukup dalam, kalau kamu paham maksudku.

ds:417:746:Dialogue Text.source: I think I catch your drift.

ds:417:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anywho a guy can dream! For now, toss one of those cookies over!
ds:417:747:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Pokoknya, boleh dong bermimpi! Untuk sekarang, lemparkan satu kukis itu!

ds:417:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I gotta load up on carbs anyways, so this is perfect!
ds:417:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Lagi pula aku perlu menambah asupan karbohidrat, jadi pas sekali!

ds:418:736:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]If it isn’t Rascal! How are you dear?

ds:418:737:Dialogue Text.source:
I’m good! And I’ve got
cookies for the two of you!
ds:418:737:Dialogue Text.target:
Baik! Dan aku membawa
kukis untuk kalian berdua!

ds:418:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Hold on love! I’ll make sure they aren’t poison…

ds:418:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Of course, I’ll need to test yours as well…

ds:418:744:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]If these are poison, it’ll just be the end of me!
ds:418:744:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Kalau ini beracun, biarlah jadi akhir hidupku!

ds:418:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Also, how dare you insinuate our lil’ Rascal would poison us!
ds:418:745:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Lagi pula, beraninya kamu menyiratkan Rascal kecil kita akan meracuni kita!

ds:418:746:Dialogue Text.source: Actually they aren’t made by me!

ds:418:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ll have to ask her for the recipe!

ds:418:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Mm, yes! It’s that depth of savory, but the hint of salty…
ds:418:752:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Mm, iya! Gurihnya begitu kaya, tapi ada sentuhan asin…

ds:418:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m going to tell her you’re making these jokes.
ds:418:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Akan kubilang kepadanya kamu membuat lelucon ini.

ds:418:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]… Maybe there’s rabbit in these cookies…
ds:418:757:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]… Mungkin ada kelinci di dalam kukis ini…

ds:418:761:Dialogue Text.source: Do you two know Charlotte and Melody?

ds:418:763:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ah yes! The critters up North. They don’t frequent these parts too often.
ds:418:763:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ah, iya! Penghuni di utara itu. Mereka tidak terlalu sering ke sekitar sini.

ds:418:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ve always wanted to make a trek up there and meet them. But it’s awfully cold up there!
ds:418:765:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sudah lama aku ingin naik dan berkenalan dengan mereka. Tapi di sana dingin sekali!

ds:418:767:Dialogue Text.source: Claire and Violet knitted me a sweater.
ds:418:767:Dialogue Text.target: Claire dan Violet merajutkan sweter untukku.

ds:418:769:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh! I bet you’re absolutely adorable in it!

ds:418:773:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Funny thing about those critters up north…
ds:418:773:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ada cerita lucu tentang penghuni di utara itu…

ds:418:774:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I haven’t met them, but I was out scavenging, and the bear… Charlotte, was it?
ds:418:774:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Aku belum berkenalan dengan mereka, tapi waktu mencari barang, si beruang… Charlotte, ya?

ds:418:775:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]She’s awfully quiet for how large she is!
ds:418:775:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Gerakannya senyap sekali untuk tubuh sebesar itu!

ds:418:776:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]She managed to sneak up on me, and I ended up having a bit of a fright!
ds:418:776:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Dia berhasil mendekat tanpa ketahuan, dan aku jadi agak ketakutan!

ds:418:777:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I didn’t quite realize who it was, so I bolted.
ds:418:777:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Aku belum sadar siapa dia, jadi langsung kabur.

ds:418:778:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It dawned on me later, but I never got the chance to mention it! It’d be a laugh now!
ds:418:778:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Baru kusadari kemudian, tapi belum sempat kuceritakan! Sekarang pasti lucu!

ds:418:780:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]That’s right! You had quite a fright that day.

ds:418:782:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s not every day you see a bear in the woods!
ds:418:782:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tidak setiap hari melihat beruang di hutan!

ds:418:788:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]… Or, did she poison these cookies to finish the job?!
ds:418:788:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]… Atau dia meracuni kukis ini untuk menuntaskan pekerjaannya?!

ds:419:736:Dialogue Text.source:
I’m delivering cookies!
Here ya go!

ds:419:739:Dialogue Text.source: This seems like a good problem to have.

ds:419:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I can’t possibly eat this much! It’ll take a week to finish it!
ds:419:740:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Mustahil aku makan sebanyak ini! Seminggu baru habis!

ds:419:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Break me off a piece. You can have the rest of mine.
ds:419:741:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Patahkan sedikit untukku. Sisanya boleh kamu ambil.

ds:419:743:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Who made these? A frickin’ bear or something?
ds:419:743:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Siapa yang membuat ini? Beruang atau apa, sih?

ds:419:744:Dialogue Text.source:
Yes actually! Have you
met Charlotte and Melody?
ds:419:744:Dialogue Text.target:
Sebenarnya iya! Sudah bertemu
Charlotte dan Melody?

ds:419:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I haven’t! But I have heard about them.
ds:419:745:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Belum! Tapi aku sudah mendengar tentang mereka.

ds:419:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Wow, and they can bake? Oh these are great too!
ds:419:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Wah, dan mereka bisa memanggang? Oh, ini juga enak sekali!

ds:419:749:Dialogue Text.source: Yep! They want to meet everyone.
ds:419:749:Dialogue Text.target: Yap! Mereka ingin berkenalan dengan semua orang.

ds:419:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well they’re off to a great start! Gosh these cookies are killer!
ds:419:750:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Yah, awal mereka bagus sekali! Astaga, kukisnya dahsyat!

ds:41:200:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Perfect timing! I’ve been bored as hell.
ds:41:200:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Pas sekali! Aku sudah bosan setengah mati.

ds:41:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I see you’ve also met our boy, Ollie!
ds:41:208:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Rupanya kamu sudah bertemu teman kami, Ollie!

ds:41:214:Dialogue Text.source: Claire/Violet both (Only have the dialogue once, with both of their portraits)
ds:41:214:Dialogue Text.target: Claire/Violet both (Only have the dialogue once, with both of their portraits)

ds:41:222:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Haha, we’re fuck buddies. He’s always so bashful about it. It’s adorable.
ds:41:222:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Haha, kami teman entot. Dia selalu malu-malu soal itu. Manis sekali.

ds:41:224:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Claire, You’re gonna scare this new guy off.
ds:41:224:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Claire, nanti orang baru ini kabur ketakutan.

ds:41:226:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]C’mon Vi, You can smell it, this boy’s been up to a lot already!
ds:41:226:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Ayolah, Vi, kamu bisa mencium baunya. Pria ini sudah banyak beraksi!

ds:41:228:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Of course I can smell it, I’m just being polite.
ds:41:228:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tentu aku bisa mencium baunya, aku cuma berusaha sopan.

ds:41:230:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]We’ll just see what the new guy thinks.
ds:41:230:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kita lihat saja apa pendapat orang baru ini.

ds:41:231:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]How about it new guy, are we scaring you?

ds:41:236:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh come on Vi, he’s clearly messing with us.
ds:41:236:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Ayolah, Vi, jelas dia cuma mengerjai kita.

ds:41:239:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That’s what I’m talking about! Look at him, this guy’s GOT it.
ds:41:239:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Nah, begitu dong! Lihat dia, pria ini memang HEBAT.

ds:41:241:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Say… You came at a pretty good time.
ds:41:241:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ngomong-ngomong… Kamu datang di saat yang tepat.

ds:41:242:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Maybe you can help us figure something out…
ds:41:242:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Mungkin kamu bisa membantu kami memecahkan sesuatu…

ds:41:247:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Haha, I don’t think so Vi, he’s already agreed to help us.
ds:41:247:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Haha, tidak bisa, Vi, dia sudah setuju membantu kita.

ds:41:252:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Which one of us would make you cum faster?
ds:41:252:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Siapa di antara kami yang bisa membuatmu keluar lebih cepat?

ds:41:254:Dialogue Text.source: Only one way to find out…
ds:41:254:Dialogue Text.target: Cuma ada satu cara untuk tahu…

ds:41:292:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Whew! I’m beat. Thanks for being the judge there.
ds:41:292:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Huh! Aku kelelahan. Terima kasih sudah jadi juri tadi.

ds:420:736:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Huh? For me? Aren’t I the one who handles deliveries?
ds:420:736:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Hah? Untukku? Bukankah aku yang mengurus kiriman?

ds:420:741:Dialogue Text.source: Do you know Charlotte and Melody?

ds:420:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yeah, the fox and bear up north?

ds:420:743:Dialogue Text.source:
That’s right! They wanna be more
friendly and active with you guys.
ds:420:743:Dialogue Text.target:
Betul! Mereka ingin lebih
akrab dan aktif bergaul dengan kalian.

ds:420:744:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That’d be great! I’d love to see them more often!
ds:420:744:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Bagus sekali! Aku senang kalau bisa lebih sering bertemu mereka!

ds:420:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Mmm~ These cookies rock too! Top tier cookies if I do say so myself.
ds:420:745:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Mmm~ Kukisnya juga mantap! Kukis kelas atas, menurutku.

ds:420:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Remember that camera I was fiddling with?

ds:420:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well it’s good to go! Let me know if you meet any critters that might wanna do some modeling!
ds:420:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Nah, sudah siap dipakai! Bilang kalau kamu bertemu siapa pun yang mungkin mau jadi model!

ds:420:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Maybe Charlotte or Melody would be interested!

ds:420:753:Dialogue Text.source:
Isn’t that a little too forward
for new critters?
ds:420:753:Dialogue Text.target:
Bukankah itu agak terlalu terus terang
untuk orang yang baru dikenal?

ds:420:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Folks don’t live around these parts and expect paid dinner and three dates!
ds:420:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Orang tinggal di sekitar sini bukan untuk menunggu ditraktir makan malam dan tiga kali kencan!

ds:420:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I’m sure you’ve realized that by now!

ds:420:758:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Atta’ boy! And gimme another cookie before you leave!
ds:420:758:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Nah, begitu dong! Dan beri aku kukis lagi sebelum pergi!

ds:421:740:Dialogue Text.source: Do you know Charlotte and Melody?

ds:421:742:Dialogue Text.source:
They live up north, but they haven’t
really come down here that often.
ds:421:742:Dialogue Text.target:
Mereka tinggal di utara, tapi
jarang turun ke sini.

ds:421:744:Dialogue Text.source:
They wanted to be neighborly!
Break the ice, so to speak.
ds:421:744:Dialogue Text.target:
Mereka ingin menjalin hubungan baik!
Bisa dibilang memecah kebekuan.

ds:421:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oooh I shoulda done that! Everyone likes food!
ds:421:745:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oooh, seharusnya kulakukan itu! Semua suka makanan!

ds:421:746:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Gosh, it’s a little hard for someone like me to cook though…
ds:421:746:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Tapi astaga, agak sulit bagi orang sepertiku untuk memasak…

ds:421:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]They seem like nice critters! I’ll be looking forward to meeting them!
ds:421:747:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Sepertinya mereka baik! Aku menantikan pertemuan dengan mereka!

ds:421:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh… And… Can I have another cookie?

ds:422:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]… Hmm, no. I smell other critters on him… Melody?
ds:422:740:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]… Hmm, bukan. Ada bau orang lain padanya… Melody?

ds:422:743:Dialogue Text.source: Yep, that’s right! You know them?

ds:422:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]We don’t really know her roommate, Charlotte. But we DO know her baking!
ds:422:747:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kami tidak terlalu mengenal teman serumahnya, Charlotte. Tapi kami TAHU kue buatannya!

ds:422:748:Dialogue Text.source:
They wanna get to know
the critters around here.
ds:422:748:Dialogue Text.target:
Mereka ingin berkenalan
dengan penghuni sekitar sini.

ds:422:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That’s great! We’ve been trying to egg them on to do it for a while.
ds:422:750:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Bagus sekali! Sudah cukup lama kami mendorong mereka melakukannya.

ds:422:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But Finley used to be roommates with them. We’d all hang every so often.
ds:422:754:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Tapi dulu Finley teman serumah mereka. Sesekali kami semua berkumpul.

ds:422:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We’ll also join Melody on her excursions!

ds:422:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Those were usually to other parts of the forest though. Not in this neighborhood.
ds:422:757:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Tapi biasanya ke bagian hutan lain. Bukan daerah ini.

ds:422:760:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We’d go looking for random one night flings.
ds:422:760:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kami mencari teman bercinta semalam secara acak.

ds:422:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]You should join us if we ever go again!
ds:422:766:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kamu harus ikut kalau nanti kami pergi lagi!

ds:423:738:Dialogue Text.source:
And Charlotte made cookies!
This one’s for you specifically.
ds:423:738:Dialogue Text.target:
Dan Charlotte membuat kukis!
Yang ini khusus untukmu.

ds:423:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oooh, man, I do miss her baking…

ds:423:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Aw look, it says "We’re Sorry" heh… Looks like they’re trying, eh?
ds:423:741:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Aw, lihat, ada tulisan "We’re Sorry", kami minta maaf, heh… Kelihatannya mereka berusaha, ya?

ds:423:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oooh, and look here, they cleaned all my belongings!
ds:423:742:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Oooh, lihat ini, semua barang-barangku sudah mereka bersihkan!

ds:423:743:Dialogue Text.target: Memangnya apa yang terjadi antara kalian?

ds:423:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well, not all critters have the same standards I suppose!
ds:423:747:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Yah, kurasa standar tiap penghuni memang berbeda-beda!

ds:423:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It was a weird lesson to learn, and we never really… concluded it too well together.
ds:423:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Itu pelajaran yang aneh, dan kami tak pernah benar-benar… menyelesaikannya dengan baik bersama-sama.

ds:423:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]In the heat of the moment, it was very aggravating, but now I can see that not all critters are compatible in terms of living situations.
ds:423:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Saat emosi sedang tinggi, rasanya sangat menyebalkan, tapi sekarang aku paham bahwa tidak semua penghuni cocok tinggal bersama.

ds:423:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]On the surface, it was mainly that they were really messy…
ds:423:752:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Sekilas, masalah utamanya karena mereka sangat berantakan…

ds:423:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Clothes and trash on the floor. Kitchen a total mess.
ds:423:753:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Pakaian dan sampah di lantai. Dapur kacau balau.

ds:423:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I was the one cleaning most of it, and I have hooves! Not an easy task!
ds:423:754:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Aku yang membersihkan sebagian besarnya, padahal aku punya kuku belah! Bukan pekerjaan mudah!

ds:423:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Melody would even borrow my gear and forget to clean it! Yuck!
ds:423:755:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Melody bahkan suka meminjam perlengkapanku lalu lupa membersihkannya! Ih!

ds:423:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But what it really seemed to be, was a lack of respect. To me and their living space.
ds:423:756:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tapi akar masalahnya, rasanya, adalah kurangnya rasa hormat. Padaku dan pada tempat tinggal mereka.

ds:423:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I mean, you were up there, right? You probably saw the mess.
ds:423:757:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Maksudku, kamu sudah ke atas sana, kan? Pasti kamu melihat berantakannya.

ds:423:761:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Really?? And the clothes on the floor?

ds:423:762:Dialogue Text.source:
There was a clothing rack.
Didn’t see much on the floor.
ds:423:762:Dialogue Text.target:
Ada rak pakaian.
Tak banyak yang kulihat di lantai.

ds:423:763:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]And Charlottes books? Those had to be around right?

ds:423:764:Dialogue Text.source:
Nope, on a book case.
Alphabetized I believe.
ds:423:764:Dialogue Text.target:
Tidak, di rak buku.
Sepertinya diurutkan menurut abjad.

ds:423:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Hah. Of course. They get their act together once I’m gone.
ds:423:765:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Hah. Tentu saja. Baru setelah aku pergi mereka mulai membenahi diri.

ds:423:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ah well, at least they seemed to have taken my complaints seriously…
ds:423:766:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ah, sudahlah, setidaknya sepertinya mereka menanggapi keluhanku dengan serius…

ds:423:768:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well. It’s not very becoming of me to let these petty things stack up and ruin some friendships. I should go talk to them.
ds:423:768:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Yah. Tidak pantas rasanya kubiarkan hal-hal sepele ini menumpuk dan merusak persahabatan. Aku harus bicara dengan mereka.

ds:424:734:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oooh! Now what do we have here?

ds:424:737:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh! Gosh, I probably shouldn’t… I’ve eaten a lot of sweets lately…
ds:424:737:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oh! Astaga, mungkin sebaiknya tidak… Belakangan ini aku banyak makan manis…

ds:424:738:Dialogue Text.source: Oh but these are friendship cookies!

ds:424:739:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh I see! Well then of course there’s room for a friendship cookie!
ds:424:739:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Oh, begitu! Kalau begitu tentu masih ada tempat untuk kukis persahabatan!

ds:424:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I didn’t peg you as a baker!

ds:424:741:Dialogue Text.source:
That’s because I’m not! These are
from the critters in the mountains!
ds:424:741:Dialogue Text.target:
Karena memang bukan! Ini
dari penghuni di pegunungan!

ds:424:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ah what was their names… Medley… Charlene?

ds:424:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ah yes! That’s right. I did some work for them a bit ago.
ds:424:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ah, iya! Betul. Aku pernah mengerjakan sesuatu untuk mereka belum lama ini.

ds:424:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Some of my finer work! And it was my first time working in ice too! Tricky stuff!
ds:424:750:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Salah satu karya terbaikku! Juga pertama kalinya aku mengerjakan es! Bahan yang sulit!

ds:424:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I wonder if that’s still holding up…

ds:424:754:Dialogue Text.source: Ok, I gotta go deliver more cookies.
ds:424:754:Dialogue Text.target: Oke, aku harus mengantar lebih banyak kukis.

ds:424:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Sounds good! Pass my compliments to the chef!

ds:424:761:Dialogue Text.source:
Didn’t you say something about
having too many sweets lately?
ds:424:761:Dialogue Text.target:
Bukankah tadi kamu bilang
belakangan ini terlalu banyak makan manis?

ds:424:763:Dialogue Text.source:
Well there’s always room
for Friendship Cookies!
ds:424:763:Dialogue Text.target:
Yah, selalu ada tempat
untuk Kukis Persahabatan!

ds:424:764:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Haha that’s right! I’ll be sure to savor this one!
ds:424:764:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Haha, betul! Yang ini pasti kunikmati baik-baik!

ds:425:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Rascal, darling! Give me a few minutes and I’ll track down Finley’s stuff.
ds:425:152:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Rascal, Sayang! Beri aku beberapa menit untuk mencari barang-barang Finley.

ds:425:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Rascal, darling! Give me a few minutes and I’ll track down Finley’s stuff.
ds:425:153:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Rascal, Sayang! Beri aku beberapa menit untuk mencari barang-barang Finley.

ds:426:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Rascal, darling! Give me a few minutes and I’ll gather up Finley’s stuff.
ds:426:152:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Rascal, Sayang! Beri aku beberapa menit untuk mengumpulkan barang-barang Finley.

ds:427:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Here you go, darling! This box should be everything Finley left up here.
ds:427:152:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ini dia, Sayang! Mestinya semua barang yang Finley tinggalkan di sini ada dalam kotak ini.

ds:428:737:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yes, we took you for granted and were just terrible roommates!
ds:428:737:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Iya, kami kurang menghargaimu dan memang teman serumah yang payah!

ds:428:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Now now, I also have my fair share of the blame. I’ve never been good at confronting these things…
ds:428:742:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Sudah, sudah, aku juga punya andil dalam kesalahan ini. Aku tak pernah pandai menghadapi masalah seperti ini…

ds:428:743:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I should have tried to communicate more before things blew up.
ds:428:743:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Seharusnya aku berusaha lebih banyak berkomunikasi sebelum semuanya meledak.

ds:428:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]But if we didn’t suck, you wouldn’t have to communicate!
ds:428:745:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Tapi kalau kami tidak payah, kamu tidak perlu berkomunikasi!

ds:428:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]And we’re sorry we left things like this for so long.
ds:428:748:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Dan maaf karena kami membiarkan keadaan seperti ini begitu lama.

ds:428:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]We felt awful after you left, and we weren’t sure how to make it up to you…
ds:428:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Kami merasa bersalah sekali setelah kamu pergi, dan tak tahu bagaimana menebusnya padamu…

ds:428:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]All we could do was hear your words and try to do better…
ds:428:750:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Yang bisa kami lakukan hanya mendengarkan ucapanmu dan berusaha lebih baik…

ds:428:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]But we never knew how to fix things…
ds:428:751:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=8]Tapi kami tak pernah tahu cara memperbaiki hubungan kita…

ds:428:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It’s fine it’s fine. I should have come up sooner honestly.
ds:428:753:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tidak apa-apa, tidak apa-apa. Sejujurnya aku yang seharusnya datang lebih awal.

ds:428:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Does… Does this mean you’ll come back?
ds:428:756:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Apa… Apa itu berarti kamu akan kembali?

ds:428:758:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Uhhh! Well. I think we all learned some important things about ourselves…
ds:428:758:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Ehhh! Yah. Kurasa kita semua sudah belajar hal-hal penting tentang diri masing-masing…

ds:428:759:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I think it’d be best for me to be on my own for now…
ds:428:759:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Kurasa untuk sekarang lebih baik aku tinggal sendiri dulu…

ds:428:763:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]But… How about we do dinner together?
ds:428:763:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Tapi… Bagaimana kalau kita makan malam bersama?

ds:428:764:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve got some new recipes I bet you two would enjoy.
ds:428:764:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Aku punya beberapa resep baru yang kurasa kalian berdua bakal suka.

ds:428:768:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That sounds wonderful, Finley. We’ll happily have you over whenever you want.
ds:428:768:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kedengarannya menyenangkan, Finley. Kami senang menerima kunjunganmu kapan pun kamu mau.

ds:428:771:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh uh. So I see you two have met Rascal, yeah?
ds:428:771:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oh, eh. Jadi rupanya kalian berdua sudah kenal Rascal, ya?

ds:428:773:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yes we have! Come on over dear, we see you!

ds:429:716:Dialogue Text.source: Sorry, I didn’t mean to intrude!

ds:429:718:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]On the contrary, dear! I think we owe you one for helping us patch things up!
ds:429:718:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Justru sebaliknya, Sayang! Rasanya kami berutang budi karena kamu membantu kami berbaikan!

ds:429:719:Dialogue Text.source:
Pretty sure that was
the magic of Charlotte’s cookies.
ds:429:719:Dialogue Text.target:
Aku cukup yakin itu
keajaiban kukis Charlotte.

ds:429:721:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]That’s true, I’m really just here for more cookies.
ds:429:721:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Benar, sebenarnya aku ke sini cuma mau kukis lagi.

ds:429:723:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ah! I knew it. I can’t blame you.

ds:429:725:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Heh, yes yes, my cookies are great.

ds:429:726:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But what is a cookie without a delivery service! That was all you Rascal!
ds:429:726:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tapi apa artinya kukis tanpa layanan pengantaran! Itu semua jasamu, Rascal!

ds:429:727:Dialogue Text.source:
That’s true.
I am a miracle worker.

ds:429:730:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh! To thank Rascal, we should have him join us for dinner sometime!
ds:429:730:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oh! Untuk berterima kasih, kapan-kapan kita harus mengajak Rascal makan malam bersama!

ds:429:736:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Hey uh Melody… regarding the toys you were borrowing…
ds:429:736:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Hei, eh, Melody… soal mainan yang kamu pinjam…

ds:429:737:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Forgive me for asking, but I’m awfully curious. Did the big one fit?
ds:429:737:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Maaf bertanya, tapi aku penasaran sekali. Yang besar muat?

ds:429:739:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh? Quite the nosy one Finley! I can’t believe you’d ask a gal something so personal…
ds:429:739:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Oh? Ingin tahu sekali, Finley! Tidak percaya kamu menanyakan hal sepribadi itu kepada perempuan…

ds:429:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Haha, ok cut the coy act! You know you’re doing that just because Rascal is here.
ds:429:741:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Haha, sudah, jangan pura-pura malu! Kamu tahu kamu begitu cuma karena Rascal di sini.

ds:429:743:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]There’s no impression like the first impression, darling…

ds:429:744:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But yes. I hilted the whole thing.

ds:429:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But really, for however small of a part you had to play, we thank you.
ds:429:749:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tapi sungguh, sekecil apa pun peranmu, kami berterima kasih.

ds:429:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ok for real though, where are those cookies?

ds:42:198:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh! Are those for me? That was fast!

ds:42:202:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]A deals a deal! Let me know when you’d like me to take you across the field!
ds:42:202:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Janji tetap janji! Bilang saja kapan kamu ingin kuantar menyeberangi padang!

ds:430:714:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey! How did the cookie delivery go?

ds:430:715:Dialogue Text.source:
It went great!
Everyone loved them!

ds:430:717:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Do you think it broke the ice enough?

ds:430:718:Dialogue Text.source:
I’m not sure… you might need to
make more cookies to convince some…
ds:430:718:Dialogue Text.target:
Aku kurang yakin… mungkin perlu
lebih banyak kukis untuk meyakinkan beberapa orang…

ds:430:720:Dialogue Text.source:
No I’m just kidding.
Everyone’s very excited to meet you!
ds:430:720:Dialogue Text.target:
Tidak, aku cuma bercanda.
Semua senang sekali ingin bertemu kamu!

ds:430:721:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oooh right... I guess the next step is to actually meet them...
ds:430:721:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oooh, benar... Kurasa langkah berikutnya benar-benar menemui mereka...

ds:430:723:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ahhh! I'm not super great with meeting a lot of new critters at once...
ds:430:723:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ahhh! Aku tidak terlalu pandai bertemu banyak orang baru sekaligus...

ds:430:725:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I’ve just got a lot of insecurities and anxieties…
ds:430:725:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Aku cuma punya banyak rasa tidak percaya diri dan kecemasan…

ds:430:726:Dialogue Text.source:
Absolutely. The critters are
very excited to meet you!
ds:430:726:Dialogue Text.target:
Tentu. Para penghuni
senang sekali ingin bertemu kamu!

ds:430:727:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m sure I can keep them in check, but I’m definitely nervous!
ds:430:727:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Aku yakin bisa mengendalikannya, tapi jelas aku gugup!

ds:430:728:Dialogue Text.source:
Honestly, the critters are very talkative.
You could probably just listen and
nod your head and they’ll love you.
ds:430:728:Dialogue Text.target:
Jujur, para penghuni banyak bicara.
Mungkin kamu cukup mendengarkan dan
mengangguk, mereka pasti menyukaimu.

ds:430:730:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ll try to prepare myself mentally for now!
ds:430:730:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Untuk sekarang, aku coba siapkan mental dulu!

ds:430:731:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Then we can do the next step later…
ds:430:731:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Lalu langkah berikutnya bisa kita lakukan nanti…

ds:431:715:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Rascal Darling, what can I do for you?

ds:431:716:Dialogue Text.source:
I couldn’t help but notice the clothes.
Would you like to model them?

ds:431:718:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Sure! Give me a second to get dressed!

ds:431:719:Dialogue Text.source:
Actually not for me. For a friend.
They’ve got a camera and
wanted to give it a run.
ds:431:719:Dialogue Text.target:
Sebenarnya bukan untukku. Untuk teman.
Dia punya kamera dan
ingin mencobanya.

ds:431:723:Dialogue Text.source:
Oh nothing like that. I think it’s mainly
for fun and to mess with the camera.
ds:431:723:Dialogue Text.target:
Oh, bukan begitu. Kurasa terutama
untuk bersenang-senang dan mencoba kameranya.

ds:431:725:Dialogue Text.source:
Pretty sure it might be explicit as well…
If you’re OK with that.
ds:431:725:Dialogue Text.target:
Sepertinya mungkin akan vulgar juga…
Kalau kamu tidak keberatan.

ds:431:726:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh why didn’t you say so, darling!
ds:431:726:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oh, kenapa tidak bilang dari tadi, Sayang!

ds:431:727:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I won’t turn down an opportunity like that!

ds:431:728:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ve got just the things I’ve been meaning to wear for such an occasion!
ds:431:728:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ada pakaian yang memang ingin kupakai untuk kesempatan seperti ini!

ds:431:730:Dialogue Text.source: Maverick. He’s the town shop keep.
ds:431:730:Dialogue Text.target: Maverick. Dia pemilik toko di kota.

ds:431:731:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Ah yes, I’m familiar with him. Perfect!

ds:431:732:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Give me a moment to get ready, and we can be on our way!
ds:431:732:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tunggu sebentar aku bersiap, lalu kita bisa berangkat!

ds:431:735:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Give me a moment to get ready, and we can be on our way!
ds:431:735:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tunggu sebentar aku bersiap, lalu kita bisa berangkat!

ds:432:716:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Melody’s in the back, she was asking if you were going to join us.
ds:432:716:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Melody di belakang. Dia tadi tanya apa kamu ikut bergabung.

ds:432:719:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]We just finished up the clothed portion! I’ll show ya them later, some really nice shots!
ds:432:719:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Kami baru selesai bagian berpakaian! Nanti kutunjukkan, beberapa fotonya bagus sekali!

ds:432:720:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But now we’re moving onto the spicy stuff, so I’m grabbing the video camera!
ds:432:720:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tapi sekarang beralih ke bagian panas, jadi aku mengambil kamera video!

ds:432:721:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Do you wanna use the photo camera?

ds:432:723:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Great! Grab that camera and come on back!
ds:432:723:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Bagus! Ambil kamera itu lalu masuk ke belakang!

ds:433:718:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Indeed, everything appears to be in order!

ds:434:716:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Just ask Peter! I haven’t stopped talking about them!
ds:434:716:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tanya Peter saja! Aku tidak berhenti membicarakannya!

ds:434:719:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I think she’s fallen out of love with me, and in love with those cookies.
ds:434:719:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Rasanya dia sudah tidak cinta padaku, malah jatuh cinta pada kukis itu.

ds:434:724:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]She’s too good for me anyways. It was only a matter of time…
ds:434:724:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Lagi pula dia terlalu baik untukku. Tinggal menunggu waktu…

ds:434:726:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hehe! Another marriage ended by my magnificent cookies…
ds:434:726:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Hehe! Satu lagi pernikahan yang kandas karena kukisku yang luar biasa…

ds:434:729:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]GOSH, I just love how huge you are!
ds:434:729:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]ASTAGA, aku suka sekali tubuhmu yang besar ini!

ds:434:734:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Mabel dear, that’s a bit rude, don’t ya think?
ds:434:734:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Mabel, Sayang, bukankah itu agak tidak sopan?

ds:434:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So tell us about yourself, Charlotte. What do you like to do?
ds:434:742:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Jadi ceritakan tentang dirimu, Charlotte. Kamu suka melakukan apa?

ds:434:744:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ooh, well, aside from baking. I really like reading!
ds:434:744:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Ooh, yah, selain memanggang kue, aku sangat suka membaca!

ds:434:746:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ya don’t say? What kind of reading?

ds:434:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Mostly novels and stories… Like, fantasy stuff.

ds:434:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Augustus is our fellow book worm here. He’s by the lake! I’ll introduce you!
ds:434:751:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Augustus juga kutu buku di sini. Dia di danau! Nanti kukenalkan!

ds:434:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So Charlotte! What’s your secret for those cookies?

ds:434:768:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]*Gasp*! Was I the side piece the whole time??
ds:434:768:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]*Terkesiap*! Apa selama ini aku cuma selingkuhan??

ds:434:771:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I think I may have… scared the crap out of your husband a while ago…
ds:434:771:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Rasanya mungkin aku pernah… membuat suamimu ketakutan setengah mati…

ds:434:773:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Gosh! Look at the view from up here!

ds:434:774:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Is this what it’s like to be tall?

ds:434:779:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yep, that was me! Fleeing at top speed with my tail between my legs.
ds:434:779:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Yap, itu aku! Kabur sekencang mungkin dengan ekor terjepit di antara kaki.

ds:434:783:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hehe, I’m sorry, that was a hilarious day!

ds:434:785:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m glad my trauma can be your pleasure.

ds:434:786:Dialogue Text.source:
Charlotte! Are these ferocious
critters bothering you??
ds:434:786:Dialogue Text.target:
Charlotte! Para makhluk buas ini
mengganggumu??

ds:434:788:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yes officer, they’re hassling me for my baking secrets!
ds:434:788:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Iya, Pak Polisi, mereka mengusikku untuk mendapatkan rahasia kueku!

ds:434:789:Dialogue Text.source:
I see… Well… I can probably help
you out… for some cookies…
ds:434:789:Dialogue Text.target:
Begitu… Yah… Mungkin bisa kubantu…
kalau diberi kukis…

ds:434:792:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Leluconnya cukup dulu, Melody sudah pergi lebih dulu.

ds:434:793:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I think she wanted to familiarize herself with the setting.
ds:434:793:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kurasa dia ingin membiasakan diri dengan tempatnya.

ds:435:19:Dialogue Text.source: A bunch of paperwork and receipts. Organized by date.
ds:435:19:Dialogue Text.target: Sekumpulan dokumen dan kuitansi. Disusun menurut tanggal.

ds:435:21:Dialogue Text.source: A huge stack of provisions! Looks mostly like food.
ds:435:21:Dialogue Text.target: Tumpukan perbekalan besar! Kebanyakan tampak seperti makanan.

ds:435:23:Dialogue Text.source: Locked tight! What could be inside?

ds:435:25:Dialogue Text.source: They look quite healthy! Seems like they were recently watered too.
ds:435:25:Dialogue Text.target: Kelihatannya sehat sekali! Sepertinya juga baru disiram.

ds:436:34:Dialogue Text.source: Plush, comfy, and oddly well lit… You get the feeling this bed gets a lot of use…
ds:436:34:Dialogue Text.target: Empuk, nyaman, dan anehnya diterangi dengan baik… Rasanya ranjang ini sering dipakai…

ds:436:36:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oy! Don’t touch the set! It’s for actors only…
ds:436:36:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oi! Jangan sentuh setnya! Khusus para aktor…

ds:436:37:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]We can do a shoot for you some other time, dear.
ds:436:37:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Lain waktu kita bisa melakukan pemotretan untukmu, Sayang.

ds:436:42:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]You have no idea what I had to do to get those!
ds:436:42:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kamu tidak tahu apa yang harus kulakukan untuk mendapatkannya!

ds:436:44:Dialogue Text.source: This is some seriously professional equipment.

ds:436:47:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]That costs more than my left nut!

ds:436:51:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m watchin’ ya, Red, don’t think you can pocket any of that!
ds:436:51:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Aku mengawasimu, Merah, jangan kira kamu bisa mengantongi itu!

ds:436:55:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I make a mean daiquri, Red. Remind me to make ya one later.
ds:436:55:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Aku jago membuat daiquiri, Merah. Ingatkan aku untuk membuatkanmu nanti.

ds:437:716:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Alright! I’m all good to go here.

ds:438:715:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Rascal darling, I’m so glad you could join us!
ds:438:715:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Rascal, Sayang, aku senang sekali kamu bisa ikut!

ds:438:716:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Are you ready to get up close and personal with yours truly?

ds:438:717:Dialogue Text.source: Actually give me just a moment…

ds:438:719:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]How’s your end Maverick? Are you ready?

ds:439:716:Dialogue Text.source: Great. Let me get into position…

ds:439:717:Dialogue Text.source: Ok, I’m gonna get a lil warmed up first.

ds:439:718:Dialogue Text.source: Just get myself nice and wet… Are you getting this?

ds:439:723:Dialogue Text.source: Rascal darling, pass me that toy behind you.
ds:439:723:Dialogue Text.target: Rascal, Sayang, tolong berikan mainan di belakangmu itu.

ds:439:725:Dialogue Text.source: Let me just position this… Riiiight there.
ds:439:725:Dialogue Text.target: Biar kuatur letaknya… Teeepat di situ.

ds:439:732:Dialogue Text.source: Then the show must go on!

ds:439:735:Dialogue Text.source: Now you guys should have a pretty good view of all the action!
ds:439:735:Dialogue Text.target: Sekarang mestinya kalian bisa melihat semua aksinya dengan jelas!

ds:439:736:Dialogue Text.source: Make sure to get in close, Rascal…

ds:439:742:Dialogue Text.source: *Fade into animation 3 with her licking herself. JUST licking*
ds:439:742:Dialogue Text.target: *Fade into animation 3 with her licking herself. JUST licking*

ds:439:746:Dialogue Text.source: Oh Rascal, honey, the cap is still on.
ds:439:746:Dialogue Text.target: Oh, Rascal, Sayang, tutup lensanya masih terpasang.

ds:439:749:Dialogue Text.source: *Fade into Loop 1 - This is the one where she’s like, kinda just tapping her cooch*
ds:439:749:Dialogue Text.target: *Fade into Loop 1 - This is the one where she’s like, kinda just tapping her cooch*

ds:439:753:Dialogue Text.source: Mmmm, perfect timing… I’m getting quite warmed up now…
ds:439:753:Dialogue Text.target: Mmmm, pas sekali… Sekarang aku mulai cukup panas…

ds:439:754:Dialogue Text.source: *Fade to second loop* This is the one where Melody is riding the dildo
ds:439:754:Dialogue Text.target: *Fade to second loop* This is the one where Melody is riding the dildo

ds:439:758:Dialogue Text.source: Nnng, this is one of my favorite toys.
ds:439:758:Dialogue Text.target: Nnng, ini salah satu mainan favoritku.

ds:439:761:Dialogue Text.source: Oh ho, you get a lot of use out of that one?
ds:439:761:Dialogue Text.target: Oh, ho, yang itu sering kamu pakai?

ds:439:764:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh yeah, this is good stuff…

ds:439:769:Dialogue Text.source: Think you can uh… suckle it a lil’ bit?

ds:439:772:Dialogue Text.source: *Transition to Full loop, including the lick AND suckle.*
ds:439:772:Dialogue Text.target: *Transition to Full loop, including the lick AND suckle.*

ds:439:774:Dialogue Text.source: Let me pick up the pace, let’s see if I can squirt for the camera!
ds:439:774:Dialogue Text.target: Aku percepat temponya, kita lihat apa aku bisa muncrat di depan kamera!

ds:439:775:Dialogue Text.source: *Loop 2 - This is the one where she is more aggressively rubbing.*
ds:439:775:Dialogue Text.target: *Loop 2 - This is the one where she is more aggressively rubbing.*

ds:439:777:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh yeah, that’s lookin’ nice! Reaaaal nice!
ds:439:777:Dialogue Text.target: Oooh, iya, bagus sekali kelihatannya! Baguuus sekali!

ds:439:784:Dialogue Text.source: See, the best thing about toys…
ds:439:784:Dialogue Text.target: Begini, yang paling bagus dari mainan…

ds:439:785:Dialogue Text.source: These guys don’t go soft on me after one round.
ds:439:785:Dialogue Text.target: Mereka tidak melembek setelah satu ronde.

ds:439:790:Dialogue Text.source: I’m going to hop off this bad boy.
ds:439:790:Dialogue Text.target: Aku mau turun dari barang hebat ini.

ds:439:791:Dialogue Text.source: Try to get a nice pull out shot.
ds:439:791:Dialogue Text.target: Coba ambil gambar yang bagus saat dicabut.

ds:439:794:Dialogue Text.source: Gah! Keep it coming Melody, this is gold!
ds:439:794:Dialogue Text.target: Gah! Teruskan, Melody, ini materi yang luar biasa!

ds:439:795:Dialogue Text.source: I think she’s gettin’ close Red!

ds:439:797:Dialogue Text.source: **When player presses button, flash to white, camera sound, and then fade to the illustration**
ds:439:797:Dialogue Text.target: **When player presses button, flash to white, camera sound, and then fade to the illustration**

ds:439:800:Dialogue Text.source: Oh gosh, did I get it on the camera?

ds:439:804:Dialogue Text.source: Get ready Rascal! Here it comes!

ds:439:805:Dialogue Text.source: **When player presses button, flash to white, camera sound, and then fade to the illustration**
ds:439:805:Dialogue Text.target: **When player presses button, flash to white, camera sound, and then fade to the illustration**

ds:439:812:Dialogue Text.source: How about you Red, didja’ get a good shot?
ds:439:812:Dialogue Text.target: Kalau kamu, Merah, dapat foto bagus?

ds:439:815:Dialogue Text.source: **When player presses button, flash to white, camera sound, and then fade to the illustration**
ds:439:815:Dialogue Text.target: **When player presses button, flash to white, camera sound, and then fade to the illustration**

ds:439:817:Dialogue Text.source: *pant pant* Well! *pant pant* How was that?

ds:439:819:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah this is great stuff Melody, you’re really workin’ this camera!
ds:439:819:Dialogue Text.target: Iya, ini bagus sekali, Melody, kamu benar-benar tahu cara beraksi di depan kamera!

ds:439:820:Dialogue Text.source: This isn’t your first time, is it?

ds:439:822:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm sorry dear. I hope you don’t mind…
ds:439:822:Dialogue Text.target: Mmm, maaf, Sayang. Semoga kamu tidak keberatan…

ds:439:826:Dialogue Text.source: Red, you lucky son of a gun!

ds:439:827:Dialogue Text.source: I knew I shoulda been holding the still-camera!
ds:439:827:Dialogue Text.target: Sudah kuduga seharusnya aku yang memegang kamera foto!

ds:439:829:Dialogue Text.source: Come dear, let’s get you cleaned up…

ds:439:830:Dialogue Text.source: *Fade to Black, transition back to the back of the shop*
ds:439:830:Dialogue Text.target: *Fade to Black, transition back to the back of the shop*

ds:439:834:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm, I think it’s time we whip out a toy…
ds:439:834:Dialogue Text.target: Mmm, rasanya sudah waktunya mengeluarkan mainan…

ds:439:836:Dialogue Text.source: Heh, I’m no stranger to a camera darling…
ds:439:836:Dialogue Text.target: Heh, aku sudah akrab dengan kamera, Sayang…

ds:439:837:Dialogue Text.source: But do you think I’d have myself on display like this often?
ds:439:837:Dialogue Text.target: Tapi kamu kira aku sering mempertontonkan diri seperti ini?

ds:439:839:Dialogue Text.source: Oh… erm, I didn’t mean anything by that…
ds:439:839:Dialogue Text.target: Oh… erm, aku tidak bermaksud apa-apa…

ds:439:841:Dialogue Text.source: Haha, I’m joking. You boys aren’t the first to get a show like this.
ds:439:841:Dialogue Text.target: Haha, aku bercanda. Kalian bukan yang pertama mendapat pertunjukan seperti ini.

ds:439:843:Dialogue Text.source: Let’s move on, while I’m still worked up…
ds:439:843:Dialogue Text.target: Ayo lanjut selagi aku masih bergairah…

ds:43:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ooooh! I'm gonna suck you so hard...

ds:440:716:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Ya stick with me, and I’ll make you a star!

ds:440:720:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]How about next time you two are the ones on the bed?
ds:440:720:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Bagaimana kalau lain kali kalian berdua yang di ranjang?

ds:440:725:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]You’ll be the support role though, I’m the star of this show after all!
ds:440:725:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Tapi kamu jadi pemeran pendukung, bagaimanapun aku bintang pertunjukan ini!

ds:440:728:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Of course! I wouldn’t miss out on a performance like that!
ds:440:728:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tentu! Pertunjukan seperti itu tidak akan kulewatkan!

ds:440:729:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Think you two can follow up this act though?
ds:440:729:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tapi rasanya kalian bisa menandingi penampilanku tadi?

ds:441:133:Dialogue Text.source: So uh… I noticed those Erotic Novels?
ds:441:133:Dialogue Text.target: Jadi, eh… Aku melihat Novel-Novel Erotis itu?

ds:441:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Usually I cover up that bottom shelf if I’m expecting guests… but uh…
ds:441:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Biasanya kututupi rak paling bawah itu kalau akan kedatangan tamu… tapi, eh…

ds:441:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah I suppose the cat’s out of the bag now…

ds:441:138:Dialogue Text.source: I thought you didn’t do "the love?"

ds:441:141:Dialogue Text.source:
If this is too forward,
you don’t have to talk about it.
ds:441:141:Dialogue Text.target:
Kalau ini terlalu terus terang,
kamu tidak harus membicarakannya.

ds:441:143:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m just trying to put it into words…

ds:441:144:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Like I might be shy about the topic…

ds:441:146:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I mean, I’ve had opportunities, but it’s always so scary in the moment! I just shy away.
ds:441:146:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Maksudku, aku pernah punya kesempatan, tapi saat itu selalu terasa menakutkan sekali! Aku malah menghindar.

ds:441:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But the books help me live it out!

ds:441:148:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]They let me consider how I might act in those situations…
ds:441:148:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Aku jadi bisa memikirkan bagaimana aku mungkin bertindak dalam situasi itu…

ds:441:150:Dialogue Text.source:
I get it! They help you live out what
some characters might be doing!
ds:441:150:Dialogue Text.target:
Aku paham! Buku membantumu merasakan
apa yang mungkin dilakukan tokoh-tokohnya!

ds:441:152:Dialogue Text.source:
But wouldn’t you rather
just try it for yourself?
ds:441:152:Dialogue Text.target:
Tapi bukankah kamu lebih ingin
mencobanya sendiri?

ds:441:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well… I wouldn’t want to try EVERYTHING I’ve read…
ds:441:153:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Yah… Aku tidak ingin mencoba SEMUA yang kubaca…

ds:441:154:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But there’s definitely some things that sound nice!
ds:441:154:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tapi pasti ada beberapa hal yang kedengarannya enak!

ds:442:133:Dialogue Text.source: What are some of your favorite stories?
ds:442:133:Dialogue Text.target: Cerita apa saja yang paling kamu suka?

ds:442:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well, I suppose a lot of the stories aren’t anything too ground breaking…
ds:442:136:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Yah, kurasa banyak ceritanya tidak terlalu baru atau revolusioner…

ds:442:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The naughty stuff can be a little bland too…

ds:442:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But for me, it’s the context that really gets things going!
ds:442:138:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tapi bagiku, konteksnyalah yang benar-benar membangkitkan gairah!

ds:442:141:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Two critters in love? That’s your pretty standard stuff.
ds:442:141:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Dua penghuni yang saling cinta? Itu cukup biasa.

ds:442:142:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But maybe one rescues the other from something… Or maybe it’s like a boss/worker sort of thing…
ds:442:142:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tapi mungkin yang satu menyelamatkan yang lain dari sesuatu… Atau mungkin hubungan atasan dan pekerja…

ds:442:143:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Or even like, maybe a brother and a sister!
ds:442:143:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Atau bahkan, mungkin saudara laki-laki dan saudara perempuan!

ds:442:145:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Haha some of these books can go pretty hard…
ds:442:145:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Haha, beberapa buku ini bisa cukup ekstrem…

ds:442:146:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The subjects themselves don’t particularly matter to me, but the drama that builds up from the context?
ds:442:146:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tema-temanya sendiri tidak terlalu penting bagiku, tapi drama yang tumbuh dari konteksnya?

ds:442:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s how different authors keep things fresh and interesting!
ds:442:147:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Begitulah berbagai penulis menjaga cerita tetap segar dan menarik!

ds:443:134:Dialogue Text.source: Ever wanted to try any of the things in these stories?
ds:443:134:Dialogue Text.target: Pernah ingin mencoba hal-hal dalam cerita ini?

ds:443:498:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I mean, I’ve read a lot of these books.
ds:443:498:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Maksudku, aku sudah membaca banyak buku ini.

ds:443:499:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]There’s all sorts of stuff I’d like to try!
ds:443:499:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ada segala macam hal yang ingin kucoba!

ds:443:500:Dialogue Text.source:
Melody seems open to helping.
Have you asked her?
ds:443:500:Dialogue Text.target:
Melody sepertinya bersedia membantu.

ds:458:203:Dialogue Text.source: Looks like a perch for a bird. It has been heavily used. There’s a sign nearby that reads Ring the bell!
ds:458:203:Dialogue Text.target: Sepertinya tenggeran burung. Sudah sering sekali dipakai. Ada papan di dekatnya yang bertuliskan Bunyikan lonceng!

ds:458:220:Dialogue Text.source: During flights. Penny will talk to you about random various things. I’ll include a list of stuff she’ll go through, but this first one will be scripted. After a certain amount of flights you can unlock her scene. Also maybe you need to be in like, act 3 or something.
ds:458:220:Dialogue Text.target: During flights. Penny will talk to you about random various things. I’ll include a list of stuff she’ll go through, but this first one will be scripted. After a certain amount of flights you can unlock her scene. Also maybe you need to be in like, act 3 or something.

ds:458:221:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Have you ever been up this high?

ds:458:225:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Don’t you worry dear, I’ve never dropped a critter before.
ds:458:225:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Jangan khawatir, Sayang, aku belum pernah menjatuhkan penumpang.

ds:458:228:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Poor old Fred, he was a good bun…
ds:458:228:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Kasihan Fred tua itu, dia kelinci yang baik…

ds:458:229:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]BAHAWHAW Just kidding! You’ll be fine dear!
ds:458:229:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]BAHAWHAW Bercanda! Kamu bakal baik-baik saja, Sayang!

ds:458:230:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh and look! Here is your stop!

ds:458:232:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’ll take it you’re trembling from excitement then!
ds:458:232:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kalau begitu, kuanggap kamu gemetaran karena senang!

ds:458:234:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Most critters nearly piss themselves from fear their first time!
ds:458:234:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Kebanyakan penumpang hampir mengompol ketakutan saat pertama kali!

ds:458:235:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh uh, don’t worry, I thoroughly wash after those incidents.
ds:458:235:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oh, eh, tenang, aku selalu mandi bersih setelah kejadian begitu.

ds:458:243:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve been doing these flights long before you were born.
ds:458:243:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Aku sudah melayani penerbangan ini jauh sebelum kamu lahir.

ds:458:245:Dialogue Text.source: Bird drops off Red, and lands on the perch.
ds:458:245:Dialogue Text.target: Bird drops off Red, and lands on the perch.

ds:458:246:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Thanks for choosing Penny Plume’s Ride and Zoom!
ds:458:246:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Terima kasih sudah memilih Tumpang dan Terbang Penny Plume!

ds:458:247:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I hope you had an enjoyable flight, and we’ll see you again real soon!
ds:458:247:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Semoga penerbanganmu menyenangkan, sampai jumpa lagi secepatnya!

ds:458:249:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The perch is just on the other side of the river.

ds:458:250:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]So until that bridge is fixed, I’ll be dropping critters off here.
ds:458:250:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Jadi sampai jembatannya diperbaiki, aku akan menurunkan penumpang di sini.

ds:458:251:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]This is off the record, and against policy, so don’t tell my boss!
ds:458:251:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Ini di luar catatan resmi dan melanggar peraturan, jadi jangan bilang bosku!

ds:458:266:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So how’s your stay been so far?
ds:458:266:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Jadi, bagaimana rasanya tinggal di sini sejauh ini?

ds:458:269:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Lots of folks seem to enjoy being busy, but personally, I like the slower pace of things…
ds:458:269:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Banyak yang sepertinya senang sibuk terus, tapi aku pribadi lebih suka hidup santai…

ds:458:270:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh gosh, maybe I’m just getting old!
ds:458:270:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Ya ampun, mungkin aku memang sudah tua!

ds:458:271:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Aaand here we are! Please remain seated while we begin our descent!
ds:458:271:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Daaann kita sudah sampai! Mohon tetap duduk saat kita mulai turun!

ds:458:273:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Bahaw! I hear you’ve been running some errands!

ds:458:274:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The folks are keeping you busy, eh?

ds:458:275:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Don’t worry, that means they like ya!

ds:458:278:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Though… We might be coming up on some turbulence…

ds:458:282:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Look’s like we’re here though, prepare to descend!
ds:458:282:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Tapi sepertinya kita sudah sampai, bersiaplah turun!

ds:458:285:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]This is your fourth trip with me. How do you like flying?
ds:458:285:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Ini perjalanan keempatmu bersamaku. Bagaimana rasanya terbang?

ds:458:286:Dialogue Text.source:
It’s actually incredible!
The sights are magnificent.

ds:458:287:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Right? It’s crazy to think! There’s SO MUCH space up here!
ds:458:287:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Iya, kan? Sulit dipercaya! Di atas sini LUAS SEKALI!

ds:458:288:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s a shame only us flyin’ folk can appreciate it.
ds:458:288:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Sayang cuma kami yang bisa terbang yang dapat menikmatinya.

ds:458:289:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m so glad I can share it with you critters!
ds:458:289:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Aku senang sekali bisa berbagi dengan kalian!

ds:458:290:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh! Here we are! Prepare for landing!

ds:458:291:Dialogue Text.source:
Still pretty scary…
And your jokes don’t help!
ds:458:291:Dialogue Text.target:
Masih cukup menakutkan…
Leluconmu juga tidak membantu!

ds:458:292:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Baww! Hah! That’s tough love for ya, Rascal!
ds:458:292:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Baww! Hah! Itulah kasih sayang yang tegas, Rascal!

ds:458:293:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Y’know, most of us birds learn how to fly by FALLING. A LOT!
ds:458:293:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Tahu tidak, kebanyakan burung belajar terbang dengan cara JATUH. BERKALI-KALI!

ds:458:294:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Gotta rip off that bandaid, y’know? Only then will you see that things aren’t so scary!
ds:458:294:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Harus berani langsung menghadapinya, tahu? Baru kamu bisa melihat kalau ternyata tidak semenakutkan itu!

ds:458:295:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Besides, the jokes are a complementary service! Those aren’t goin’ anywhere, bahaw!
ds:458:295:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Lagi pula, lelucon itu layanan gratis! Bakal terus ada, bahaw!

ds:458:313:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Y’know, I’ve been seeing you a lot today…
ds:458:313:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Tahu tidak, hari ini aku sering sekali bertemu kamu…

ds:458:314:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Normally I don’t see the same critter more than twice a day…
ds:458:314:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Biasanya aku tidak bertemu penumpang yang sama lebih dari dua kali sehari…

ds:458:315:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Not that I mind of course! I’ll ferry your cute rump all day long!
ds:458:315:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Tentu aku tidak keberatan! Seharian mengantar pantat manismu juga boleh!

ds:458:316:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh gosh, don’t tell my boss I’m flirting with you! Bahaw!
ds:458:316:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Ya ampun, jangan bilang bosku aku merayumu! Bahaw!

ds:458:320:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Right? I hear the flight attendant isn’t half bad lookin’ either!
ds:458:320:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Iya, kan? Kudengar pramugarinya juga lumayan cantik!

ds:458:322:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Must be nice, I keep gettin’ stuck with these lazy free loaders!
ds:458:322:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Enak, ya, aku malah terus-terusan dapat penumpang malas yang maunya gratisan!

ds:458:323:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Y’all got legs, don’tcha? Bahaw just messin’, dear!
ds:458:323:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Kalian punya kaki, kan? Bahaw, cuma bercanda, Sayang!

ds:458:328:Dialogue Text.source:
The sign reads: Ring the bell!
Now, if you only had a bell…
ds:458:328:Dialogue Text.target:
Papannya bertuliskan: Bunyikan lonceng!
Andai kamu punya lonceng…

ds:458:335:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Each of the bells are in their own key and ring out a specific jingle that helps me figure out where you are! See, sounds echo quite aimlessly up in the sky, so this helps speed up the process!
ds:458:335:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Setiap lonceng punya nada dasar dan melodi sendiri untuk membantuku tahu di mana kamu berada! Soalnya, gema suara sulit dilacak dari langit, jadi ini mempercepat pencarian!

ds:458:336:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I only offer pick up and drop off at the designated perches! It’s all part of the terms and services! (also apparently emergency rescue services…)
ds:458:336:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Aku hanya menjemput dan menurunkan penumpang di tenggeran yang sudah ditentukan! Semua itu bagian dari syarat dan ketentuan layanan! (dan ternyata juga layanan penyelamatan darurat…)

ds:458:337:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Finally, by riding Penny Plume’s Ride and Zoom you accept any and all accidental damages that can happen and may result in permanent damage, and or death!
ds:458:337:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Terakhir, dengan menaiki Tumpang dan Terbang Penny Plume, kamu menerima segala risiko kecelakaan yang dapat mengakibatkan cedera permanen dan atau kematian!

ds:458:339:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]OK With that all out of the way, where would you like to go?
ds:458:339:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Oke, setelah semua itu beres, mau pergi ke mana?

ds:458:341:Dialogue Text.source: Player can only choose the Central Forest
ds:458:341:Dialogue Text.target: Player can only choose the Central Forest

ds:458:347:Dialogue Text.source: Player can only choose the Central Forest
ds:458:347:Dialogue Text.target: Player can only choose the Central Forest

ds:458:353:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I bet you’re wondering what’s with this bell you rang, eh?
ds:458:353:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kamu pasti penasaran dengan lonceng yang kamu bunyikan itu, ya?

ds:458:355:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]See, I run a little business here! Would you like to hear my lil’ spiel?
ds:458:355:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Begini, aku punya usaha kecil di sini! Mau dengar sedikit promosiku?

ds:458:358:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Welcome to Penny Plume’s, Ride and Zoom!
ds:458:358:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Selamat datang di Tumpang dan Terbang Penny Plume!

ds:458:359:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The name’s Penny, as you know, and I’ll be your flight attendant today!
ds:458:359:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Seperti yang kamu tahu, namaku Penny, dan aku akan menjadi pramugarimu hari ini!

ds:458:360:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]… And every other day. I’m the only one who works at Penny Plume’s Ride and Zoom.
ds:458:360:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]… Dan setiap hari lainnya. Aku satu-satunya pekerja di Tumpang dan Terbang Penny Plume.

ds:458:361:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Let me explain how it works! I’ve given these bells to everyone in the forest, and when a critter needs a ride, they can ring the bell and I’ll pick them up!
ds:458:361:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Biar kujelaskan cara kerjanya! Lonceng-lonceng ini sudah kubagikan ke semua penghuni hutan. Kalau ada yang perlu tumpangan, tinggal bunyikan loncengnya, lalu akan kujemput!

ds:458:362:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]She can go mama-bear sometimes, but she means well.
ds:458:362:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Kadang dia protektif seperti induk beruang, tapi maksudnya baik.

ds:458:363:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Trust me, I’ve had my fair share of scolds from her!
ds:458:363:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=6]Percayalah, aku juga sudah sering kena omelannya!

ds:458:364:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Oh! Looks like we’re here! Hold on tight!
ds:458:364:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=7]Oh! Sepertinya sudah sampai! Pegangan yang erat!

ds:458:367:Dialogue Text.source: Uh, Yeah! … Sorry, do I know you?
ds:458:367:Dialogue Text.target: Eh, iya! … Maaf, kita saling kenal?

ds:458:368:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]You probably weren’t conscious at the time… but I was the one who found you.
ds:458:368:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Mungkin waktu itu kamu tidak sadar… tapi akulah yang menemukanmu.

ds:458:369:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I was flying my normal routes, and I saw you collapsed on the ground!
ds:458:369:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Aku sedang terbang di rute biasa, lalu melihatmu tergeletak di tanah!

ds:458:371:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I didn’t know how to help, so I took you to Scarlett immediately.
ds:458:371:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Aku tidak tahu harus berbuat apa, jadi langsung kubawa kamu ke Scarlett.

ds:458:372:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I’ve been busy working, so I couldn’t stop by to see how you were doing. It’s been plaguing me all day!
ds:458:372:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=5]Aku sibuk bekerja, jadi tidak sempat mampir untuk melihat keadaanmu. Seharian aku kepikiran!

ds:458:373:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But I’m so happy to see you are doing ok!
ds:458:373:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Tapi aku senang sekali melihatmu baik-baik saja!

ds:458:375:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Baww, no worries dear. Again, just glad to see you’re okay.
ds:458:375:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Baww, tenang saja, Sayang. Sekali lagi, aku cuma senang kamu baik-baik saja.

ds:458:377:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Let me know if this is too much for you right now! I know you might not be feeling well.
ds:458:377:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Bilang kalau sekarang ini terlalu berat buatmu! Aku tahu mungkin kamu masih kurang sehat.

ds:458:380:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh look, that’s the clearing where I found you.
ds:458:380:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=3]Oh, lihat, itu tanah lapang tempat aku menemukanmu.

ds:458:382:Dialogue Text.source: … I, uh… Didn’t get a lot of sleep…

ds:458:384:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hah! I’m guessing Scarlett gave you an earful already?
ds:458:384:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=1]Hah! Pasti Scarlett sudah mengomel panjang lebar, ya?

ds:458:421:Dialogue Text.source: Penny is on a date right now! Better try again later.
ds:458:421:Dialogue Text.target: Penny sedang kencan! Sebaiknya coba lagi nanti.

ds:458:425:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]All this glowing glyph business has been super exciting!

ds:458:428:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Good things actually! I think they’re becoming more curious about it.
ds:458:428:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=4]Hal baik, kok! Kurasa mereka makin penasaran.

ds:458:431:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I feel like things are just beginning!

ds:459:435:Dialogue Text.target: [pic=2]Jadi bagaimana rasanya tinggal di sini sejauh ini?
